Title: Digital - Senior Data Analyst / Data Analyst
Description:
THE BUSINESS

We are Everyday Luxury™.

It's what we do and how we do it — together.

It's working alongside world-class talent in pursuit of world-class results.

It's maximizing your potential in a high-performance culture.

It's knowing that wherever you are, you belong.

It's elevating your world — and the world of those who love and will love Aritzia.

It's You. And an endless runway of opportunity.




With a Global Support Campus in Vancouver and additional Support Office hubs in major cities across North America — including Toronto, New York, Los Angeles and Seattle — our workplace network is strategically designed to support our People and serve our Clients a frictionless experience. So, you can do what you do best — with us.




THE TEAM

The mission of the Digital Technology department is to provide the technology foundations, delivery capabilities, and operational excellence that enable Digital to scale with speed and deliver exceptional digital experiences.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Aritzia is growing and our Digital Technology team is growing with it. This is a unique opportunity to join the team responsible for unlocking the value of Aritzia's data and enabling data-driven decision-making across the business. As the Senior Data Analyst/Data Analyst, you will transform data into actionable insights by partnering with stakeholders to understand key business questions, analyze data, and communicate meaningful recommendations. With the skills you gain in this role, the opportunities are endless – from a rewarding career in Digital Technology to continued growth and development with Aritzia.




THE ROLE

As the Senior Data Analyst/Data Analyst, Digital Technology, you will:

Partner and innovate with business leaders to deeply understand or identify the strategic opportunities across client acquisition, activation, retention and reactivation
Define measurement strategies to quantify the performance of various customer programs and compare their current condition against a hindsight benchmark
Support with generating actionable insights by analyzing customer behaviour through diagnostics, correlations, and hypothesis testing to grow the business and enhance customer experience
Clearly and accurately visualize and communicate data and analytics through reports, dashboards, and presentations to maximize strategic decisions




THE QUALIFICATIONS

The Senior Data Analyst/Data Analyst, Digital Technology, has:

Proven skills, education, and/or applicable certifications in:
SQL
Visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or equivalent)
Python
R or related statistical analysis and tools
Analyzing and interpreting complex datasets to generate actionable business insights
A commitment to learn, apply, champion and enrich Aritzia's Values and Business and People Leadership principles




THE COMPENSATION

At Aritzia, we provide market-leading compensation packages designed to reward impact through our pay-for-performance philosophy.




The range for roles at this level is $100,000-$300,000 per year. Total compensation may include base, bonus and/or equity depending on the role, which has the potential to be greater than this range.




With comprehensive benefits, aspirational workspaces, and elevated perks and experiences — we provide it all.




THE PERKS

Some of the industry-leading benefits you will receive working at Aritzia:

Product Discount — Maybe you’ve heard of our famous product discount? Or our exclusive private shopping events? You have now.
Baby Leave Program — We provide up to 16 weeks of paid time to support you and your growing family.
Aritzia Virtual Wellness — Because your health, happiness and safety matter, we provide 24/7 resources to support you in your wellbeing goals, whether they’re physical, mental, social or financial.
Aspirational Workplace — Our offices are specially designed to be spaces of creativity, productivity and inspiration.
Amenities — Additional amenities include a private parent’s room, shower facilities with elevated complementary conveniences, bike rooms and more.
The Extras — We also offer a multitude of other perks like snacks and refreshments, dry-cleaning, hotel, restaurant discounts, health and wellness discounts, and self-care promos.




ARITZIA




Aritzia is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Our goal is to be inclusive, diverse, and representative of the communities where we work while creating an environment where every person can enjoy a successful career. This commitment applies to all candidates and employees regardless of race, ethnicity, citizenship, creed, place of origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, family status, marital status, disability, age, and any other protected characteristic.




Requests for accommodation due to a disability or any other protected characteristic can be made at any stage of the recruitment process and during employment by contacting our People & Culture Team.




We’re committed to making your experience positive and transparent. Please note, our recruiters will only contact you using an @aritzia.com email address. If you receive recruitment-related messages from other domains, please disregard them.

Title: Data Analyst Sr - Quality and Safety
Description:
Work Location: Downtown Seattle (Hybrid – 3 days/week on-site)

Supports the Hospital and Enterprise Analytics' vision, mission, and strategic initiatives by using technical expertise to design, create and develop analytical solutions and by providing internal consultation and project management. The incumbent provides leadership in the facilitating and gathering business requirements, and provides knowledge in business/clinical processes, analytical expertise, technical programming skills, and substantial leadership skills in working with key stakeholders, end users and project team members. This position identifies and resolves issues throughout the development of analytical solutions, and is accountable for identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in workflow processes in the implementation of these solutions. Primary responsibility is the design, creation and deployment of analytical solutions for Executive leadership and other key stakeholders within the SCH organization. The incumbent is responsible for frequently taking a formal or an informal lead on project tasks, and leads efforts to design and implement analytic solutions, including reports, dashboards, and views from a wide range of existing data sources, and provides leadership in evaluating and optimizing these solutions. The incumbent also assures integrity of the data for current and future use in strategic initiatives, continuous quality improvement efforts and hospital goals, and for insuring the sustainability and adaptability of all developed solutions.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Health Science, Computer Science, Math, Business or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience/technical training that demonstrates analytical and technical competency.

Minimum five (5) years experience in progressively more responsible work as a data analyst, developer or equivalent.

Experience in data extraction/integration/aggregation using SQL, R or python.

Expert in use of data visualization for non-technical audiences.

Experience with at least one notable BI reporting tool (e.g., Tableau, QlikView, PowerBI, Business Objects, html/d3).

Experience working with source control tools and version management.

Required Credentials

N/A.

Preferred

Experience working with senior and executive leaders.

Experience with EHR Data (Epic)

Quality and safety related experience.

Experience working as a data analyst within a healthcare setting.

Experience with clinical, hospital and/or financial applications and/or systems.

Experience as a member of a delivery team supporting integrated analytics products and solutions for a wide range of customer groups.

Uses reasonable and basic statistical analyses to make comparisons and detect trends, communicate insights.

Utilizes established data analysis models and tools for analyzing qualitative or quantitative data.

Compensation Range

$118,174.00 - $177,262.00 per year

Salary Information

This compensation range was calculated based on full-time employment (2080 hours worked per calendar year). Offers are determined by multiple factors including equity, skills, experience, and expertise, and may vary within the range provided.

Disclaimer for Out of State Applicants

This compensation range is specific to Seattle, positions located outside of Seattle may be compensated differently depending on various factors.

Benefits Information

Seattle Children’s offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 403(b), life insurance, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more. Additional details on our benefits can be found on our website www.seattlechildrens.org/careers/benefits.

About Us

Hope. Care. Cure. These three simple words capture what we do at Seattle Children’s – to help every child live the healthiest and most fulfilling life possible. Are you ready to engage with a mission-driven organization that is life-changing to many, and touches the hearts of all? #HOPECARECURE

Our founding promise to the community is as valid today as it was over a century ago: we will care for all children in our region, regardless of the families’ ability to pay. Together, we deliver superior patient care, advance new discoveries and treatments through pediatric research, and serve as the pediatric and adolescent, academic medical center for Washington, Alaska, Montana and Idaho – the largest region of any children’s hospital in the country.

U.S. News & World Report consistently ranks Seattle Children’s among the nation’s best children’s hospitals. For more than a decade, Seattle Children’s has been nationally recognized in key specialty areas. We are honored to be one of the nation’s very best places to care for children and the top-ranked pediatric hospital in Washington and the Pacific Northwest.

As a Magnet designated institution, we recognize the importance of hiring and developing great talent to provide best-in-class care to the patients and families we serve. Our organizational DNA takes form in our core values: Compassion, Excellence, Integrity, Collaboration, Equity and Innovation. Whether it’s delivering frontline care to our patients in a kind and caring manner, practicing the highest standards of quality and safety, or being relentlessly curious as we work towards eradicating childhood diseases, these values are the fabric of our culture and community. The future starts here.

Our Commitment

Seattle Children’s welcomes people of all experiences, backgrounds, and thoughts as this is what drives our spirit of inquiry and allows us to better connect with our patients and families. Our organization recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes based on merit without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

The people who work at Seattle Children’s are members of a community that seeks to respect and celebrate all the qualities that make each of us unique. Each of us is empowered to be ourselves.

Seattle Children’s is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Workplace and Affirmative Action Employer.

Title: Data Analyst – Class Action Defense
Description:
Description

This is an exciting opportunity to work for one of the top law firms in the U.S.! Davis Wright Tremaine LLP is looking for a Data Analyst to join our team in our Seattle, Portland, Los Angeles, or San Francisco offices.

This position offers the flexibility to be fully remote while working within reasonable commuting distance from any of our offices.

This position is responsible for supporting a dynamic and growing class-action defense practice. The data analyst will play a pivotal role in managing, analyzing, and visualizing data for complex matters, including wage and hour disputes, pay equity cases, and class-action litigation. The ideal candidate will thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and demonstrate outstanding technical, analytical, and communication skills to streamline class-action litigation support processes and deliver exceptional client service.

At Davis Wright Tremaine, you will find challenging assignments, opportunities for professional growth and community involvement, and a culture of inclusion. DWT fosters inclusiveness and authenticity. Regardless of position, everyone here has a voice and the support is unparalleled.

On a Typical Day You Will

Data Management & Analytics


Partner with attorneys and clients to evaluate data needs, develop analysis strategies, and deliver clear and actionable insights.
Obtain, structure, and manage raw datasets from various sources, including payroll, timekeeping, and HRIS.
Analyze and evaluate data using advanced tools and reporting platforms to create pivot tables, charts, and intuitive visual dashboards.
Perform advanced data analytics to generate deliverables such as exposure analyses, pay equity audits, affirmative action plans, and class lists.
Design exposure analysis reports to identify key case strengths, risks, and potential settlement strategies.
Organize data workflows for wage and hour analyses, enabling efficient and accurate review across multiple data sets and record formats.



Collaboration & Communication


Work with multidisciplinary teams, including attorneys, clients, expert witnesses, and opposing counsel, to guide data-related discussions.
Collaborate with IT, eDiscovery, and Practice Support teams to ensure secure, compliant handling of sensitive data throughout the case lifecycle.
Communicate findings effectively to attorneys, clients, and other stakeholders through written reports, visual presentations, and face-to-face briefings.



Technology Strategy & Support


Evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and methodologies for data analysis, visualization, and reporting for litigation support.
Leverage software such as Excel, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, or similar tools to deliver dynamic and interactive visualizations of crucial metrics.
Collaborate with staff in analytics roles to provide support and seamless backup coordination.



Class-Action Specific Support


Assist with analysis of potential CAFA removal.
Prepare putative class lists, perform random sampling analyses, and other tasks in support of class opposition processes.
Develop and run pay equity and EEO analyses to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and best practices.
Coordinate with expert witnesses to create polished and effective exposure models for case development and litigation defense strategy.
Generate detailed reports to support complex class-action claims, highlighting key trends and patterns in the data.



Trial & Litigation Preparation


Support attorneys during motion practice, depositions, and trial preparation with clear, accurate data summaries and visual exhibits.
Assist in reviewing data-related findings in expert reports, ensuring alignment with case objectives and litigation strategies.



Join Us If You Have


4+ years of professional experience as a Data Analyst, with a proven track record in complex data analysis and reporting, preferably in employment class action litigation or related fields.
Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in statistics, data analytics, or a related field.
Technical Proficiency:
Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, macros, and advanced formulas.
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, SQL, or similar platforms for data visualization and analysis.
Familiarity with HRIS, payroll systems (e.g., ADP, UKG), and wage and hour analysis.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to adapt technical findings for non-technical audiences.
Advanced proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office applications (i.e., Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) for drafting and editing complex documents and spreadsheets.
Exceptional problem-solving, analytical skills, and attention to detail, with a demonstrated ability to meet tight deadlines.
Familiarity with employment law, including wage and hour standards (especially in California), pay equity laws, and EEO compliance are strongly preferred.
Ability to design and deliver exposure models and visual insights for effective case strategy.
Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Willingness and availability to work flexible hours, including evenings or weekends, to meet litigation deadlines.
Previous experience in a law firm or professional services setting supporting multiple offices strongly preferred.


Who We Are

Davis Wright Tremaine LLP is an AmLaw 100 law firm with 9 offices nationwide. We are relentlessly committed to client service and look for candidates who share that commitment. At DWT, client service means having empathy for each client’s and each lawyer’s work and personal pressures, business objectives, and legal needs; anticipating their needs; and having the capabilities and commitment to deliver what matters most to them.

What’s in it For You?

DWT offers competitive compensation in addition to ample benefits including but not limited to:


Choice of health and vision insurance plans
2 paid volunteer days for qualifying community service work
Dental plan
Fertility and adoption benefit
Paid sabbatical after 13 years of service
Tuition reimbursement
Commuter benefits
Retirement contribution



This job description intends to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to include all duties and responsibilities.

Washington State

The annualized salary range for this position in Washington is $121,000 to $145,000 ($62.05 to $74.36 hourly). Actual pay will be adjusted based on the candidate’s education, training, experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. Full time employees may be eligible for a bonus, health insurance with an optional HSA, long term disability, dental insurance, vision care, telemedicine and virtual short term solution based counseling services, life insurance, Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, subsidized backup care and caregiving resources, 401(k), vacation, sick time, 11 paid holidays each year and an employee assistance program. For full-time employees, the initial vacation benefit is 15 days per year and 11 days of sick leave per year, accrued bi-weekly. Additional voluntary programs include: voluntary accident insurance, voluntary life, voluntary disability, voluntary long term care, and pet insurance. Commuter and Transit programs are also available.

California

The annualized salary range for this position in Los Angeles is $120,000 to $146,000 ($61.54 to $74.87 hourly); and in San Francisco is $138,000 to $165,000 ($70.77 to $84.62 hourly). Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. Full time employees may be eligible for a bonus, health insurance with an optional HSA, long term disability, dental insurance, vision care, telemedicine and virtual short term solution based counseling services, life insurance, Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, subsidized backup care and caregiving resources, 401(k), vacation, sick time, and an employee assistance program. Additional voluntary programs include: voluntary accident insurance, voluntary life, voluntary disability, voluntary long term care, and pet insurance. Commuter and Transit programs are also available.

Davis Wright Tremaine LLP fosters a culture where all talented individuals—including those who are traditionally underrepresented in the legal profession—can have, and can see, paths to success. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion sits on four pillars: Community, Growth, Education, and Engagement. Learn more about the firm’s commitment to DEI here:www.dwt.com/dei.

Davis Wright Tremaine provides reasonable accommodations for those who need them to complete the application or recruiting process and for employees who need reasonable accommodations to perform the essential functions of their positions due to a disability or for religious reasons. If you need to request accommodation during the application or recruiting process, please email [email protected].

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to join our Human Resources People Analytics team. In this strategic role, you will leverage your analytical expertise and problem-solving skills to transform raw data into actionable insights, enabling HR and business leaders to optimize processes, enhance performance, and drive organizational efficiency. Your work will be pivotal in shaping data-driven HR strategies and fostering organizational success. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design advanced data models and visualizations that contribute to our mission of operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Proactively address challenges, offering innovative, data-driven solutions that enhance HR processes and outcomes.

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field or equivalent in years of exp.

Expertise in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI).
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide impactful solutions.
Excellent attention to detail, ensuring recommendations are accurate and actionable.
Strong communication skills for effective interaction with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A mindset of ownership and curiosity, with the drive to understand data within its broader business context.

Solid experience in HR analytics, with a deep understanding of its impact on talent management and policy decisions.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, R, Etc).

DSHS HCLA Performance Outcomes and Data Analyst

The Department of Social and Health Services (DSHS) and the Home and Community Living Administration (HCLA) are looking for their newest Performance Outcomes and Data Analyst. This newly created position contributes to the division's ability to monitor operational performance, improve reporting consistency, support informed operational decision-making, and promote the health, safety, and well-being of vulnerable adults residing in licensed and certified long-term care settings throughout Washington State.

Working closely with the Business Intelligence Analyst, you'll assist in developing business intelligence solutions, improving data quality, and translating business needs into meaningful analytical products.

If collecting and telling stories with data sounds exciting to you, then we want to hear from you!

Some Of What You'll Do


Analyze and interpret RCS performance and operational data
Assist and support the Development and maintenance of reports generation, dashboards, scorecards and performance measures
Respond to and prioritize data requests
Validate data and monitor data quality
Collaborate closely with the Office Chief of Business Operations, Business Intelligence Analyst, and RCS program staff.


Who We Want In This Role

Knowledge

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Statistics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Social Sciences, or a closely related field.

AND

Minimum of two years of professional experience in data analysis, performance measurement, business intelligence, program evaluation, reporting, or a related analytical field.

Or

Equivalent combinations of education and professional experience in data analysis, performance measurement, business intelligence, program evaluation or a related field may substitute for the year per year of educational requirements.

Skills And Abilities


Experience creating, collecting, validating, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources to support business or operational decisions.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, scorecards, and data visualizations using reporting and business intelligence tools.
Experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to management, stakeholders, or program staff.
Demonstrated experience utilizing SQL and other data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence applications to collect, manage, analyze and present data in support of operational, programmatic, and strategic objectives.
Experience working with databases, data management practices, and performance metrics.

The Washington State Employee Assistance Program promotes the health and well-being of employees.

Social Security

Public Service Loan Forgiveness

If you are employed by a government or not-for-profit organization, and meet the qualifying criteria, you may be eligible to receive student loan forgiveness under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program.

Holidays

Full-time and part-time employees are entitled to paid holidays and one paid personal holiday per calendar year.

Note: Employees who are members of certain Unions may be entitled to additional personal leave day(s), please refer to position specific Collective Bargaining Agreements for more information.

Full-time employees who work full monthly schedules qualify for holiday compensation if they are employed before the holiday and are in pay status for at least 80 nonovertime hours during the month of the holiday; or for the entire work shift preceding the holiday.

Part-time employees who are in pay status during the month of the holiday qualify for the holiday on a pro-rata basis. Compensation for holidays (including personal holiday) will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status in the month to that required for full-time employment, excluding all holiday hours. Pay status includes hours worked and time on paid leave.

Full-time employees earn eight hours of sick leave per month. Overtime eligible employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month, earn a monthly proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full-time employment. Overtime exempt employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month do not earn a monthly accrual of sick leave.

Sick leave accruals for part-time employees will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday.

Vacation (Annual Leave)

Data Analyst – RFQ, Proposal & Business Performance Analytics

________________________________________

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to support customer’s Program Management and Business Development organization. This role will be responsible for tracking and analyzing the end-to-end opportunity pipeline from RFQ receipt through quote submission, negotiation, contract award, and program kickoff.

The analyst will transform business development, estimating, proposal, and program data into actionable insights that improve bid management, enhance forecasting accuracy, increase win rates, and provide leadership visibility into opportunity conversion performance.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, experience managing large datasets, and the ability to develop executive scorecards, dashboards, and business performance analytics.

Industry Experience


Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline, with 3–7 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or performance analytics roles.
Proven experience working with large datasets and developing executive dashboards, scorecards, and business performance reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and SQL.
Prior experience supporting Program Management, Business Development, Estimating, Proposal Management, Sales Operations, or RFQ-to-Award processes is highly desirable.
Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the aerospace, manufacturing, defense, or industrial sectors, including exposure to opportunity pipeline management, win-rate analysis, forecasting, and KPI framework development.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to transform complex business data into actionable insights and leadership-ready recommendations.


Key Responsibilities: Summary of Responsibilities & Skills


Track and manage the complete RFQ-to-Award lifecycle, including RFQ receipt, quote submission, negotiations, award decisions, and program handoff.
Collect, consolidate, validate, and maintain opportunity, proposal, and award data from multiple business systems.
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting tools that provide visibility into pipeline health and business performance.
Analyze RFQ volumes, proposal activity, quote turnaround times, award rates, win/loss performance, and revenue opportunities.
Perform month-over-month, quarter-over-quarter, and year-over-year trend analysis to identify business growth patterns and performance gaps.
Generate actionable insights on customer activity, opportunity conversion rates, business segment performance, and program trends.
Create executive-level reports and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and PowerPoint for leadership reviews.
Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as RFQs received, quotes submitted, proposals pending, awards won, pipeline value, and forecasted revenue.
Conduct comparative analysis across customers, product lines, business sectors, manufacturing sites, and program portfolios.
Support forecasting activities by providing visibility into near-term awards, future revenue potential, and business growth opportunities.
Collaborate closely with Program Management, Estimating, Sales, Engineering, and Business Development teams to improve data quality and reporting effectiveness.
Identify bottlenecks in the proposal and quotation process and recommend process improvements to enhance responsiveness and win rates.
Standardize KPI definitions, reporting methodologies, and dashboard formats to enable consistent reporting across the organization.
Drive continuous improvement through automation of reports, enhancement of analytics capabilities, and development of scalable business intelligence solutions.
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to management to support strategic decision-making and business growth initiatives.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in Excel (advanced), SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and PowerPoint for data analysis, dashboard development, executive reporting, and business performance monitoring.
Experience working with large, complex datasets, including data extraction, cleansing, transformation, validation, and trend analysis.
Ability to develop and maintain RFQ-to-Award dashboards, KPI scorecards, pipeline reports, and revenue forecasting models.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, conversion drivers, business risks, and growth opportunities.
Experience performing win/loss analysis, opportunity pipeline tracking, proposal performance measurement, and business forecasting.
Effective data storytelling and executive communication skills, capable of translating complex data into actionable insights and leadership recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across Program Management, Business Development, Estimating, Engineering, and Operations teams.
Continuous improvement mindset with experience standardizing reporting processes, automating analytics, improving data quality, and implementing scalable business intelligence solutions.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst I
Description:
As a Business Intelligence (BI) analyst, you will be responsible for managing concurrent analytical projects. You will also be involved in project work with Port-wide reach that requires some consultation with organizational and functional departments, and you will translate simple requirements into analytical applications and solutions that inform business cases, with significant cost and process savings and contribute directly to the success of department business plans and key enterprise strategic goals.


You will design, develop, and maintain basic to intermediate BI solutions using technologies such as Tableau, Excel, and Alteryx.
You will function as a technical resource for reporting and analytical projects, be familiar with data sources used in day-to-day operations, and respond quickly to ad hoc problems.
You will provide advice for analytics projects, including utilizing best practices for the design and development of analytical solutions and data visualizations, as well as reviewing and contributing to technical documentation to ensure accurate development of reporting solutions.
You will assist in managing the Tableau Cloud environment including data sources, security, and subscriptions.
You will bring data to life using storytelling and advanced data visualization techniques. You will also use data visualization tools to communicate actionable insights across multiple data sources.
You will actively participate in the business intelligence community by preparing materials for presentations at local conferences as well as attending conferences and training to bring fresh ideas to the organization.
You will continuously maintain an understanding of Business Intelligence technology, architecture, methodologies, and best practices and build additional BI capability through training programs and one-on-one assistance.


Who you are:


Experienced – You possess six (6) months of entry-level experience in data analysis and working with large data sets. This includes using SQL and data visualization tools such as Tableau, ETL tool like Alteryx, and/or with data modeling and data warehousing concepts. This may include internship experience.
Desired – We hope you have a bachelor’s degree or above in computer science, math, information technology, and/or information security.
Committed to Equity – You will apply equity and exemplify shared values, behaviors, and practices in all aspects of the work. At the Port of Seattle, equity is a daily responsibility and a foundational expectation for all Port employees.
Proficient – You can analyze complex datasets using statistical methods and BI tools, create effective data visualizations, and use strong SQL skills to extract and manipulate data. You also have experience with data modeling and data warehousing, understanding business processes, and have basic knowledge of relational database design and research methods.
Efficient Communicator – You have strong communication skills to present findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
Analytical – You can think critically and solve problems using data-driven insights and can pay attention to details and ensure data accuracy. You can also manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
Adaptable – You can work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and can work independently and as part of a team.


What Else You Need To Know


Work Schedule – Your normal work schedule will be Monday – Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (40 hours per week). Slightly more flexible start and end times are available in this role. Weekend on-call coverage may be required as needed.
Work Environment - This work will take place in a hybrid/in-office setting at Management’s discretion.
Washington State Residency Requirement – Employees must establish a residence in Washington state within 30 days of their first day of employment and must maintain a residence in Washington State during their employment with the Port of Seattle. If a position is eligible to telework, work performed while teleworking must be performed in Washington State.
Security Requirements – As the successful candidate, you must pass a Transportation Security Administration (TSA) background check as well as a criminal history background check with the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). Your employment will be contingent upon obtaining a Port of Seattle ID badge upon clearance.


Why you'll love it here:

The Port of Seattle offers an extensive benefits package that rewards our staff for their valuable contributions towards the Port‘s mission. In addition to the summary below, benefit details for non-represented positions can be found on the Port of Seattle‘s website. If the position is represented by a union, please refer to the “Collective Bargaining Agreement” or contact the appropriate Union Representative for specific information related to benefits and eligibility.


Healthcare – Medical, Dental, and Vision Care with options that work for you and your family.
Paid Vacation – Just about four weeks per year that increases with tenure to rest and rejuvenate.
Paid Sick Leave – At least one hour of sick leave for every 40 hours worked.
Holidays – More than ten days per year to celebrate with family and friends away from work.
Pension/Retirement Plans – A pension and additional savings plans to prepare for your future after the Port.
Getting to Work – From subsidized parking and a low-cost public transit card to alternative work arrangements giving you an opportunity to work hybrid.
Parental Leave – Six weeks of paid leave to spend with new additions to your immediate family.
Development – From tuition reimbursement, training, stretch assignments and internal internships, we support a learning culture.
Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion – The Port of Seattle values diversity as a source of innovation and strength. We are actively working across the organization to create a culture where all employees – regardless of race, gender, and other identities – succeed and reach their fullest potential.
Work-Life Balance – We provide the resources to help you create habits to be healthy and balanced.
Mission Driven – We are focused together in promoting economic opportunities and quality of life in the region by advancing trade, travel, commerce, and job creation in an equitable, accountable, and environmentally responsible manner.


Why the Port of Seattle:

Every role at the Port of Seattle is vital to our thriving community. We are a leader in moving people and cargo across the country and around the world. With facilities and property ranging in scope from a half-acre park to one of the largest airports and container terminals on the West Coast, we maximize the public assets in our portfolio with an eye toward best uses and environmental sustainability. Find out more here.

Our vision is to create a Port that mirrors – throughout its breadth of operations and services and within its leadership – the diversity of our communities, instill principles of equity into its culture, and ensures a fair and intentional distribution of opportunities to expand economic development and quality of life for all in our region. Find out more about how our values RAISE us up and our commitment to equity.

Title: Data Analyst, MFN RCX
Description:
Description

In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.

WWRR includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WWRR, you will partner across these teams to help customers discover great deals on quality used, rentals, and open box items; get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WWRR, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for leveraging data and analytics to identify gaps, measure effectiveness, and drive decisions to improve the returns experience. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. You will own end-to-end project execution for initiatives within your focus area, including influencing partner teams, driving prioritization on the roadmap, and working with tech to resolve issues you surface. You will leverage SQL and analytical tools to support the projects you own. Additionally, you should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impact the bottom line of the business.

Key job responsibilities


Use data and analytics to identify operational gaps, drive business decisions, and own resolution with partner teams.
Employ the appropriate tools and methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse, and help reduce bad debt
Analyze customer behavioral patterns and develop policy change recommendations based on findings and drive implementation with partner teams
Leverage data to influence partner teams and drive prioritization to get issues resolved
Write SQL queries and leverage data to surface gaps, track project health, and report on outcomes
Work closely with business, engineering, and partner teams to align on priorities and deliver against your focus area


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of program or project management experience
2+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
Experience writing SQL queries to extract and analyze data, track program health, and drive decisions
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or 2+ years of Amazon experience in an analytical or program management capacity


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
Experience managing stakeholder communications and driving alignment across multiple teams
Experience building automated reporting or dashboards using BI tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, or similar)

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst, Finance
Description:
Get To Know The Pokémon Company International

The Pokémon Company International manages the Pokémon property outside of Asia and is responsible for brand management, licensing and marketing, the Pokémon Trading Card Game, the animated TV series, home entertainment, and the official Pokémon website. Pokémon was launched in Japan in 1996 and today is one of the most popular children’s entertainment properties in the world.

Learn more online at corporate.pokemon.com and pokemon.com.



Get to know the role


Job Title: Business Intelligence Analyst, Finance
Job Summary: This role will be responsible for deep analysis of complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to decision-makers.
FLSA Classification (US Only): Exempt
People Manager: No


What you’ll do


Build and maintain automated data pipelines extracting financial data from Oracle Fusion Cloud (GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets)
Transform raw data into clean, reporting-ready datasets; monitor pipelines and resolve data issues
Document data lineage and transformation logic
Design and maintain Tableau dashboards for key financial metrics
Translate Finance/Accounting requirements into technical specs, ensuring consistent metrics across tools
Partner with Finance, Accounting, and Tech teams on reporting needs and priorities
Provide ad hoc analysis for audits, forecasting, and management reporting; train users on self-service tools
Maintain validation checks reconciling source data to reports
Maintain data dictionaries and documentation
Drive automation and data quality improvements


What you’ll bring


Five (5) to seven (7) years of relevant professional experience or a demonstrated equivalent level of expertise
Bachelor's degree in an analytical field or a demonstrated equivalent level of applicable experience
Demonstrated proficient experience using SQL, Python or other coding languages and ETL tools (i.e. data build tool)
Experience using data visualization tools (i.e. Tableau, PowerBI)
Data warehouse architecture and modeling experience
Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle ADW strongly preferred
Familiarity with Databricks and other cloud-based data warehouses
Experience with implementing data quality monitoring and alerting systems
Experience with JIRA, Gitlab and Confluence
Business domain knowledge in accounting, finance, IP & royalty strongly preferred


Base Salary Range: For this role, new hires generally start between $95,000.00 - $127,000.00 per year. The full range is $95,000.00 - $172,000.00 per year. This range is applicable for the labor market where the role is intended to be hired. The final base salary is directly related to the candidate’s qualifications and professional experience uniquely.

How You’ll Be Successful


Passion for Pokémon: Develops an understanding of the Pokémon brand, the impact it has on our people, culture, business, fans, and communities, and applying that knowledge and passion to everything you do.
Challenging the Expected: Approaches challenges with curiosity and creativity, embracing the possibility of failure as an opportunity to learn something new, develop innovative ideas, solve complex problems and identify unique opportunities.
Integrity and Respect: Demonstrates integrity and respect by leading with empathy, listening to others, seeking out different perspectives, and taking personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and results.
Dedicated to Quality: Takes ownership to maintain and promote high standards, looks for new ways to learn and improve, and embraces a growth mindset to seek and apply feedback from others in an effort to continuously improve.
Building Relationships: Develops and strengthens relationships, adopting a “team first” mentality and working collaboratively to solve problems and meet shared goals.
Delighting Customers: Listens and understands the interests and needs of our customers and stakeholders, making them feel heard and important, and embracing these learnings to continue delivering a unique Pokémon experience.


What To Expect


An innovative culture driven by impact, delivering meaningful outcomes.
Company events that celebrate the spirit of Pokémon.
Competitive cash-based compensation programs.
100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for you.
Generous paid family leave.
Employer-paid life insurance.
Employer-paid long and short-term income protection insurance.
US Employees: 401k Employer Matching.
UK/IRE/MX Employees: Pension Employer Contributions.
Fitness reimbursement.
Commuter benefit.
LinkedIn learning.
Comprehensive relocation package for certain roles.
Hybrid work environment.


The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this role. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. For roles in the United Kingdom, candidates will need the right to work. In some cases, and for some roles, the Company may be able to arrange a visa. For roles in Ireland, this role requires candidates to have the right to live and work in the Republic of Ireland. However, we welcome applications from all nationalities and may consider supporting an employment permit application, in appropriate and suitable cases.

The Pokémon Company International is committed to the inclusion of all qualified applicants for consideration in our job application process. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview, or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact the Talent Acquisition team at accommodationrequest_ta@pokemon.com.

Join Our Team: Do Meaningful Work and Improve People’s Lives

Our purpose, to improve customers’ lives by making healthcare work better, is far from ordinary. And so are our employees. Working at Premera means you have the opportunity to drive real change by transforming healthcare.

Premera is committed to being a workplace where people feel empowered to grow, innovate, and lead with purpose. Learn how Premera supports our members, customers and the communities that we serve through our Healthsource blog: https://healthsource.premera.com/.

Information Analyst III, Workforce Management

Position Summary

The Information Analyst III, Workforce Management is responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights that support workforce planning, operational performance, business decision-making, and regulatory compliance. This role partners closely with leaders and stakeholders across the organization to identify reporting needs, analyze trends, improve data quality, and develop scalable analytics solutions.

As a senior analyst, this position leads complex analytical initiatives, establishes reporting standards and best practices, mentors less experienced analysts, and drives data-informed decisions that support organizational goals. The Information Analyst III serves as a trusted advisor for workforce analytics and business intelligence needs across multiple functional areas.

This is a hybrid role, located on our campus in Mountlake Terrace WA

What You'll Do


Partner with business stakeholders to understand complex business challenges, define reporting requirements, and deliver data-driven solutions that improve operational performance, reduce costs, support compliance, and enhance workforce effectiveness.
Design, develop, document, maintain, and optimize reports, dashboards, data models, and analytical solutions that support workforce management and organizational decision-making.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and actionable insights.
Develop automated reporting and dashboard solutions that improve visibility into key workforce, operational, and business performance metrics.
Validate and peer review analytical work, reports, and dashboards to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to established standards.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting processes, operational databases, and overall analytical efficiency; recommend and implement solutions.
Lead complex analytical projects and cross-functional initiatives, coordinating efforts to achieve project goals and measurable business outcomes.
Analyze and resolve complex reporting and data issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions.
Create and maintain technical documentation, reporting standards, data definitions, and process documentation.
Provide mentorship, guidance, and training to analysts and business partners on reporting tools, methodologies, and best practices.
Assist with project planning by estimating resource requirements, effort, timelines, and project complexity.
Develop workforce analytics, forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and operational performance reporting to support workforce management strategies.


What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; or four (4) years of equivalent work experience.
Five (5) years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Experience working with large datasets, data validation, and analytical problem-solving.
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions that support business decision-making.


Preferred Qualifications


Three (3) or more years of experience in healthcare, health insurance, workforce management, or a related industry.
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large-scale data environments.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern analytics environments.
Experience developing workforce analytics, staffing models, forecasting solutions, scheduling analytics, or operational performance reporting.
Knowledge of contact center operations, workforce planning, or healthcare operational analytics.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Advanced knowledge of SQL, reporting tools, business intelligence platforms, and data analytics methodologies.
Strong understanding of relational databases, data structures, data governance, and reporting best practices.
Excellent analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.
Demonstrated ability to lead analytical initiatives, manage competing priorities, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Proven ability to mentor analysts and promote best practices in reporting, analytics, and data management.
Knowledge of healthcare operations, healthcare data, health insurance concepts, and workforce management principles.
Ability to translate business needs into scalable analytical and reporting solutions that drive measurable results.


Why Join Premera?

At Premera, data plays a critical role in improving the health and well-being of our members and communities. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to influence strategic decisions, improve workforce effectiveness, and partner with leaders across the organization to deliver meaningful business outcomes through analytics and insight.

Premera total rewards

Our comprehensive total rewards package provides support, resources, and opportunities to help employees thrive and grow. Our total rewards are more than a collection of perks, they're a reflection of our commitment to your health and well-being. We offer a broad array of rewards including physical, financial, emotional, and community benefits, including:


Medical, vision, and dental coverage with low employee premiums.
Voluntary benefit offerings, including pet insurance for paw parents.
Life and disability insurance.
Retirement programs, including a 401K employer match and, believe it or not, a pension plan that is vested after 3 years of service.
Wellness incentives with a wide range of mental well-being resources for you and your dependents, including counseling services, stress management programs, and mindfulness programs, just to name a few.
Generous paid time off to reenergize.
Looking for continuing education? We have tuition assistance for both undergraduate and graduate degrees.
Employee recognition program to celebrate anniversaries, team accomplishments, and more.


For our hybrid employees, our on-campus model provides flexibility to create your own routine with access to on-site resources, networking opportunities, and team engagement.


Commuter perks make your trip to work less impactful on the environment and your wallet.
Free convenient on-site parking.
Subsidized on-campus cafes make lunchtime connections with colleagues fun and affordable.
Participate in engaging on-site activities such as health and wellness events, coffee connects, disaster preparedness fairs and more.
Our complementary fitness & well-being center offers both in-person and virtual workouts and nutritional counseling.
Need a brain break? Challenge someone to a game of shuffleboard or ping pong while on campus.

Premera seeks to attract and retain the most qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

If you need an accommodation to apply online for positions at Premera, please contact Premera Human Resources via email at careers@premera.com or via phone at 425-918-4785.

$92,400.00 - $157,100.00

Title: Analyst
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential Team Placements Include


Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.


About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do


Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.
Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.


What We Look For


1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.
Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.
Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.


Pay Grade - I

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Title: Business Intelligence Developer
Description:
Job Description

Position Summary:

Husky Health Center at the University of Washington, has an outstanding opportunity for a Business Intelligence Developer to join our team.

About This Opportunity

Reporting to the Assistant Director for Health Informatics & Data Strategy, this position will be responsible for writing and automating reports, developing dashboards, designing and administering surveys, conducting internal assessments and related activities. This position will contribute to related efforts across the UW Division of Student Life and exercise significant ownership and control over its work products and will serve as a subject matter expert and consultant to non-technical colleagues with custom data reporting requirements.

This is a 100% FTE onsite position

Salary range - $6,667 – $8,333 per month

Key Responsibilities

Report and Dashboard Development and Automation (50%)


Design, build, iterate, and automate operational and clinical reports and dashboards using Epic, Power BI, and related data sources and tools
Proactively engage with subject matter experts across a variety of units within the Husky Health Center and broader Student Life Division to understand individual needs and responsively develop solutions
Convert manual/ad hoc extracts into automated, reliable, schedule-driven, version-controlled BI assets (including parameterized and self-service reports)
Develop interactive dashboards in Power BI (or other approved platforms) that translate complex utilization, productivity, patient volume, and financial metrics into actionable views for non-technical stakeholders
Apply best practices for user interface design, readability, and accessibility
Respond to and appropriately triage requests for ad hoc reports
Write and maintain thorough technical documentation and non-technical end-user job aids for all data products
Implement automated data validation procedures and quality monitoring mechanisms


Survey & Assessment (35%)


Design and administer internal assessment surveys supporting operational and strategic goals, to inform needs assessments, evaluate experiences, and more
Apply best practices, ensure methodological rigor, data integrity, and data privacy
Build survey data ingestion and normalization workflows; integrate survey outcomes into broader BI reporting footprints
Produce presentations, summaries and reports for a variety of audiences
Perform statistical analyses to determine the significance of data outputs and identify themes, trends, or other inferential and descriptive summaries for leadership
Identify and apply key performance indicators (KPIs) relevant to strategic requests for data, specifically those pertaining to student success, population health and health outcomes, and operational measures of impact within Husky Health Center and partner units in Student Life


Strategic & Stakeholder Collaboration (15%)


Meet regularly with Husky Health Center and Student Life leaders to refine requirements, prototype solutions, and align deliverables with strategic objectives
Translate business questions into measurable KPIs; recommend data-driven approaches with emphasis on high-automation, low-maintenance solutions


Other Responsibilities


Flexible and resourceful; high degree of professionalism and diplomacy; excellent people skills
Demonstrate initiative, professional judgment, and the ability to work independently and with others, with minimal on-site supervision and without structured practical training
Ability to operate in situations of uncertainty, troubleshoot challenges, and champion projects through completion
Perform other duties as assigned


Required Qualifications

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications.

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Health Informatics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Health Information Management, Industrial Engineering; or Business Administration, Public Health, or Health Administration with quantitative/analytics focus
Two (2) years' experience designing and managing BI dashboards
Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Manager


Additional Qualifications


Experience designing and/or administering surveys, including experience with tools such as Qualtrics or Microsoft Forms
Ability to accomplish all primary job functions without reliance on artificial intelligence tools, including successful completion of a proctored technical assessment as part of the hiring process
Applicants will be asked to present a relevant Business Intelligence deliverable or data product from their personal portfolio or previous experience


Desirable Qualifications


Master’s degree in a listed or related field
Two (2) years of professional experience in a related field
Applied statistical analysis experience in healthcare, higher education, public health, or related fields
Experience with and knowledge of Institutional Review Board (IRB) processes
Demonstrable experience with using scripting/programming languages in task automation and/or data pipelines
Ability to effectively utilize artificial intelligence tools to enhance quality and efficiency
Experience with Epic and Workday data


Typical Working Conditions

Husky Health staff members are considered essential employees and are expected to report to work during UW closures for severe weather, natural disasters, or other emergency conditions.

Work hours: Monday – Friday, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm

Work location: Seattle Campus

Telecommute: This is a 100% onsite position. However, at the discretion of the employer, a hybrid telework arrangement may be approved for up to two remote workdays per week

About Husky Health

Husky Health Center, on the UW Seattle Campus in the Division of Student Life, is an AAAHC-accredited outpatient facility providing high quality health care to a primarily young adult population. As a student-focused clinical unit within the Division of Student Life, we are committed to supporting the health, well-being, and success of UW’s student population. We provide comprehensive, full-spectrum primary and preventive care in over 40,000 patient encounters annually. Our services include Primary and Same Day Care, Physical Therapy, Sports Medicine, OB/GYN and Travel Medicine. We are co-located with an on-site pharmacy and a branch of the UW Medicine Laboratory, and we work collaboratively with campus partners like the UW Counseling Center and Student Life’s health promotion and prevention services to provide holistic support that helps students thrive throughout their Husky experience.

UW Medicine Department of Analytics for Quality, Population Health and Value has an outstanding opportunity for a Business Systems Analyst.

WORK SCHEDULE

Department Description

The UW Medicine Department of Analytics for Quality, Population Health and Value supports a wide range of data collection, analysis, and reporting activities across UW Medicine. UW Medicine’s Chief Quality Office, Department of Analytics for Quality, Population Health and Value is a shared services organization that supports all of UW Medicine. Value Based Analytics is responsible for providing analytics support in value-based contracting by facilitating data workflows and creating tools and reporting that facilitate and support strategic decision making and internal goal setting and tracking.

This position reports to the UW Medicine Director of Analytics for Quality, Population Health, and Value and plays an integral role in data management, reporting process improvement, and operational support. The position works closely across UW Medicine’s healthcare system, collaborating with population health affiliated departments, contracting, IT Services and Epic departments, UW Medicine stakeholders, and external organizations.

POSITION HIGHLIGHTS


15 days of vacation your first year – Also, 12 days of sick time, 1 personal holiday, and 11 paid holidays each year
100% matching, 100% immediately vesting 403(b)


Primary Job Responsibilities


Provides data programming and analytics in support of physician and system leadership, encompassing quality, financial, and utilization reporting, population health tools, value measurement, and ad hoc analyses
Apply expert-level SQL database development skills, including SSRS/SSIS and other Microsoft platform technologies, to deliver high-quality reporting solutions and dashboards
Designs, codes, tests, and maintains BI/reporting and analytics objects using industry best practices
Develops, cleanses, prepares, validates, and distributes reports and files from multiple data sources
Ensures established requirements are met and that coordination of timely reporting is completed
Develops, manages, and maintains requirements and specification documents (e.g., design documents, report inventory, promotion requests)
Creates tools for understanding populations, measuring value and impact, and other ad hoc analytical purposes
Drives operational effectiveness through stakeholder communication, cross-functional collaboration, process design, and governance activities that sustain the Value-Based Analytics program
Designs, implements, and optimizes standard reporting and operational procedures for Value-Based Analytics, Quality Assurance
Maintains the integrity of data infrastructure through workflow documentation, process optimization, and alignment with ACO and value-based care best practices.


Requirements


Bachelor of Science degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science / Data Analytics; equivalent experience can substitute for the degree requirement


5+ years' experience include the following


Advanced SQL, SSIS, SSRS, ETL, data modeling, and EDW design, experience working with large volumes of data, and proficiency with BI and reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau)
Healthcare industry experience with in-depth knowledge of healthcare data and workflow
Advanced analytic skills and the ability to independently analyze problems, present options, and implement solutions
Demonstrated skills in the area of business system analysis, operational support, and process improvement


Desired Qualifications Include


Lean/Six Sigma experience
Project Management experience
UW Medicine experience

UW Medicine is Washington’s only health system that includes a top-rated medical school and an internationally recognized research center. UW Medicine’s mission is to improve the health of the public by advancing medical knowledge, providing outstanding primary and specialty care to the people of the region, and preparing tomorrow’s physicians, scientists and other health professionals.
