Title: Senior Business Analytics Specialist
Description:
Overview

Commercial Engineering & AI (CEAI) partners closely with stakeholders to accelerate the transformation of Microsoft’s commercial business into a frontier organization. We bring together AI‑native engineering, modern platforms, and deep commercial insight to reimagine how work gets done - at scale and with impact. Our mission is to unlock new ways of operating through intelligent systems while creating the conditions for our teams to do the most meaningful work of their careers. If you’re excited to build, experiment, and shape the future of commercial execution with AI at the core, we invite you to apply.

The Business Intelligence Center of Excellence (BI COE) is responsible for delivering AI-first, enterprise-scale analytics that power data-driven decision-making across Microsoft’s Partner and Seller ecosystem. Our mission is to transform fragmented data into a single, trusted source of truth, enabling actionable insights, automation, and intelligent experiences.

The successful candidate for this role will lead the Security BI, data analytics & insights for the team globally, supporting leadership as well as Corporate & field teams, driving next level intelligent insights and predictive analytics around the business, led and scaled through AI across multi-modal interfaces. This role will also partner directly with the other members of our BI COE Team to deliver integrated, AI-led insights solutions, not proliferating or creating duplicative, isolated, or “more” interfaces in isolation.

You will play a role in shaping the next generation of AI-powered BI solutions, leveraging Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and semantic modelling to deliver scalable, high-performance, and governed analytics experiences.

Responsibilities


Interpret complex business problems and requirements, translating them into capability needs, then building/ enabling AI-ready semantic layers that support natural language querying, automation, and predictive insights to enable AI-driven insights, Copilot scenarios, and intelligent analytics experiences leveraging Fabric, Power BI, GHCP, Cowork, CLI and more to solve these business problems
Enable AI-led predictive analytics capabilities and data insights for sellers, managers, and leadership to understand actionable insights and how to best use it to achieve measurable results. (What they need to know, Why they need to know it, and What they need to do about it)
Integrate and work with BI COE team members and stakeholders to identify, understand, and prioritize business and information needs
Utilize/deliver standardized tools and reporting which enable speed, efficiency, and scale in the business to accelerate the standardized business operations vs. isolated, disconnected, or duplicative solutions
Locate and define new process improvement opportunities and solve for root cause business issues to locate and correct problems
Drive adoption of AI-first principles across BI COE analytics and reporting solutions.


Impact & Outcomes


Deliver a unified, AI-powered analytics platform for Security insights
Enable single source of truth (OSOT) across data solutions
Reduce time-to-insight through optimized semantic models and self-service BI
Drive adoption of Fabric + AI-first BI strategy across BI COE


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 3+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Finance, Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 4+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualificaitons


8+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, or Analytics
Experience in:
Semantic modeling (Power BI / Tabular / DAX)
Data architecture and dimensional modeling (star schema, OSOT principles)
Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Direct Lake, pipelines, OneLake)
Power BI (dataset optimization, reporting, governance)
Experience building analytics solutions at scale.
Experience with data governance, security, and compliance framework.
Experience in Microsoft Sales ecosystem.
Experience with AI-driven BI scenarios (Copilot, predictive analytics, data agents).
Experience integrating multiple enterprise datasets into unified reporting models.
Experience operating in matrixed, cross-functional environments and influence stakeholders.
Storytelling skills with experience to translating data into business impact.

There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $137,600 - $222,600 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:

Title: Senior Business Operations Associate
Description:
About DAT

DAT Freight & Analytics is an award-winning employer of choice and a next-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com

Application Deadline: 10/1/2026

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Senior Associate to help redefine how BizOps gets done at DAT. This hybrid role sits at the intersection of strategy, business intelligence, and applied AI: you'll deliver the insights leaders rely on for strategic decisions, while designing and deploying AI agents that scale and extend our analytics capabilities.

You'll partner with stakeholders across the business to surface high-value problems, develop and report on KPIs that inform target priorities and team performance, and build agentic workflows that turn recurring tasks into self-service tools. With each analysis, you'll ask the natural follow-up: what can an agent do to complement this next time?

This is a high-impact IC role with meaningful visibility at the leadership level. Agents are rapidly transforming internal BizOps functions, and you'll shape how we incorporate them into ours.

What You’ll Do

Develop and operate agentic solutions to traditional business intelligence responsibilities:


Strategic Oversight: Support leadership in developing and executing business strategies. Assist with setting organizational goals, tracking progress, and ensuring alignment across departments.
KPI development & ownership: Develop and own the key performance indicators that leadership uses to measure business health, ensuring metrics stay aligned with evolving strategic priorities.
Strategic & ad-hoc analysis: Partner with stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Product, and Marketing to scope analytical questions, deliver deep-dive insights, and translate findings into clear recommendations that drive business decisions.
BI development & reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and data models that make key business metrics accessible, accurate, and trustworthy across the organization.
Agent design & deployment: Design, prototype, and deploy AI agents that augment workflows, including agents that monitor metrics for anomalies, generate narrative summaries, answer ad-hoc data questions, and automate routine reporting cycles.
Performance monitoring & iteration: Track how deployed agents and dashboards perform in the wild, gather feedback from end users, and continuously refine outputs to improve accuracy, usefulness, and adoption over time.
Automation opportunity identification: Spot repetitive analytical tasks across the organization and evaluate which are best suited for agentic automation versus traditional BI tooling, balancing impact, complexity, and risk.
Data quality & integrity: Partner with Data Engineering to validate source data, surface inconsistencies, and ensure that both human-facing analyses and agent outputs are built on a trustworthy foundation.
Documentation & enablement: Document agent capabilities, limitations, and intended use cases so stakeholders know when to trust outputs and when to escalate or verify.


The Skills And Experience You’ll Bring


3-5 years in high-growth startups, strategy consulting, business intelligence, data analytics or specialized BizOps roles. Series A–C experience is a significant plus.
Strong SQL and Excel skills. You can independently get to the data you need and build the models behind your own reporting.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
Daily working fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day work; comfortable writing clear prompts, evaluating outputs, debugging agent behavior, and knowing when human judgment must override automation.
Growth mindset and a willingness to work hard; this will be a high-effort, high-reward type role for those excited about building business leverage with AI.


Nice to Haves:


Experience deploying AI agents or LLM-powered tools, including thinking through evaluation, monitoring, and failure modes.
Experience in logistics, fintech, marketplaces, or B2B SaaS businesses.


Why DAT?

DAT is an award winning employer of choice.

For starters, we have a hybrid work environment, but we also know what makes a great workplace. We have a time-tested and resolute set of operating values predicated on integrity, mutual respect, open communication, and executing with excellence. These values inform our strategic vision as much as any one of our products does. We’ve been an employer of choice in the Portland metropolitan area for four decades, and within one year of opening our Denver office, DAT was #26 on Built In Colorado’s 100 Best Places to Work In Colorado.


Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and AD&D insurance
Parental Leave
Flexible Time Off
An additional 10 holidays of paid time off per calendar year
401k matching (immediately vested)
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Short- and Long-term disability sick leave
Flexible Spending Accounts
Health Savings Accounts
Employee Assistance Program
Additional programs - Employee Referral, Internal Recognition, and Wellness
Free TriMet transit pass (Beaverton Office)
Competitive salary and benefits package
Work on impactful projects in a cutting-edge environment
Collaborative and supportive team culture
Opportunity to make a real difference in the trucking industry
Employee Resource Groups


For Washington-based candidates, in compliance with the Washington State Pay Transparency Law, the salary range for this role is $141,000 - $190,000. DAT considers factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education and training, core skills, internal equity, and market and business elements when extending an offer.

DAT embraces the value of a diverse workforce, and believes it is a core strength of our company that we encourage those values in every DAT employee, at every level of our organization, regardless of tenure or rank. We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Title: Public Defense Research and Data Analyst
Description:
Summary

This recruitment will be used to fill a Career Service position and to create an eligibility pool to fill vacancies that may occur within the next six (6) months.

The King County Department of Public Defense (DPD) is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking individual to serve as our Public Defense Research and Data and Analyst. This position is responsible for carrying out technical support, data, and system configuration tasks of moderate complexity as directed, exercising sound judgment in day-to-day execution to prioritize assigned requests, identify appropriate solutions, and determine when issues require escalation or coordination. The position works across multiple systems and functional areas, including case management, databases, reporting, website and information management platforms, and related SaaS applications. Working under the direction of the Director of Data Analytics, and in close collaboration with the Department's eDefender Administrator as a technical thought partner, the Research and Data Analyst supports process and system improvements, assists with the implementation and testing of enhancements, and provides accurate and timely data and technical products in response to operational, policy, strategic planning, and programmatic needs. The position regularly collaborates with department staff, leadership, technical partners, and other key interested partners. The successful candidate should also be aware of significant national trends in public defense.

This recruitment may be used to fill a Career Service (CS), Term-Limited Temporary (TLT), or Special Duty Assignment (SDA) Research and Data Analyst position, and to establish an eligibility list for vacancies that may occur within the next six months. TLT and SDAs may last up to 12 months and may be extended or end early based on business needs.

The Department’s Mission Statement

The King County Department of Public Defense represents indigent adults and children facing a loss of liberty. Our department is an independent voice that advocates for their objectives, interests, and dignity.

DPD provides high quality legal representation to indigent clients in felonies, misdemeanors, juvenile defense, family defense (dependency cases), involuntary commitment (mental illness), and sex offender commitment proceedings.

DPD advocates to reduce the harm and reach of the criminal and civil legal systems that restrict our clients’ liberty, and advances policy reforms to reduce systemic racism. We strive to create a flexible workplace culture that is inclusive, respectful, and supportive, premised on a shared anti-oppression framework. To learn more about DPD, visit our website.

Job Duties

Essential job functions and duties include but are not limited to the following:


Provide day-to-day leadership and management of the department’s research, data and analytics operations and resources. Make critical decisions related to technology procurement and implementation, and coordinate the evaluation, deployment, and management of current and future technologies.
Oversee requirements, technical development, selection, testing, deployment, training, and operational support for the department’s information systems and applications.
Build and maintain strong collaboration with end users and leadership to ensure information system and application needs are met or exceeded.
Ensure research, data, and analytics operations comply with applicable laws, regulations, King County standards, and security requirements; establish and maintain effective governance structures supporting data privacy and security.
Lead the research, collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative data to assess DPDs client programs and services.
In collaboration with Director’s Office leadership, help define assessment, research and evaluation priorities that support data driven decision-making and organizational improvement.
Oversee the development and maintenance of information systems, applications and data collection activities.
Lead the data and analytics team to provide high-level in-house expertise on cutting-edge public defense services.
Advance fair and equitable data practices that reduce burden, uncover inequities, and work collaboratively with department leadership to increase access to public data whenever possible.
Serve as the department’s liaison to internal and external partners on data presentations, as well as assessment and evaluation findings and approaches.
Manage multiple ongoing projects in an environment of changing priorities, time constraints, and budget limitations; identify and determine scope of work for sustainability of new and existing projects.


Experience, Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills

Public Defense Research and Data Analyst duties and essential functions may include:


Provide technical support to Department staff on software applications and case management systems, including triaging, prioritizing, and resolving support tickets submitted by non-technical staff; distinguish break/fix issues from enhancement requests, training needs, and non-system requests, and escalate as appropriate.
Ability to travel throughout King County in a timely manner.
Independently manage complex configuration, business-rule development, and system integration work within the Department’s eDefender case management system (part of the eSeries/eCourt suite), coordinating with the eDefender Administrator to align on shared system architecture and priorities.
Independently develop and troubleshoot business rules and configuration logic within eDefender, in coordination with the eDefender Administrator on shared system standards.
Independently write and troubleshoot complex SQL queries (T-SQL/PL-SQL) to support eDefender configuration, data extraction, and reporting needs.
Test configurations, updates, and enhancements within the Department's SaaS case management solution to verify functionality before deployment.
Develop and deliver in-person training sessions for Department staff on software applications, and create and maintain training documentation, user guides, and process documentation.
Manage and maintain the Department's website using Sitecore, including content updates, page maintenance, and troubleshooting.
Assist in the management, organization, and governance of documents and records within Office 365 and SharePoint, including folder structures, permissions, and version control support.
Query, clean, and standardize data from the Department's in-house case assignment and management databases to support accurate reporting and analysis.
Independently analyze complex ad-hoc data requests and deliver actionable insights directly to Department leadership to inform policy and resource decisions, often under deadline.
Support colleagues in building technical proficiency and confidence using Department data systems and software applications.
Other duties, as assigned.


Experience, Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills


Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Criminology, Sociology, Anthropology, Public Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field, and two or more years of relevant experience in technical support, systems configuration, or data analysis; OR any equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the work.
Have working knowledge of SQL (T-SQL or PL-SQL) sufficient to write and troubleshoot queries for configuration, reporting, and data extraction purposes.
Have experience with, or the ability to learn, scripting/business-rule languages such as Groovy or Velocity, or comparable logic-based configuration languages, to support case management system customization.
Have demonstrated experience providing technical support to non-technical staff, including triaging and resolving software support requests in a professional, customer-focused manner.
Have experience with, or the ability to quickly learn, eDefender or a similar eSeries-based case management system (eCourt, eProsecutor, eSupervision), including its forms, workflow, and search configuration tools.
Are comfortable working with SaaS technology solutions and have experience testing configurations, enhancements, or integrations of low to moderate complexity.
Have experience creating training materials and delivering training to staff with varying levels of technical proficiency.
Have experience with, or the ability to quickly learn, Sitecore or similar content management systems for website administration.
Have experience optimizing and maintaining documents and information within Office 365 and SharePoint, including organizational structure and access management.
Have demonstrated experience interacting with and analyzing raw data, including cleaning and standardizing data for reporting purposes.
Can interact with a broad range of stakeholders — including staff, leadership, and external partners — to understand needs, translate them into workable solutions, and communicate technical information clearly to non-technical audiences.
Have strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple, sometimes competing, priorities to produce accurate and timely work products.
Have a basic understanding of project management principles and the ability to support projects of varying size and complexity as a technical resource.
Apply a lens of equity and social justice in their work and demonstrate inclusive behaviors as a team member.
Demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with individuals from diverse backgrounds and technical skill levels.


Desired Qualifications:


Demonstrated experience working in criminal justice, legal services, or public defense settings.
Demonstrated experience working in a unionized environment.


Supplemental Information

King County offers great benefits, to include a pension plan, holidays, transit pass, plus training and education opportunities to promote growth and development. Our focus is to provide our employees with work life balance.

Completed King County application.
A current/chronological resume
Cover letter detailing your background and what you can bring to the Department of Public Defense.

Note: Special Duty opportunities are only open to current King County career service employees that have completed their initial probation. Special Duty applicants must have approval from their current supervisor to accept an assignment.

Pay Upon Special Duty Placement: current employees selected for special duty will be compensated based upon the provisions of the King County Code/Personnel Guidelines for their base position.

The selection process may include evaluation of application materials and supplemental questions, interviewing, references, a personnel file review going back the last three (3) years, and if applicable a background check. You must completely fill out the application with your relevant education and work experience and attach the required documents to your application.

WORK SCHEDULE AND LOCATIONThe Data and Analytics team works in a hybrid model, with an onsite minimum of three (3) days per week. During the probationary period, employees are required to work onsite four (4) days per week. The ratio of telecommuting to onsite work will be dependent on business needs and is subject to change. The primary onsite location for this position is the Dexter Horton Building, 710 Second Avenue, Seattle.

This position is exempt from the overtime provisions of the federal Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA). As an exempt employee, you are expected to work the hours necessary to satisfactorily perform your job and will not be eligible for overtime pay or compensatory time.

Title: Data Analyst 3 - Anaplan Model Builder
Description:
Job Description

The Data Analyst 3 - Anaplan Model Builder will be a member of the S&OP/S&OE technical enablement team supporting NCoder, Nordstrom's network volume planning product within Supply Chain Network Throughput Planning. NCoder transforms cross-functional enterprise plans and forecasts into warehouse-level volume plans across six connected Anaplan models — Inbound, DC Outbound, Store Inbound, Returns, and Task, staged through a central DataHub — informing operational resource decisions across Nordstrom's distribution centers, fulfillment centers, and stores. The Data Analyst 3 - Anaplan Model Builder will own the design, build, and maintenance of NCoder's Anaplan models, partnering closely with Supply Chain planners and engineering to keep the platform scalable, well-governed, and aligned to evolving business needs.

A day in the life…


Design, build, and maintain modules, dashboards, and calculation logic across NCoder's Anaplan models (Inbound, DC Outbound, Store Inbound, Returns, Task)
Partner with Supply Chain planners and product/engineering leads to translate volume-planning requirements into scalable Anaplan model designs
Manage and troubleshoot data connections between Anaplan and DataHub, the central staging layer that receives all external data from BigQuery via Airflow import DAGs
Maintain the model sequence and dependencies across Workstream 1 (Inbound → DC Outbound → Store Inbound) and Workstream 2 (Returns, running independently), both feeding the downstream Task model
Optimize models for performance and usability as planning cadence, data volume, and new workflows (e.g., fulfillment, last mile) come online
Document model logic, data flows, and business rules to support governance, onboarding, and audit needs
Partner with data engineering on BigQuery source/destination tables and Airflow DAG issues that affect model refreshes
Train and support Supply Chain planners and downstream consumers (Warehouse Ops, Transportation, Store Ops, SC Finance) on using NCoder models
Leverage AI-assisted tools such as Claude Code and Claude Desktop to accelerate model documentation, testing, and workflow automation


You own this if you have…


Degree in Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
3-5+ years building and maintaining Anaplan models; Anaplan Certified Model Builder (Level 3) or equivalent preferred
Strong understanding of Anaplan architecture: modules, lists, hierarchies, actions, dashboards, hub-and-spoke model design
Experience with data integration/ETL — BigQuery, Airflow-orchestrated pipelines, or similar
Comfortable with SQL for querying source and destination tables
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into structured technical model designs
Supply chain domain experience preferred (DC/FC/store operations, inbound/outbound logistics, returns, or labor/task planning)
Comfortable presenting to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Pay offers are dependent on the location, as well as job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Title: Principal Power Resource Planning Analyst
Description:
Position Description

Tacoma Power Management is seeking a talented and driven individual to join its Resource Planning & Analytics team. As a Principal Power Resource Planning Analyst, you will help navigate Tacoma Power’s path into the future. This is a time of unprecedented change for electric utilities. New technologies, clean energy policies and changing markets are shifting the energy landscape and presenting new opportunities and challenges for utilities. Despite these changes, one thing remains constant: Tacoma Power will need to make sure it can keep the lights on and keep rates low for customers. Your work will be instrumental in ensuring that we can continue to provide customers with clean, low-cost and reliable power for years to come, regardless of what the future holds.

This position leads key modeling and analysis efforts that inform Tacoma Power’s long-term resource planning work, with particular focus area in demand-side resource economics, power market dynamics and customer demand modeling.

Please note: The Resource Planning & Analytics team currently has two positions open. This position is at the principal level, while the other is at the senior level (Senior Power Resource Planning Analyst). You must apply to each position individually to be considered for both.

In This Role, You Will


Model: Collaborate in the development, operation and refinement of the models we use to assess the benefits and costs of key long-term resource planning decisions under various scenarios of the future.
Analyze: Analyze and interpret data and modeling outputs and provide thoughtful explanation of results.
Advise: Participate in the development of resource planning recommendations and serve as subject matter expert within areas of expertise and provide technical guidance and support to team and staff in other groups.
Collaborate: Work closely with the Resource Planning & Analytics team to coordinate modeling assumptions and approaches and with other groups throughout the utility on specific projects.


Qualifications

Minimum Education*

Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, economics, statistics, mathematics or directly related field

Minimum Experience*

4 years of experience in statistical analysis, data modeling or data analytics including 1 year prior at senior, lead and/or supervisory level


Relevant education and experience may substitute for one another on a year-for-year basis


Licensing, Certifications And Other Requirements

Some positions may require individuals to complete annual training and pass a comprehensive personal risk assessment (background check) prior to employment and every five years thereafter as required by federal regulatory requirements (NERC-CIP)

Desired Qualifications


Strong investigative and exploratory skills
Experience with script-based data analysis tools (Python preferred)
Ability to present technical information clearly and concisely
Advanced degree in Economics, Finance, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering or related field
Previous experience successfully leading analysis projects
Knowledge of power system economics, wholesale energy markets and/or energy policy


Selection Process & Supplemental Information

Apply

All interested individuals must apply online and attach a resume and cover letter that includes major responsibilities and accomplishments related to the position.

Appointment is subject to references and passing a background check.

A Commitment to Equity & Diversity

At the City of Tacoma, we're on a mission to make our workforce as diverse and inclusive as the community we serve. We actively seek out candidates from a wide range of backgrounds and cultures. Join our team at the City of Tacoma and help us build a more vibrant, inclusive, and equitable community for all.

If you have a less traditional background, we want to hear about your transferrable skills and experience. We value a variety of perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the table.

Tacoma Power

Tacoma Power is an almost 100% hydroelectric, municipally-owned public power utility, located in Tacoma. We serve approximately 180,000 customers as one of the three operating divisions of Tacoma Public Utilities, alongside Tacoma Water and Tacoma Rail. As one of the most livable, walkable cities in the country, you'll find that Tacoma is a great fit for all interests with places to bike, run, hike, and explore, the perks of a big city, and the charm of a small town.

Compensation & Benefits

Pay Details:

Annual Salary: $122,096.00 - $171,953.60

Employee Benefits | City of Tacoma

For technical difficulties using the Neogov system, call the applicant support line at 1-855-524-5627 between 6:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Pacific Standard Time. This will allow us to assist you before the job announcement closes.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Description

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

Realtor.com is a two-sided platform helping match the consumers on our site and apps to our paying customers. The Data Science & Analytics team at Realtor.com provides trusted data and insights to optimize every aspect of consumer/customer experience and to drive the company’s commercial performance.

Avail Realtor.com is a fast-growing platform transforming how independent landlords and tenants manage the rental experience. Built with the spirit of a startup and backed by the scale and stability of a leading digital real estate company, Avail provides a complete suite of tools, resources, and education to help landlords manage their properties with confidence and professionalism. As part of the Avail team, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact – shaping the future of this rapidly expanding brand and helping to reimagine the rental industry for millions across the U.S..

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst with a strong background in business intelligence and strategic analytics to help shape the future of Avail. As a trusted partner to the Avail leadership team, you will be the vital link between complex data and pivotal business moves, striving to enable and empower data-driven decision making across the business.

In this role, you will analyze large and complex data sets, define and track business KPIs, build automated reporting solutions, conduct robust analyses, generate actionable insights, and deliver clear recommendations that inform critical decisions across strategy, product, marketing, and operations.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented analytics expert, a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, and a team player who excels in cross-functional collaborations, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and driven by a desire to make things better.

What You'll Do


Partner closely with Avail business stakeholders to understand/clarify needs and requirements, and translate them into analytical problems.
If the required data is not available, work with the team to identify the right data sources, and build analytical data layers in collaboration with the data engineering partner.
Independently conduct end-to-end data analytical work from data collection, ETL, analysis, to the delivery of insights and recommendations.
Serve as Avail’s Business Intelligence expert and own KPI development, measurement, tracking, and reporting. Closely monitor KPIs and carry out deep-dive analysis to explain changes and trends, and surface areas of opportunities.
Own and run regular business performance reporting, and actively contribute analytics-related content to business reviews and other reports.
Build automated reports and dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Mixpanel, etc.
Build and grow adoption of self-service solutions that empower stakeholders to access data and insights, and hence accelerate data-driven decision making.
Conduct market and competitor analysis using a variety of internal and external data sources.
Work with Avail leadership team on strategic initiatives and planning, providing analytical support on financial modeling, forecast, opportunity sizing, and so on.


What You Bring


Bachelor’s degree, ideally in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
6+ years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role.
SQL proficiency is a must, with 6+ years of experience.
Proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets for quick reporting and ad hoc analysis.
Strong capability to work with complex data sets and perform EDA, descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analyses.
Experience with cloud-based data environments such as Snowflake and AWS.
Significant experience creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Mixpanel, Power BI, or similar tools.
Proven experience using data and analytics to drive revenue and other business KPIs, and doing so in a proactive manner by actively seeking to identify opportunities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to diverse technical and business audiences at different levels.
Experience in collaborating with cross-functional partners.
Experience managing multiple priorities, responding to urgent data requests, and adapting to changing business needs and priorities.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
Proficiency with a scripting language such as Python or R.
Experience in the tech sector, especially marketplace or property tech.


How We Work

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.

How We Reward You

Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to:


Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage
Family forming benefits
13 Paid Holidays
Flexible Time Off
8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off
Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3.5% company match
Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non-degreed programs
1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions
Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program
Free snacks and refreshments in each office location


Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com®

Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow.

Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0247289

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to the Navy to understand their data and support Fleet readiness.

As a client-facing data analyst embedded with a DOW client, you’ll work closely with our customers to understand their data questions and then dig into their data-rich environments and tools to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise the client on what the information means by developing decision-making support visualization products and dashboards to help translate data into recommendations. You will use automation tools and scripts to streamline data processing and reporting.

What You'll Work On:


Provide clear, timely data analysis and trend insights for leadership in a fast paced environment and preparing written analysis.
Analyze data across various subject areas to develop a complete data picture for non-technical leadership and clients.
Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data is accessible and organized to support analysis, trend forecasting and alerting needs.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies, and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, interpretation, evaluation, and analysis of large data sets.
Establish quantitative/qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive decision-making.
Create visualizations and dashboards, such as graphs, tables, and maps, across multiple platforms to communicate findings effectively.
Produce recurring and rapid-turnaround reports and analysis, including responses to high-priority leadership and congressional requests, across multiple office branches to ensure a holistic understanding and facilitate informed decision-making.
Engage directly with clients to understand their evolving needs, communicate findings clearly, and provide actionable recommendations. Adapt to client feedback and requests, fostering strong professional relationships and supporting informed decision-making at all organizational levels.



Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


3+ years of experience in data analysis or data visualization
Experience in quantitative data analysis, performance measurement, data cleansing, metrics evaluation, and applied research
Experience executing projects and tasks independently, including large-scale initiatives
Experience leading discussions about data products, sources, and projects with executive leadership
Ability to identify and analyze data sets to meet customer requirements and translate complex findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences
Ability to be organized, multi-task, and respond quickly to urgent requests
Ability to work closely with executive leadership on large data projects and communicate effectively via email and phone
Secret clearance
Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Law, Engineering, Social Sciences, Physical Science, Applied Science, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics or Management



Nice If You Have:


3+ years of experience with data analysis or data visualization with Power BI, Excel, or Tableau preferred
Experience with data querying and manipulation using SQL or similar tools



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.



Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams

Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
At SimPL Freight Solutions, we simplify transportation for companies that move a lot of freight but don’t want the headache of managing it all themselves. We step in as their transportation team - coordinating shipments, managing carrier relationships, tracking performance, and improving how everything runs behind the scenes.

Our customers range from large manufacturers to high-volume distributors across industries like automotive, building materials, food, and packaging. No matter the industry, the goal is the same: keep freight moving smoothly, efficiently, and without surprises.

We pride ourselves on being proactive, responsive, and accountable - anticipating issues, communicating clearly, and continuously finding better ways to deliver results.

Position Overview

Are you naturally curious, comfortable working with numbers, and always asking why? SimPL Freight Solutions is looking for a Junior Data Analyst who is excited to turn data into meaningful business insights.

This is an early-career opportunity designed for a recent graduate or someone beginning their analytics career. You will join a growing analytics department within a fast-growing logistics company, where your work will support real decisions involving clients, pricing, operations, and company strategy.

You will not be expected to know everything on day one. We are looking for someone with strong analytical foundations, attention to detail, and the drive to learn. You will receive guidance from experienced team members while gradually taking ownership of dashboards, reports, models, and improvement projects.

What You'll Do


Collect, clean, and validate client, prospect, pricing, and operational data
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Excel, Power BI, Salesforce, and other tools
Analyze freight patterns, pricing, service performance, and business trends
Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences
Support pricing projects, client strategy reviews, sales presentations, and operational decisions
Partner with operations, sales, pricing, technology, and leadership on cross-functional projects
Identify data quality issues and help improve the accuracy and consistency of information across systems
Document and improve recurring reporting and analytical processes
Explore opportunities to automate workflows and use approved AI tools more effectively
Present findings and explain how they may affect clients or the business


What You'll Have The Opportunity To Learn


How analytics supports pricing, transportation, customer service, and business strategy
How to work with large, real-world datasets that may not always be perfectly organized
How to design dashboards and reports that business leaders actually use
How to translate a business question into a structured analysis
How to communicate findings to clients, managers, and company leadership
How to take an analytics project from an initial question through a final recommendation
How a growing analytics department develops its tools, processes, and standards


Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
0-2 years of relevant experience; internships, co-ops, academic projects, and related coursework are welcome
Coursework or project experience involving data cleaning, analysis, visualization, or reporting


Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities


Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and charts
Exposure to Power BI or another data visualization tool preferred; Salesforce experience is a plus
Exposure to SQL, data modeling, or database concepts through coursework or practical experience preferred
Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skills
Foundational data analysis and critical-thinking skills, with a willingness to learn
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to explain findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Collaborative, dependable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities


We Offer


A competitive salary + bonus opportunities
Career growth, development, and advancement opportunities
Excellent benefits including:
Medical, Dental and Vision Insurances
Life and Disability Insurances
Company 401K plan with a company match
15 PTO days and 9 paid holidays

Core Values


Figure it out, Make it happen
Passion & Grit
Results Matter
Integrity
Teamwork


Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.

Employment is based on individual merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. We value a diverse workforce that encompasses a wide range of perspectives, skills, and abilities.

We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

At Sonatype, we empower developers with best in class tools to build secure, high-quality software at scale. Our mission is to create a world where software is always secure and developers can innovate without fear. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we are pioneers in software supply chain management, open source security, and DevSecOps.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you will transform complex product datasets into actionable insights, build scalable analytics infrastructure, mentor associate-level analysts, and drive data-informed product decisions.

What You’ll Do


Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.
Analytics & Data Modeling: Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data modeling, dashboard creation, and KPI development. Deliver high-accuracy analyses independently across various product initiatives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

2025 Best DevSecOps Solution by DevOps Dozen
Visionary in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Application Security Testing
2025 DEVIES Award to our SBOM Manager new product for its innovation and impact in developer technology

2022 Tech Ascension Best DevOps Security Solution Award
2022 NVCT Cyber Company of the Year
Company Wellness days - We shut down company operations during some days of the year (5 in total) to enable all employees to pursue personal growth and enjoy much-needed and deserved additional rest.
Paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO)

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Description

About Us

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a best in class, seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

Position Overview

We are looking for a meticulous Senior Data Analyst with exceptional skills in data analytics and reporting to join our team. This role will serve as a vital link between our business intelligence team, commercial, and client success departments. The Senior Data Analyst will collaborate closely with both internal and client-facing teams to ensure seamless alignment across all analytics initiatives, performance measurement, and key insights. Reporting directly to the Executive Director of Data Strategy, this position is an integral part of the iBIDADS team.

Data Management & Analytics Support


Build, develop, and maintain datasets to support automated reporting solutions and program performance measurement, ensuring alignment with established SLAs.
Support commercial teams with data needs for performance reviews, business planning activities, and newly onboarded business.
Conduct ad hoc analysis to investigate and resolve program issues, providing critical support during QBR, Business Planning, and Launch Execution.
Manage third-party data integration and analysis, including shipping analytics and return-to-sender reconciliation processes.


Program Performance Analytics


Design and implement internal and client-facing program performance datasets, tracking and analyzing key SLA measurements and program KPIs.
Co-develop dashboards that visualize program performance trends, providing data-driven insights to client-facing teams and internal operational support.
Collaborate with both internal operations and client-facing BI teams to ensure consistent metrics and reporting.
Provide data-driven insights to the commercial and internal teams


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with internal and customer-facing BI departments on healthcare analytics initiatives, supporting the internal operations excellence team and commercial team with key performance insights.
Ensure consistent data definitions and metrics across both BI functions, contributing to monetization opportunities through consulting and data products.
Work closely with Product Engineering to ensure product features, enhancements, and changes are reflected in the datasets


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure accuracy, reliability, and security of all performance data, implementing data validation processes and quality control measures.
Document data lineage and maintain data dictionaries, collaborating with stakeholders to define business rules and metrics.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to continuously improve data management and analytics processes.


Requirements

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in data analysis, with at least 3 years focused on healthcare reporting.
Advanced skills in SQL and Python, with experience in database management.
Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Domo, or similar.
Strong understanding of healthcare metrics and reporting requirements.
Experience supporting commercial and operations teams with program performance and identification of opportunities.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Deep passion for data, analytics, and a natural curiosity to explore and extract key insights.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in the healthcare industry.
Proficiency in R for data manipulation.
Knowledge of data warehouse concepts and ETL processes.
Understanding of SLA management and performance metrics.
Experience working in dual-focused BI environments (internal and client-facing).
Familiarity with pharmacy management systems and logistics data.
Experience with data transfer agreements, data use agreements, and third-party data integration.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms.


Personal Attributes


Natural curiosity about data and its business implications.
Strong desire to track and improve program performance.
Can-do attitude with a passion for solving complex problems.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Excellent communication skills to translate technical findings to business stakeholders.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Team player willing to go the extra mile to support organizational goals.
Adaptable and responsive during high-pressure periods like launches, business planning, and quarterly reporting.
Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends.


What Success Looks Like


The commercial team consistently receives accurate, timely data for program management and performance.
Client-facing teams leverage insights to enhance customer relationships and drive business growth.
SLAs are consistently met for all reporting requirements, ensuring high standards of service.
New programs are seamlessly integrated into reporting and data systems.
Continuous improvement of data processes and reporting efficiency is achieved.
Seamless collaboration between internal and client-facing BI functions is maintained.
Operational metrics are effectively tracked and analyzed to drive commercial success and program performance.
Data sources are effectively integrated and governed, ensuring data quality and reliability.
Data security and privacy are maintained, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
Innovation and staying updated with industry trends are prioritized to maintain a competitive edge.
User satisfaction and feedback are actively sought and incorporated to continuously improve data solutions.


Employment Classification

Status: Full-time

FLSA: Exempt

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Gifthealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you do not meet every requirement but still feel you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply!

Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Data Analytics Senior Analyst is responsible for analyzing, preparing, and presenting data to support executive decision-making, project reporting, and operational performance tracking. This role focuses on developing structured reporting, dashboards, and data solutions while continuously improving data collection, quality, and efficiency. The position collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality insights and scalable reporting capabilities.

Key Responsibilities


Analyse, prepare data, and create reports for executive and project-level stakeholders
Prepare data, KPIs, and metrics for executive reports and presentations
Create various reports and dashboards for project management and executive reporting
Design report layouts with clear, high-level summaries, KPIs, and graphical presentations
Review existing data collection methods and identify continuous improvement opportunities
Develop and maintain tables, templates, trackers, and structured data models
Implement automation in data collection and reporting processes
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and readiness for reporting
Identify trends, patterns, and insights from structured and unstructured data
Support cross-functional teams with reporting and analytical needs
Develop and enhance business intelligence solutions and dashboards
Apply data transformation, cleansing, and standardization techniques
Continuously improve reporting processes for speed, quality, and efficiency


Qualifications


Minimum 8–10+ years of experience in data management and analysis
Strong experience with databases; relational databases preferred
Strong ability to summarize and interpret data and recognize trends and patterns
Experience with project reporting and executive-level reporting
Advanced user of Excel and Office tools
Experience with PowerQuery, Power BI, and similar reporting tools
Experience designing reports with strong visualization and presentation capabilities
Proficiency in SQL; knowledge of M and DAX is a plus
Programming experience (e.g., VBA or other languages) is a plus
Experience working with data structures, templates, and tracking tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong communication skills and ability to present complex data to non-technical stakeholders
Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources
Ability to work cross-functionally in a dynamic environment


About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES


High-Performance Culture
Customer Focus
Operational Excellence
Innovation
Financial Strength


VERTIV BEHAVIORS


Own it
Act with urgency
Foster a customer-first mindset
Think big and execute
Lead by example
Drive continuous improvement
Learn and seek out development
Promote transparent & open communication


About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Title: Analyste de données / Data Analyst
Description:
***An English version will follow***




À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. We’re currently seeking qualified candidates for a Data Analyst in our Fort Washington office. This position reports directly to the Analytics Manager and will be responsible for data gathering, analysis, and reporting.

Create reports for internal teams/external clients
Identify, analyze, and interpret patterns in data sets using statistical techniques
Derive and communicate data insights
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to data analysis and BI

Ability to generate information quickly and manage multiple projects at once
Ability to work extended hours as needed

Along with a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer a modern working environment that supports work/life balance. They value hard work and a positive, can-do attitude, and in return, fosters a fun, friendly, and team-oriented culture.

Title: Data Analyst - Servicing Operations
Description:
As a Data Analyst for Rocket Loans, you'll be a strategic partner to our leadership, collecting, analyzing, and reporting on data that drives operational excellence. You'll work closely with our Senior Data Analyst leadership to support operations, call center, and servicing reporting needs ultimately enabling our team leaders to make data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency and performance. You'll use a range of tools and methodologies, including statistics, technical expertise, and modern data platforms, to generate actionable insights and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. As a storyteller, you'll collect data from various sources to guide strategic decisions and support our transition to advanced analytics platforms.

About The Role


Identify and communicate patterns in operations and call center data in response to business needs using data manipulation, statistics, and data visualization
Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports, and methods with a focus on operations/servicing metrics and call center activity
Use data to support and challenge business solutions with stakeholders, particularly operations and collections teams
Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions around operational performance and team efficiency
Maintain strong relationships and alignment among operations stakeholders to meet reporting and analytical objectives
Define, gather, and validate data requirements; evaluate and ensure data quality standards are met
Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Support the team's transition to Sigma as our primary reporting and visualization platform
Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in operations, call center management, and data analytics


About You

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals


Preferred Qualifications


Domain expertise in operations/call center reporting and supporting operations teams with collections and call center activity metrics
Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
Databricks SQL experience
Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
AWS experience


What You’ll Get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

Headquartered in Detroit, Rocket Loans was established to create the most simple, rocket fast personal loan process. We assembled a top-notch team of individuals combining new, passionate team members with some of the best veterans from Rocket Mortgage to create the most user-friendly lending platform in the world. We have given it our best to create an experience that is best-of-breed in the personal loan industry and commit even more to continuously improving it. At Rocket Loans, you’ll build a career that helps you achieve your professional goals while helping clients get the loans they need to reach their financial goals. We’re looking for innovators and those unafraid to disrupt the status -quo. With an inclusive culture and opportunities to make a positive impact, we’re here to help you foster your career growth.
