About The Job

Google's leadership team hand-picks thorny business challenges, and members of BizOps work in small teams to find solutions. As part of this team you fully immerse yourself in data collection, draw insight from analysis, and then zoom out to develop compelling, synthesized recommendations. Taking strategy one step further, you also persuasively communicate your recommendations to senior-level executives, roll-up your sleeves to help drive implementation and check back-in to see the impact of your recommendations.

In the Google Procurement Organization (GPO), our aim is to unlock value for Google to reinvest in what matters most. We do this by bringing velocity, efficiency, and security to buying at Google, while partnering deeply across Google to deliver solutions fit for purpose. As a centralized organization operating in a high complexity environment, we bring "one voice" to stakeholders and suppliers to ensure the best outcomes. Our organization fosters a culture of collaboration and innovation while providing opportunities for ongoing career growth and development.

Within the Google Procurement Organization, the Digital Experience team is responsible for enabling and ensuring a consistent approach across the entire GPO through deep data insights and agile simple processes and technology and focuses on developing GPO's processes, technology landsape and data architecture to create efficient, user-friendly, and integrated processes and systems that enhance GPO's capabilities, streamline operations, improve user experiences, and drive value for the organization.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $180000 - $261000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Design, develop, and maintain self-service reporting tools, dashboards, and analytics platforms tailored for procurement stakeholders.
Oversee collecting, aggregating, and analyzing procurement-related data from various sources to create actionable insights and meaningful visualizations.
Drive in-depth analysis to identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics relevant to procurement operations.
Lead creation of interactive and visually appealing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using data visualization and reporting tools and software.
Drive ongoing manual reporting activities by generating ad-hoc reports, and analyses as needed for specific operational requirements and ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of manually prepared reports.

Title: Sustainability Data Analyst
Description:
Location: United States - Remote

About The Role

Worldly is seeking a Sustainability Data Analyst with a passion for deep, detailed work with complex data. This person will partner with teams across Worldly to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of the sustainability data we provide to customers.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented and curious, a self-starter who enjoys understanding how calculations work, validating assumptions, and ensuring that outputs are reliable and defensible. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys balancing deep independent work with highly collaborative cross-functional stakeholder engagement.

What You'll Do


Work directly with large, complex sustainability datasets to support the development and maintenance of Worldly’s impact content.
Conduct content quality assurance (QA) and user acceptance testing (UAT) for sustainability calculations, metrics, and related content to ensure product and data accuracy and consistency across the Worldly platform.
Update and maintain complex assessment-defining files based on specifications from stakeholders.
Manage analytical content that controls and governs customer data exports.
Investigate and resolve data issues and questions by tracing outputs back to the source data and underlying logic.
Query Worldly data with SQL to support internal and external customer needs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to align data outputs that meet platform needs and customer expectations.
Continuously improve automation, documentation, and internal understanding of calculations, metrics, and data structures.
Conduct targeted research projects.


We'd Like to See


Exceptional attention to detail and a strong desire to understand how data and calculations work from end-to-end.
Bachelor's degree or similar experience in a relevant field (e.g., Sustainability, Environmental Engineering, Data Science).
2+ years of experience working in an analytical, data-focused, or consulting role.
Strong proficiency in SQL and comfort working directly with raw data.
Solid understanding of sustainability concepts, such as environmental impact measurement or carbon accounting.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and move work forward with minimal oversight.
Strong problem-solving skills and persistence when working through complex or ambiguous data challenges.
Clear written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfort working cross-functionally and incorporating feedback from multiple stakeholders.
Claude/AI fluency


It Helps If You Have


Experience with Python for data analysis or validation.
Comfort vibecoding your own non-production solutions to analytical and automation problems.
Background in statistics or quantitative analysis.
Familiarity with sustainability reporting frameworks or standards.
Experience working with customer-facing data products or platforms.


What We Can Offer You


Comprehensive benefits offerings - 90% employee premium and 75% spouse/dependent premium are covered by Worldly
Company-sponsored 401(k) with up to 4% match for US-based employees
Incentive Stock Options
100% Parental Paid Leave
Unlimited PTO
13 company holidays


Life at Worldly

Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we are able to build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level.

Our team represents over 15 countries and brings unique experiences from technology to farming to the table. Surround yourself with kind, enthusiastic, and dedicated people who put collaboration and growth at the center of our shared goals.

Benefits and Perks


Earn a competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. Get healthcare, retirement matching, and equity for US employees.
Use our work-from-home stipends to get the supplies you need.
Flexible time off. Take the time you need to recharge. Our culture encourages team members to explore and rest to be their best selves.
We're remote, not lonely. Join the culture committee, coffee chats, or a variety of other interest groups.


Travel Notice

This role may require occasional travel to support business needs, including but not limited to team collaboration, customer engagement, or company events.

Equity Statement

We believe it's essential to reflect the diversity of those we strive to serve. True innovation happens when everyone has room at the table, including the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. We're dedicated to building a culturally and experientially diverse team that leads and works with empathy and respect.

Compensation


Annual Base Salary: $ 75,000 - $90,000
5% Annual Bonus Potential
Incentive Stock Option Package
Work-From-Home Stipends
Final compensation figures will be determined based on a wide variety of factors, including experience and location. These factors will be evaluated and considered by Worldly throughout the entirety of this process.


Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

Title: Sales Operations Data Analyst
Description:
Cytek Biosciences is a leading life sciences technology company advancing the next generation of cell analysis solutions for biomedical research, drug discovery, and clinical research. The company develops innovative flow cytometry and cell analysis technologies designed to provide researchers with high-resolution, high-content, and high-sensitivity data to better understand complex biological systems.

Cytek is recognized for its patented Full Spectrum Profiling™ (FSP®) technology, which captures the full fluorescence spectrum from multiple lasers to enable highly multiplexed and sensitive single-cell analysis. Its portfolio includes advanced flow cytometry platforms such as the Cytek Aurora®, Northern Lights™, Aurora CS, Aurora Evo, and Borealis™, along with reagents, software, and services that provide integrated solutions for researchers.

Headquartered in Fremont, California, Cytek serves pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, contract research organizations, and leading academic research institutions worldwide. The company’s mission is to enable scientists to obtain deeper biological insights and accelerate scientific innovation through powerful, accessible cell-analysis technologies.

The Sales Operations Data Analyst will drive forecasting excellence, process optimization, and advanced analytics initiatives across our global sales organization. In this role, the candidate supports forecast accuracy improvements, leads sophisticated projects to streamline operational efficiency, and contributes to data-driven initiatives by applying advanced data processing techniques to extract, combine, and analyze data from multiple CRM and ERP sources. This role will focus on collaborating with Global Sales Leadership, Finance, Operations, and IT teams.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform essential duties and responsibilities satisfactorily.


Improve forecast reliability and accuracy for enterprise products, focusing on forecasting support and providing actionable insights for strategic accounts.
Incorporate data insights to guide sales strategies, inform business decisions, and align with forecasting objectives.
Assist with global data reconciliation across CRM, financial, and forecasting systems to validate data, resolve discrepancies, and ensure consistent, reliable reporting.
Ensure data hygiene in Salesforce and forecasting platforms by managing product updates, system configurations, pricing analysis and conducting regular pipeline reviews.
Establish metrics to measure forecasting performance, pipeline health, and data quality, and pinpoint areas for process improvement.
Provide hands-on support to the sales team by managing pipeline data, sales attainment dashboards, troubleshooting system issues, and delivering training and tools to enable efficient forecasting workflows.
Support forecasting projects, process automation, and analytics improvements to improve sales projections and operational scalability.
Perform exploratory data analysis to identify data inconsistencies, patterns, trends, and correlations in large data sets.
Support the identification and resolution of data anomalies, working closely with stakeholders to address issues promptly.
Extract reliable data from various sources to identify key insights and opportunities and challenges our clients should act on.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer specific business questions and provide accurate and actionable recommendations.


Requirements & Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.


Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline.
5+ years of data analytics experience; leading multiple projects of various scope/complexity from initiation to closeout, with data quality as a focus.
Exceptional data expertise in all aspects of data analysis, insights creation, and visualization.
Advanced CRM and ERP data processing skills, including building advanced reports and queries.
Strong flexibility to work with a variety of application development applications.
Exceptional organizational skills, detail-oriented, adaptive, and strong client-focused mindset.
Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Salesforce, SAP, and Integrated Business Planning (IBP), experience with Python, SQL, or other data tools is a plus.
Background in supporting instrument manufacturing and life science products in forecasting or revenue planning is highly preferred.
Ability to manage a variety of tasks with tight timelines.
Excellent quantitative, analytical, written, and oral communication skills.
Comfortable navigating through ambiguity and crafting solutions without a defined guideline.
Strong work ethic and highly developed problem-solving skills.
Enjoy working under time constraints and can excel under pressure.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. 


The role is on-site in the Fremont, CA office.
Individuals may be required to travel to and from Cytek offices and other locations, as needed.
Prolonged periods of sitting and working on a computer.


Cytek is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

JOB TITLE: Finance Data & Transformation Analyst

REPORTING TO: Finance Manager, IH&S

LOCATION: Remote

Who is IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)?

As a business unit of IDEX Corporation, IH&S has a long history of driving growth in life sciences and healthcare by embracing innovation and redefining the supplier-customer relationship. The work we do every day allows us to discover key insights and break new ground to create some of the most meaningful technologies that have a lasting impact on companies, industries, and society. One of business segments is called Life Science Fluidics and we are looking to add more talent to the team.

IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)

IH&S is comprised of six domestic and one international business unit. IH&S is a manufacturing and R&D focused team that sits at the leading edge of high-end fluidic and optical applications for life sciences. Focused on assisting partners at every stage of the development processes, we invest in people and infrastructure to drive bold ideas and pragmatic solutions. With the rich foundation of talent, universities, and supporting businesses, IH&S is the ideal location to elevate your career with fascinating work and endless opportunities.

Our formula for success is simple. We work hard to maintain a culture where you can own your work; you are encouraged to try new ideas in a collaborative environment; and you can apply your skillset to enable our clients to gain a competitive advantage in their own market. At IDEX Health & Science, you will have the opportunity to work with a great group of people, mentor others, and build a great future.

Scope Of Role

This position plays a critical role in advancing IH&S’s finance data transformation initiatives by focusing on developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, enabling standardized financial reporting, and translating complex financial and operational data into clear, decision-ready insights. In addition to supporting ongoing reporting needs, this individual will contribute to the design and implementation of scalable data models that support forecasting, KPI tracking, and executive-level performance visibility. Title: IT Workforce Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Certain terms and conditions of employment for this position, including the rate of pay, benefits, etc., are currently subject to negotiation with the appropriate union.

As part of the People Analytics team, the workforce analyst supports workforce reporting, analytics, and metric development activities that inform operational and strategic decision-making across UCSF. Working under the direction of the Director of People Analytics, the incumbent partners with analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to investigate workforce questions, develop workforce metrics, conduct analyses, and deliver reporting solutions that support organizational priorities. Working under the direction of the Director of People Analytics, the technically-oriented workforce analyst will support leadership requests, develop metrics, conduct analyses, and operationalize business questions into reporting and analytics products.

This role will touch upon the broad portfolio of People Analytics domains, including workforce demographics, workforce movement, human resources operational analytics, occupational health, learning and compliance, engagement, and other workforce-related initiatives.

Working closely with data architects, analysts, and business stakeholders, the incumbent contributes to analytic solution design, develops reusable business logic, validates outputs, and translates workforce requirements into maintainable technical solutions. The position serves as a bridge between business analysis and data engineering by refining analytic SQL, documenting business rules, preparing data transformation logic, and partnering with engineers to productionize reporting and analytics assets. The analyst independently executes complex assignments while escalating novel architectural, governance, or enterprise-wide decisions to senior team members. The position requires strong technical skills, sound judgment, and the ability to independently execute complex assignments while escalating novel architectural, governance, or enterprise-wide decisions to senior team members. The analyst independently executes assigned analyses and reporting projects while receiving guidance on prioritization, stakeholder management, and novel or highly complex analytical problems.

Department Overview

The mission of the Enterprise Information and Analytics (EIA) department is to advance UCSF’s institutional priorities by enhancing access to and the use of data and analytics, including appropriate data platforms and data governance, in a manner that meets the unique needs across the education, research, and care mission areas. The department achieves its goals by working with clinical, research, education, and business partners to organize, integrate, govern, and transform UCSF’s data assets into actionable insight and information.

People Analytics owns enterprise-wide assets for UCSF as a whole, used for both operational and analytical purposes, as well as departmental and business assets to drive business insights and decisions.

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor's degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
At least 2 years of experience developing complex SQL queries and working with structured data. Experience writing maintainable, well-organized SQL using joins, CTEs, window functions, and reusable query patterns. Familiarity with Python or similar scripting languages preferred..
At least 2 years’ experience developing reports from large data sets.
Experience translating business questions into analytic approaches and actionable recommendations. 2 years’ experience developing and maintaining report specifications in collaboration with business owners.
Familiarity with dimensional modeling concepts, logical data design, source-to-target mapping, and data transformation techniques. Experience documenting business logic for implementation by engineering teams. Demonstrated experience using data to solve business problems and support decision-making.
Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills.
Proficiency in MS 365 Office Suite, especially Excel.
Excellent communication, escalation, time management, collaboration, and change management skills. Ability to work both independently and in teams.
Experienced in setting priorities across competing demands, clarifying expectations, and sustaining a positive and productive attitude despite swiftly changing priorities and a high level of activity. Ability to complete projects and achieve results in a fast-paced work environment.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with workforce, HR, healthcare, operational, or compliance-related data.
Experience developing metrics and KPIs.
Familiarity with workforce analytics concepts including turnover, mobility, staffing, compliance, and organizational effectiveness.
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Databricks, or similar analytics platforms.


About Us

About UCSF

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

Pride Values

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

Equal Employment Opportunity

The University of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected status under state or federal law.

Salary Information

The final salary and offer components are subject to additional approvals based on UC policy.

Your placement within the salary range is dependent on a number of factors including your work experience and internal equity within this position classification at UCSF. For positions that are represented by a labor union, placement within the salary range will be guided by the rules in the collective bargaining agreement.

To learn more about the benefits of working at UCSF, including total compensation, please visit: https://ucnet.universityofcalifornia.edu/compensation-and-benefits/index.html

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

Hippocratic AI is looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to shape product strategy and measure the clinical, operational, and financial impact of our healthcare AI products. This isn't a dashboarding role — you'll help define what "good" looks like for AI clinical agents (including critic frameworks and quality criteria), not just track adoption of a finished product.

You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, clinical teams, and leadership to answer questions like: What should we build? What's driving or limiting adoption? What outcomes are we creating for patients and customers? Where should we invest next — and how do we prove it with data?

The ideal candidate moves comfortably from an ambiguous business question to structured analysis to an executive-ready recommendation, and has the business judgment to know which questions matter most.

What You'll Do

Define how we measure success


Partner with clinical and product teams to define AI agent performance criteria, including critic frameworks and quality metrics.
Define north star metrics and measurement frameworks that guide product strategy — not just measure what already exists.
Design analytical approaches to evaluate product changes and program impact, including in real-world settings where randomized experiments aren't possible.
Conduct pre- and post-launch analysis to determine whether initiatives achieved their intended outcomes.


Turn data into decisions and dollars


Translate ambiguous product and business questions into structured analysis and clear recommendations that influence roadmap and prioritization.
Build business cases and ROI models connecting product usage to operational efficiency, cost reduction, capacity, and patient/customer outcomes.
Partner with technical teams to improve instrumentation so the data behind these decisions is reliable.


Represent the work — internally and with customers


Present findings and recommendations (not just metrics) to Product leadership and executives.
Sit directly in customer and partner conversations to represent product data, outcomes, and ROI — this isn't just internal deck prep.
Serve as a strategic analytics partner across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and GTM, and help raise the analytical bar as we scale.


Location Requirement

We believe the best ideas happen together. To support fast collaboration and a strong team culture, this role is expected to be in our Menlo Park office five days a week, unless otherwise specified.

What You Bring

Must-have


5+ years in product analytics, product strategy, data analytics, business strategy, or management consulting.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical discipline (Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Data Science, CS, Engineering, or related).
Advanced SQL and demonstrated ability to independently analyze large, complex datasets; working Python proficiency preferred.
Demonstrated experience using data to influence product strategy, prioritization, or roadmap decisions.
Experience with product analytics/BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, or similar).
Design analytical approaches to evaluate product changes and program impact — including in real-world settings where randomized experiments aren't possible.
Experience building business cases, ROI analyses, or financial models, and presenting them to senior stakeholders.


Nice-to-Have


Experience in product analytics or strategy at a technology, healthcare technology, SaaS, or AI company.
Experience working with healthcare data, products, clinical workflows, or healthcare organizations.
Fluency in healthcare financial and value-based care concepts (e.g., HRRP/readmission economics, value-based care arrangements, risk-based contracting).
Experience designing causal, cohort, funnel, retention, or behavioral analyses, especially where RCTs aren't feasible.
Experience presenting to Director/VP/C-suite or senior customer stakeholders.
Experience with AI, machine learning, or LLM-powered products.
Startup or high-growth experience where responsibilities extend beyond a narrowly defined analytics function.


What Success Looks Like

Success here isn't how many dashboards you build — it's whether your analysis changes a decision. You'll help us understand which product investments matter most, which capabilities create measurable value, and how to prove it with data.

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first. We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future. Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors. We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI. Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

Equal Opportunity

Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.

Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @hippocraticai.com email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

Title: Senior Marketing Analyst
Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and technically strong Senior Marketing Analyst with deep expertise in SQL and Power BI to support, measure, and optimize marketing performance across both digital and offline channels. This is a hands-on, data-driven role focused on transforming complex datasets into reliable insights that inform marketing strategy and business decisions.

Responsibilities


Develop and maintain advanced SQL queries to transform, aggregate, and analyze large-scale marketing, customer, and revenue datasets.
Build and maintain analytical datasets and reporting tables supporting marketing performance, attribution, and experimentation.
Develop, manage, and optimize Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, and dashboards used by marketing leaders and executives.
Create executive-level dashboards that clearly communicate performance, trends, and key drivers across channels including PPC, SEO, Paid Social, Organic Social, Display, Email, CTV, Linear TV, Print, and OOH.
Monitor and validate data quality, investigate anomalies, and ensure consistency across reporting sources and dashboards.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting automation, scalability, efficiency, and performance.
Support additional analytical initiatives and responsibilities as needed.


Required Skills & Qualifications


Advanced SQL expertise, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, and query performance optimization.
Strong experience building and maintaining Power BI datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and advanced DAX measures.
Demonstrated ability to design data models that support flexible slicing, multi-period comparisons, and executive-level reporting.
Experience analyzing multi-channel marketing data from platforms such as Google, Bing, Meta, and programmatic or CTV platforms.
Strong understanding of marketing KPIs, attribution concepts, and performance measurement frameworks.
Ability to translate technical analysis into clear business insights and effectively communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders.


Preferred Skills & Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in analytics, statistics, economics, marketing, or a related field.
Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Azure Synapse, or similar technologies.
Familiarity with data modeling concepts including star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and fact tables.
Experience with attribution modeling, incrementality testing, or causal inference methodologies.
Experience optimizing Power BI performance, including query folding, data models, and report performance.
Familiarity with Python or R for advanced analytics is a plus.
Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and marketing data integrations.
Experience working with ServiceTitan or similar operational data platforms is a plus.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Description

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

Realtor.com is a two-sided platform helping match the consumers on our site and apps to our paying customers. The Data Science & Analytics team at Realtor.com provides trusted data and insights to optimize every aspect of consumer/customer experience and to drive the company’s commercial performance.

Avail Realtor.com is a fast-growing platform transforming how independent landlords and tenants manage the rental experience. Built with the spirit of a startup and backed by the scale and stability of a leading digital real estate company, Avail provides a complete suite of tools, resources, and education to help landlords manage their properties with confidence and professionalism. As part of the Avail team, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact – shaping the future of this rapidly expanding brand and helping to reimagine the rental industry for millions across the U.S..

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst with a strong background in business intelligence and strategic analytics to help shape the future of Avail. As a trusted partner to the Avail leadership team, you will be the vital link between complex data and pivotal business moves, striving to enable and empower data-driven decision making across the business.

In this role, you will analyze large and complex data sets, define and track business KPIs, build automated reporting solutions, conduct robust analyses, generate actionable insights, and deliver clear recommendations that inform critical decisions across strategy, product, marketing, and operations.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented analytics expert, a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, and a team player who excels in cross-functional collaborations, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and driven by a desire to make things better.

What You'll Do


Partner closely with Avail business stakeholders to understand/clarify needs and requirements, and translate them into analytical problems.
If the required data is not available, work with the team to identify the right data sources, and build analytical data layers in collaboration with the data engineering partner.
Independently conduct end-to-end data analytical work from data collection, ETL, analysis, to the delivery of insights and recommendations.
Serve as Avail’s Business Intelligence expert and own KPI development, measurement, tracking, and reporting. Closely monitor KPIs and carry out deep-dive analysis to explain changes and trends, and surface areas of opportunities.
Own and run regular business performance reporting, and actively contribute analytics-related content to business reviews and other reports.
Build automated reports and dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Mixpanel, etc.
Build and grow adoption of self-service solutions that empower stakeholders to access data and insights, and hence accelerate data-driven decision making.
Conduct market and competitor analysis using a variety of internal and external data sources.
Work with Avail leadership team on strategic initiatives and planning, providing analytical support on financial modeling, forecast, opportunity sizing, and so on.


What You Bring


Bachelor’s degree, ideally in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
6+ years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role.
SQL proficiency is a must, with 6+ years of experience.
Proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets for quick reporting and ad hoc analysis.
Strong capability to work with complex data sets and perform EDA, descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analyses.
Experience with cloud-based data environments such as Snowflake and AWS.
Significant experience creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Mixpanel, Power BI, or similar tools.
Proven experience using data and analytics to drive revenue and other business KPIs, and doing so in a proactive manner by actively seeking to identify opportunities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to diverse technical and business audiences at different levels.
Experience in collaborating with cross-functional partners.
Experience managing multiple priorities, responding to urgent data requests, and adapting to changing business needs and priorities.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
Proficiency with a scripting language such as Python or R.
Experience in the tech sector, especially marketplace or property tech.


How We Work

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.

How We Reward You

Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to:


Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage
Family forming benefits
13 Paid Holidays
Flexible Time Off
8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off
Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3.5% company match
Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non-degreed programs
1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions
Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program
Free snacks and refreshments in each office location


Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com®

Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow.

Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. As a Data Analyst, you will join Canada Life’s Canada Operations & Business Enablement, Data Analytics and Reporting team. In this role you will support all Canada Operations and Business Enablement teams with the development, implementation, and maintenance of analytics solutions ranging from descriptive and diagnostic to predictive.

The Analyst, Data & Analytics supports decision making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will assist in modelling, analysing, and predicting business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements, collect, integrate, clean, explore, model, and analyze large datasets and visualize results and present to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Work with large datasets that are not consistent, clean, or fully modelled
Communicate effectively and demonstrate critical thinking and business acumen.
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner

Reliability Status Security Clearance – this can only be completed with candidates who receive an offer of employment. 1-3 years of relevant experience and a bachelor’s degree in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification is preferred
Demonstrated experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualisation tools (Power BI) with experience at creating interactive dashboards
Ability to write efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate, and transform data from multiple sources, and to automate data pipelines
Proficiency in Power BI, Data Modelling, Power Query, and DAX
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Good knowledge in data analytics and statistical modelling
Strong communication and presentation skills
Proven ability to learn quickly and independently and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset


Given the size and scope of our organization, we have the flexibility for this position to be located in the following head office locations: Toronto, London, Winnipeg. This role follows a hybrid work model, with an in-office presence required three days per week.

The ideal candidate will have experience interfacing with internal and external client teams, problem solving with peers, and possess a strong technical aptitude with good organizational skills and a desire to learn and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Distill complex business and technical requirements into viable analytical solutions
Partner with subject matter experts to understand root cause patterns within data
Data mapping, transformation and normalization
Data visualization and interface/ manipulation development
Analytics platform enhancements and toolset evaluations
Troubleshooting and audit trail development


Requirements

You will thrive if you:


Exhibit a “self-starter” mindset in taking ownership over delegated project responsibilities
Quickly spot non-standard patterns in data and can follow the trail back through complex data pipelines
Enjoy rapid mastery of process dimensions around problems solved with data analytics
Are a tenacious self-learner
Are detail and results oriented


You Bring a Toolkit Of Your Past Experiences Of


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst or with Data Analytics tooling (e.g. Python, SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) in a commercial capacity

Demonstrated history of integrating multiple data sets to create unique insights
Implementing and designing data curation, and data analysis frameworks
Experience working across an array of stakeholders
Effective collaboration, experienced in creating technical partnerships across teams
Learning and understanding the various data domains across the enterprise and able to communicate complex relationships between clinical and business concepts across the enterprise and various stakeholders
Effectively delivering results in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities

Travel


Expected to be minimal.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0247289

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to the Navy to understand their data and support Fleet readiness.

As a client-facing data analyst embedded with a DOW client, you’ll work closely with our customers to understand their data questions and then dig into their data-rich environments and tools to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise the client on what the information means by developing decision-making support visualization products and dashboards to help translate data into recommendations. You will use automation tools and scripts to streamline data processing and reporting.

What You'll Work On:


Provide clear, timely data analysis and trend insights for leadership in a fast paced environment and preparing written analysis.
Analyze data across various subject areas to develop a complete data picture for non-technical leadership and clients.
Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data is accessible and organized to support analysis, trend forecasting and alerting needs.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies, and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, interpretation, evaluation, and analysis of large data sets.
Establish quantitative/qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive decision-making.
Create visualizations and dashboards, such as graphs, tables, and maps, across multiple platforms to communicate findings effectively.
Produce recurring and rapid-turnaround reports and analysis, including responses to high-priority leadership and congressional requests, across multiple office branches to ensure a holistic understanding and facilitate informed decision-making.
Engage directly with clients to understand their evolving needs, communicate findings clearly, and provide actionable recommendations. Adapt to client feedback and requests, fostering strong professional relationships and supporting informed decision-making at all organizational levels.



Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


3+ years of experience in data analysis or data visualization
Experience in quantitative data analysis, performance measurement, data cleansing, metrics evaluation, and applied research
Experience executing projects and tasks independently, including large-scale initiatives
Experience leading discussions about data products, sources, and projects with executive leadership
Ability to identify and analyze data sets to meet customer requirements and translate complex findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences
Ability to be organized, multi-task, and respond quickly to urgent requests
Ability to work closely with executive leadership on large data projects and communicate effectively via email and phone
Secret clearance
Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Law, Engineering, Social Sciences, Physical Science, Applied Science, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics or Management



Nice If You Have:


3+ years of experience with data analysis or data visualization with Power BI, Excel, or Tableau preferred
Experience with data querying and manipulation using SQL or similar tools

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Why Bison:


Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability

Title: Specialty Pharmacy Data Analyst
Description:
About The Job

Loopback Health is hiring an innovative and team-oriented Data Analyst within the Health System Solutions team to work on a blend of clinical, economic and operational datasets to answer questions across the healthcare delivery and life sciences value chain.

The Analyst’s role will be to inquire about the nature of the question being asked, distill the question into relevant data elements to represent, the visualization and delivery format, and presentation scheme to answer the client question at hand.

The ideal candidate will have experience interfacing with internal and external client teams, problem solving with peers, and possess a strong technical aptitude with good organizational skills and a desire to learn and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will also have excellent problem-solving skills and exhibit strong, fact-based communication skills. At Loopback you will enjoy success, develop your professional skills, and allow your career to thrive within a fast-growing business who is expanding their team.

Duties to Include


Distill complex business and technical requirements into viable analytical solutions
Partner with subject matter experts to understand root cause patterns within data
Data mapping, transformation and normalization
Data visualization and interface/ manipulation development
Analytics platform enhancements and toolset evaluations
Troubleshooting and audit trail development


Requirements

You will thrive if you:


Exhibit a “self-starter” mindset in taking ownership over delegated project responsibilities
Quickly spot non-standard patterns in data and can follow the trail back through complex data pipelines
Enjoy rapid mastery of process dimensions around problems solved with data analytics
Are a tenacious self-learner
Are detail and results oriented


You Bring a Toolkit Of Your Past Experiences Of


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst or with Data Analytics tooling (e.g. Python, SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) in a commercial capacity
Experience working with extremely large health care datasets
Demonstrated history of integrating multiple data sets to create unique insights
Implementing and designing data curation, and data analysis frameworks
Experience working across an array of stakeholders
Effective collaboration, experienced in creating technical partnerships across teams
Learning and understanding the various data domains across the enterprise and able to communicate complex relationships between clinical and business concepts across the enterprise and various stakeholders
Effectively delivering results in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities
Documenting and testing results of your analytics efforts, engaging with QA and Delivery teams to satisfy client needs


Travel


Expected to be minimal.


This employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status (e.g., H1-B) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

About Loopback

Loopback is a healthcare data company dedicated to improving access and outcomes for complex patients. We partner with health systems to grow and optimize specialty pharmacy performance, and we support life sciences organizations in accelerating evidence generation and expanding patient access through differentiated data and insights. Our work sits at the intersection of data, technology, and patient care, and we’re building a purpose-driven team that reflects that mission.

Founded in 2009, Loopback has been recognized by the Dallas Business Journal as one of the Best Places to Work, reflecting a culture grounded in collaboration, trust, and impact. Loopback has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies and consistently ranks among the fastest-growing companies in Dallas by the Dallas Business Journal.

Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.

Program Performance Analytics

Work closely with Product Engineering to ensure product features, enhancements, and changes are reflected in the datasets


Data Quality & Governance

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Experience in the healthcare industry.

Understanding of SLA management and performance metrics.
Experience working in dual-focused BI environments (internal and client-facing).

Experience with data transfer agreements, data use agreements, and third-party data integration.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms.

Natural curiosity about data and its business implications.

Can-do attitude with a passion for solving complex problems.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Excellent communication skills to translate technical findings to business stakeholders.

À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.

About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.




About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.




Key Responsibilities

Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
Special projects, and other duties as required.




Candidate Qualifications

Strong problem solving skills.
2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
Understanding of statistical principles.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Fully bilingual in English and French.
Ability to coordinate across teams.




Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.


What We Offer

  • 100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
  • Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.

  • Fully bilingual in English and French.
  • Ability to coordinate across teams.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations


The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. The Firm will provide reasonable accommodations as necessary to allow an individual with a disability to apply for and/or perform the essential functions of a position. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Compensation And Benefits

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:


State of California: $116,000 - $237,000
State of Colorado: $107,000 - $191,000
State of Connecticut: $95,000 - $241,000
State of Illinois: $105,000 - $204,000
State of Maine: $79,000 - $182,000
State of Maryland: $113,000 - $171,000
State of Massachusetts: $116,000 - $222,000
State of Minnesota: $116,000 - $192,000
Jersey City, NJ: $126,000 - $229,000
State of New York: $108,000 - $234,000
State of Vermont: $115,000 - $220,000
State of Virginia: $76,000 - $220,000
State of Washington: $113,000 - $214,000
Washington, D.C.: $150,000 - $220,000


The above salaries do not include a discretionary bonus, however bonus opportunities are non-guaranteed, and are dependent upon individual and firm performance. Full-time employees receive benefits including: medical and dental coverage; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; pre-tax flexible spending account for certain medical and dependent care expenses; an employee assistance program; Paid Time Off; paid holidays; participation in a retirement plan program after meeting eligibility requirements; and more.

Please include a cover letter and resume when applying.
