Title: Data Analyst - Servicing Operations
Description:
As a Data Analyst for Rocket Loans, you'll be a strategic partner to our leadership, collecting, analyzing, and reporting on data that drives operational excellence. You'll work closely with our Senior Data Analyst leadership to support operations, call center, and servicing reporting needs ultimately enabling our team leaders to make data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency and performance. You'll use a range of tools and methodologies, including statistics, technical expertise, and modern data platforms, to generate actionable insights and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. As a storyteller, you'll collect data from various sources to guide strategic decisions and support our transition to advanced analytics platforms.

About The Role


Identify and communicate patterns in operations and call center data in response to business needs using data manipulation, statistics, and data visualization
Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports, and methods with a focus on operations/servicing metrics and call center activity
Use data to support and challenge business solutions with stakeholders, particularly operations and collections teams
Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions around operational performance and team efficiency
Maintain strong relationships and alignment among operations stakeholders to meet reporting and analytical objectives
Define, gather, and validate data requirements; evaluate and ensure data quality standards are met
Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Support the team's transition to Sigma as our primary reporting and visualization platform
Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in operations, call center management, and data analytics


About You

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals


Preferred Qualifications


Domain expertise in operations/call center reporting and supporting operations teams with collections and call center activity metrics
Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
Databricks SQL experience
Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
AWS experience


What You’ll Get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

Headquartered in Detroit, Rocket Loans was established to create the most simple, rocket fast personal loan process. We assembled a top-notch team of individuals combining new, passionate team members with some of the best veterans from Rocket Mortgage to create the most user-friendly lending platform in the world. We have given it our best to create an experience that is best-of-breed in the personal loan industry and commit even more to continuously improving it. At Rocket Loans, you’ll build a career that helps you achieve your professional goals while helping clients get the loans they need to reach their financial goals. We’re looking for innovators and those unafraid to disrupt the status -quo. With an inclusive culture and opportunities to make a positive impact, we’re here to help you foster your career growth.

As a storyteller, you'll collect data from various sources to guide strategic decisions and support our transition to advanced analytics platforms.

About The Role

  • Identify and communicate patterns in operations and call center data in response to business needs using data manipulation, statistics, and data visualization
  • Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports, and methods with a focus on operations/servicing metrics and call center activity
  • Use data to support and challenge business solutions with stakeholders, particularly operations and collections teams
  • Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions around operational performance and team efficiency
  • Maintain strong relationships and alignment among operations stakeholders to meet reporting and analytical objectives
  • Define, gather, and validate data requirements; evaluate and ensure data quality standards are met
  • Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
  • Support the team's transition to Sigma as our primary reporting and visualization platform
  • Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked
  • Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in operations, call center management, and data analytics

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
  • Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
  • Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
  • Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
  • Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
  • Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
  • Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals

Preferred Qualifications

  • Domain expertise in operations/call center reporting and supporting operations teams with collections and call center activity metrics
  • Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
  • Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
  • Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
  • Databricks SQL experience
  • Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
  • AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
  • AWS experience

What You’ll Get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

Headquartered in Detroit, Rocket Loans was established to create the most simple, rocket fast personal loan process. Tu intègres l'équipe en tant que Data Analyst pour l'un de nos clients grands comptes du secteur bancaire.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst – Leading Client




Our client is a rapidly growing organisation undergoing an exciting period of transformation, with data becoming increasingly central to how the business operates and makes decisions. They are investing in their data and BI capabilities and are looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst to help build a trusted, scalable reporting environment.




The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to take ownership of the development and continuous improvement of Power BI reporting across the business. You’ll work closely with senior stakeholders and business teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights, while helping establish consistent data models, KPIs, and reporting standards.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across the full analytics lifecycle — from sourcing and modelling data through to building dashboards, developing advanced DAX and Power Query logic, and presenting insights to decision-makers.




Key Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain high-quality Power BI dashboards across multiple areas of the business.
Own the end-to-end reporting process, from understanding business requirements through to data modelling, development, testing, and deployment.
Develop robust and reusable semantic data models using strong data modelling principles.
Use Power Query and DAX to transform data and create advanced business metrics and reporting logic.
Write SQL queries to source, analyse, and combine data from multiple systems.
Define and standardise KPIs with business stakeholders to create a consistent view of performance.
Replace fragmented spreadsheets and legacy reporting with scalable, self-service BI solutions.
Analyse data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and areas for business improvement.
Implement appropriate reporting permissions and data access controls.
Work with stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting adoption, and self-service analytics.
Provide guidance, documentation, and training to help business users get greater value from data.




About You:

4+ years’ experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a similar role.
Strong hands-on experience building Power BI dashboards end-to-end.
Advanced Power Query and DAX skills, including complex transformations and custom measures.
Strong understanding of data modelling, including relationships, hierarchies, and star schema.
Solid SQL skills with experience working across multiple data sources.
Proven ability to translate business questions into effective data and reporting solutions.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and non-technical business users.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on data quality and accuracy.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex data clearly.
Self-motivated, organised, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.




Nice to Have:

Power BI certification.
Experience with Microsoft data and automation tools.
Experience implementing data governance, security, and GDPR-compliant reporting.
Exposure to broader data engineering or cloud data environments.
Experience developing self-service analytics capabilities.




Why Join?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation where data is becoming a key driver of business performance. You’ll have significant ownership over the development of the BI environment, work closely with senior stakeholders, and play a key role in establishing a more scalable and data-driven organisation.




Location: Dublin (Hybrid)

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Data Analysis & Insights: Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, trends, and insights that drive informed decision-making.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Do you see the benefits of gaining variety and experience from different customers and industries but developing with one and the same employer? As an employee at ESSIQ, you get the best of both worlds.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst with a strong technical foundation in data engineering to join our team. In this role, you’ll manage multiple data and reporting solutions across different technologies.

You’ll work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams — acting as the key bridge between business needs and data-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights:

Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, trends, and insights that drive informed decision-making.

Visualization & Reporting:

Design and develop dashboards and reports in Power BI to communicate insights effectively.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Work with Data Engineers and Data Scientists to turn business requirements into actionable data models and analytics solutions.

Required Skills & Experience


Strong proficiency in SQL and Power BI
Proven experience in Business Intelligence or Advanced Analytics projects
Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills
Experience in requirement gathering, process understanding, and solution design


Soft Skills & Working Style


Strong interpersonal and cross-cultural communication skills
Comfortable collaborating across international teams and time zones
Adaptable, proactive, and eager to learn new technologies and methodologies
Skilled in virtual collaboration tools for effective teamwork in global settings


About Essiq

ESSIQ is the technology consultancy where everything starts with the individual. We offer you the opportunity to shape your own career, a modern salary policy and flexible solutions! ESSIQ was founded in 2005 and has since grown with over 130 employees and three offices that you can find in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö. With us, you have the opportunity to work on site with the client, in-house and in satellite. Your interests and driving forces lead the way and our goal is to make the perfect match between individual and mission.

ESSIQ is a social company. We put a lot of resources into community and we have a wide range of professional and social activities. Our communication platform is imbued with openness and promotes networking and skill exchange as well as leisure activities and relationship building.

APPLICATION

Selection and interviews will take place continuously, so send your application today! Please respect that we do not accept any applications by email.

Questions about the role? Contact: Fredrik Persson, fredrik.persson@essiq.se

Do you want to know more about ESSIQ?

Visit http://essiq.se and follow us on our social media!

Description De L'entreprise

Inetum est un leader européen des services numériques. Pour les entreprises, les acteurs publics et la société dans son ensemble, les 28 000 consultants et spécialistes du groupe visent chaque jour l'impact digital : des solutions qui contribuent à la performance, à l'innovation et au bien commun.

Présent dans 19 pays au plus près des territoires, et avec ses grands partenaires éditeurs de logiciels, Inetum répond aux enjeux de la transformation digitale avec proximité et flexibilité.

Porté par son ambition de croissance et d'industrialisation, Inetum a généré en 2023 un chiffre d'affaires de 2,5 milliards d'€.

Pour répondre à un marché en croissance continue depuis plus de 30ans, Inetum a fait le choix délibéré de se recentrer sur 4 métiers afin de gagner en puissance et proposer des solutions sur mesure, adaptées aux besoins spécifiques de ses clients : le conseil (Inetum Consulting), la gestion des infrastructures et applications à façon (Inetum Technologies), l'implémentation de progiciels (Inetum Solutions) et sa propre activité d'éditeur de logiciels (Inetum Software). Inetum a conclu des partenariats stratégiques avec 4 grands éditeurs mondiaux - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft et SAP et poursuit une stratégie d'acquisitions dédiée afin d'entrer dans le top 5 européen sur ces technologies et proposer la meilleure expertise à ses clients.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Description Du Poste

En tant que Data Analyst, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la collecte, l'analyse et la valorisation des données afin d'accompagner les équipes métier dans leurs prises de décision.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée, depuis la collecte et la transformation jusqu'à la création de tableaux de bord et d'indicateurs de pilotage. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes métiers, les chefs de projet et les équipes techniques pour produire des analyses pertinentes permettant d'améliorer la performance et le suivi de l'activité.

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : 


Collecter, consolider et analyser les données issues de différentes sources.
Définir, mettre en place et suivre les indicateurs de performance (KPIs).
Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord et reportings décisionnels.
Analyser les tendances et produire des recommandations basées sur les données.
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données exploitées.
Participer à l'identification des besoins métiers et à leur traduction en indicateurs pertinents.
Produire des analyses régulières et des synthèses à destination des parties prenantes.
Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de reporting et d'analyse.
Collaborer avec les équipes métiers, projets et techniques dans le cadre d'études et d'analyses de données.


Qualifications

Fort d'au moins 3 ans d'expériences, vous disposez de solides compétences techniques dans des domaines tels que :


Très bonne maîtrise de SQL.
Maîtrise de Power BI ou d'un outil de datavisualisation équivalent.
Bonne maîtrise d'Excel.
Connaissances en modélisation et manipulation de données.
Capacité à analyser et interpréter des données complexes.
Connaissance des environnements décisionnels et du reporting.
Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse.


Vous aimez évoluer dans des environnements techniques complexes et innovants. Vous avez un véritable esprit d’équipe et aimez partager vos connaissances pour faire avancer la dynamique collective. Rigueur, adaptabilité et sens du service font partie de votre ADN professionnel.

Qualités personnelles


Excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens de l’écoute
Capacité à convaincre et fédérer les parties prenantes
Très bonnes compétences rédactionnelles
Forte capacité d’analyse, esprit de synthèse
Rigueur, autonomie et sens du service


Informations supplémentaires

L'évolution Professionnelle Au Sein D'Inetum 

Chez Inetum, nous croyons en votre développement et nous vous accompagnons à chaque étape grâce à :


Des formations et certifications régulières pour rester à la pointe des technologies,
Du temps dédié à la montée en compétence sur de nouvelles solutions.


Ce Que Nous Offrons 


Un environnement technologique stimulant et des projets stratégiques.
Une équipe experte et collaborative, où vos compétences seront valorisées.
Accompagnement personnalisé par Inetum pour booster votre carrière.


 

✅ Congés & RTT 

Les avantages Inetum qui font la différence :


27 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de RTT (dès 1 an d'acquisition)
1 jour supplémentaire tous les 5 ans d’ancienneté
Congés exceptionnels (dont 1 jour pour déménagement)


💙 Santé & Bien-être 


Mutuelle premium (65 % pris en charge)
Affiliation gratuite des enfants + option conjoint
Téléconsultation médicale gratuite
Prévoyance complète


🚲 Mobilité 


Remboursement transport en commun à 50 %
Indemnité vélo jusqu’à 200 €/an


💰 Avantages Financiers 


Dispositif de participation + Plan d’Épargne Groupe
Action logement (aide pour achat, travaux, location)


🏡 Télétravail 


Dispositif en place depuis 2011
Indemnité mensuelle (15 € / mois)
Participation aux frais d'installation


🍽 Tickets Restaurant 


9 € par jour travaillé (60 % pris en charge par l'employeur)


🤝 Cooptation 


Prime de 500 € à 1500 €


🎉 Vie D’entreprise 


Activités sociales & culturelles
Événements festifs d’équipe


🧘 Qvt


4 jours/ an de congé menstruel
Temps partiel sénior
Maintien de salaire pour les congés maternité après 6 mois d'ancienneté
Prévention en santé mentale

Description:
💡 OVENTI Consulting, cabinet de conseil en Data et Intelligence Artificielle qui allie expertise technique de pointe, vision stratégique et accompagnement sur mesure. Nous couvrons tout le cycle de vie des projets Data/IA, de la stratégie à l'implémentation de solutions personnalisées (ML, BI, automatisation intelligente).

Nos équipes, issues des meilleures écoles, s'intègrent chez nos clients ou opèrent depuis notre LAB interne, véritable foyer d’innovation. Chez Oventi, nous privilégions le "sur mesure" et l'innovation concrète. Chaque collaborateur est accompagné, formé et suivi pour garantir une culture d'excellence et un impact réel.




🧑 💻 Pourquoi ce rôle est clé ?

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au niveau de la data, de la business intelligence et de l'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission principale sera de transformer la donnée en leviers d'action concrets pour les équipes métiers, en consolidant le pilotage analytique et en intégrant des solutions d'IA pour affiner la prise de décision.




🎯 Vos missions au quotidien :

Pilotage de la performance :

Assurer un rôle de pilotage data et analytique complet, en définissant et en suivant les indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) pour le business.




Définition de stratégies :

Contribuer activement à la définition des stratégies, notamment en matière de merchandising et de négociation, en fournissant des analyses et des recommandations basées sur les données.




Optimisation de l'écosystème de reporting :

Gérer et rationaliser l'ensemble des tableaux de bord existants. L'objectif est de réduire le nombre de dashboards pour aboutir à une constellation d'outils plus efficaces et pertinents.




Développement d'outils analytiques :

Concevoir et mettre en place des outils de reporting stratégiques, tels qu'un Revenue Performance Dashboard, pour offrir une vision claire et consolidée de la performance financière.




Analyse avancée assistée par l'IA :

Mener des analyses complexes et des raisonnements "au cas d'usage" en exploitant des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Utiliser l'IA comme un levier pour explorer les données et formuler des hypothèses d'action.




🧩 Stack technique :

Langages : Python, SQL
Bases de données : BigQuery
Outils de Business Intelligence & Visualisation : Looker, Tableau
Formats de données : CSV, JSON, Avro
Outils de gestion projet : Jira, Confluence




🧩 Vous êtes la personne idéale si :

8 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
Diplômé d'un master ou d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Analyse, intelligence artificielle ou data science.
Aisance relationnelle, esprit collaboratif et appétence pour l'amélioration continue.




🌟 Pourquoi rejoindre OVENTI ?

Rejoindre Oventi, c'est choisir une aventure professionnelle unique :




✔️Une structure à taille humaine : Favorisant l'échange, l'autonomie et l'innovation, où votre impact est direct et visible.

✔️Des missions à forte valeur ajoutée : Dans des secteurs variés, avec une approche "sur mesure" où nos solutions ont des impacts importants chez nos clients.

✔️Une culture d’excellence technique : Avec un réel accompagnement de carrière et un suivi personnalisé.

✔️Une équipe passionnée et engagée : Des ingénieurs recrutés avec soin, formés en continu, et investis sur le long terme.

✔️L’agilité d’une startup, la rigueur d’un cabinet expert : Le meilleur des deux mondes pour une expérience enrichissante.

✔️Des missions à impact, visibles et valorisantes : Où vous aurez un impact réel sur les décisions métiers et la valeur business générée.




📍 Localisation : Paris (75002) avec 2-3 jours de télétravail hebdomadaire

💶 Rémunération : A discuter selon vos prétentions

🗓️ Démarrage : ASAP

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About This Vacancy

You will work with diverse datasets to identify trends, monitor performance, and deliver actionable recommendations that help stakeholders achieve their objectives.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect, analyze, and visualize data, translating complex information into clear and impactful reports and dashboards.


Define data requirements, reporting needs, and analytical approaches based on business objectives and project requirements.
Perform data extraction, exploration, and analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support data-driven decision making.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, KPIs, and analytical tools to monitor business performance and support operational and strategic initiatives.
Conduct data quality checks, validate analytical outputs, troubleshoot data issues, and produce clear documentation to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting and analysis.


What We Expect From You


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
Previous experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or related analytical roles.
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python and Microsoft Excel for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
Hands-on experience with Business Intelligence and data visualization tools, such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, or similar platforms.
Proven experience in data analysis, KPI definition and monitoring, dashboard development, performance reporting, and business insights generation.
Experience working with large and complex datasets, ensuring data quality, consistency, and accuracy.
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques and data modeling concepts is considered a plus.
Familiarity with data warehousing, ETL processes, and cloud-based analytics platforms is considered a plus.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
Good oral and written communication skills, both in Italian and English


What You Can Expect From Us

The position offers a permanent employment contract, and the base gross annual salary (Gross Annual Salary – RAL) will be no less than €30,000, in line with the National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL) for Commerce – Tertiary, Distribution and Services.

TMC is committed to offering a competitive compensation package. At the end of the recruitment process, after assessing the candidate's experience, skills, and qualifications, the company may offer a final gross annual salary higher than the amount stated above.

In line with our business model, the final compensation package also includes a project profit-sharing component, an individual annual learning and development budget of €4,000 net, and an annual welfare allowance. Further details will be provided during the recruitment process, in accordance with the company's applicable policies.

TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings expertise to its clients in order to support them with the realization of their technological challenges. As such, TMC is operating as an expert center at the disposition of its clients and we help them to be more competitive in an ever more global and faster-changing technological world. At TMC we believe that people are the driving force behind technological innovation. That is why we want to create the best possible conditions for tech talents to thrive in. We offer you a challenging and stimulating work environment in which you can be the director of your own career. As an Employeneur you are part of our TMC family. Next to our outstanding technical expertise, fun and engagement are meaningful parts of our culture.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join the Future of Data & Analytics at The Ardonagh Group

The Ardonagh Analytics Lab is an exciting new operation established by The Ardonagh Group in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath. As a centre of excellence for data and analytics, the Lab delivers data-driven insights that support colleagues and clients across the globe.

With more than 12,000 colleagues operating across a diverse portfolio of insurance products and related services, Ardonagh is committed to using data to transform decision-making, enhance client outcomes, and build a deeper understanding of risk.

Our mission is simple: use data, analytics, and innovation to achieve better outcomes for every participant in the value chain. We explore vast and complex datasets, uncover hidden opportunities, model future scenarios, and help clients and insurer partners prepare for the unknown.

We're now looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our growing Analytics Team and play a pivotal role in turning data into meaningful business insight.

The Opportunity

As a key member of the Data Analytics Team, you will work across a variety of datasets to both respond to business requests and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance across the Group.

You will bridge the gap between our Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams, ensuring that data is transformed into valuable insights that drive decision-making, operational efficiency, and commercial success.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an analytically curious professional who enjoys solving complex business problems and influencing strategic decisions through data.

What You'll Be Doing


Translate complex data into actionable insights that inform decision-making, solve business challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and efficiency.
Partner closely with Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams to understand available data sources and maximise their business value.
Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities within large datasets and provide recommendations that support strategic business decisions.
Enhance automated reporting and dashboards through proactive analysis, meaningful commentary, and actionable recommendations.
Support the development and implementation of robust data governance, management, and reporting processes across the Group.
Explore and apply AI and machine learning techniques where appropriate to drive innovation and enhance business insight.
Contribute to the continued development of a world-class analytics function within the Ardonagh Analytics Lab.


What We're Looking For

Essential Experience & Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years' experience in data analysis and reporting.
Strong SQL expertise, including data querying, mining, manipulation, and segmentation.
Advanced quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex datasets.
At least 2 years' experience using statistical programming languages such as Python or R.
Solid understanding of database concepts, structures, and data modelling.
Strong knowledge of Business Intelligence principles and analytical best practices.
Experience with one or more BI tools, including Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.


Desirable Experience


Experience within financial services.
Previous exposure to General Insurance is highly advantageous.
Knowledge of predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-based analytical techniques.


About You

We're looking for someone who:


Is an experienced analytics professional capable of working independently and taking ownership of outcomes.
Brings a proactive, solutions-focused mindset and thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Has a genuine passion for transforming data into business value.
Quickly builds an understanding of business operations and technical environments.
Is a strong relationship builder who can confidently engage with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication and influencing skills.


Why Join Us?

At the Ardonagh Analytics Lab, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging, high-impact projects that influence decision-making across a global organisation. You'll join a collaborative team passionate about innovation, continuous learning, and unlocking the power of data to shape the future of insurance.

If you're excited by the opportunity to turn complex data into meaningful business outcomes and want to be part of a growing analytics centre of excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at The Ardonagh Group.

The Company

In an industry that never stands still, neither do we. The Ardonagh Group was founded in 2017 and has grown to become the UK’s largest independent insurance distribution platform and a top 20 broker globally.

Our best-in-class entrepreneurial and specialist brands span a network of 150+ locations worldwide and have a combined workforce of more than c.12,000 people. Across our portfolio, we offer a highly diversified range of insurance-related products and services across the full insurance value chain in the UK, Ireland and broader international markets.

From complex multinational corporations to individuals purchasing personal insurance policies, our understanding of the communities we serve, together with our scale and breadth, allows us to deliver a broad range of product and risk solutions to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving market.

If you approach life with a sense of adventure you might just find what you need at Ardonagh to bring your ambition to life.

Find out more about Ardonagh’s world of opportunity on LinkedIn or visit www.ardonagh.com.

🚀 About This Role

Your mission is to transform raw data into clear, actionable insights that power smarter decisions across the business — ensuring every team has the visibility they need to move fast and move well. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

How You'll Shape Our Story:

Your day-to-day will include

Gathering and transforming data from a variety of sources — including internal databases, external APIs, and surveys, ensuring data is ready for analysis.
Analyzing data using statistical techniques — identifying trends, patterns, and insights that drive smarter business decisions.
Developing data visualizations — creating clear, compelling dashboards and reports that communicate findings to stakeholders in a concise and actionable way.
Partnering with stakeholders — understanding their needs and developing data-driven solutions that address real business questions.
Championing data quality — maintaining and supporting a culture of strong data quality across teams and workflows.
Staying ahead of analytics trends — keeping up-to-date on the latest tools, techniques, and best practices in data analytics.
Mentoring colleagues — coaching co-workers on analytics best practices and helping elevate the team's overall data capability.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

Up to 4 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you know how to break down complex questions and find the signal in the noise.
Technical proficiency — familiar with SQL, Python, and at least one data visualization tool such as Tableau, Metabase, or Power BI.
Eagerness to learn and develop — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and proactively grow your skills.
Great communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and complexity — you navigate unstructured problems with ease and bring clarity to chaos.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team — you're self-driven but collaborative when it counts.

The Kind of Energy We're Looking For:

We're not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We're into people who make things happen.

You lead and listen. Whether you're steering the ship or rowing alongside the crew, you bring others with you and keep communication wide open.
You own your stuff. You don't wait for instructions: you see an opportunity, grab it, and make it better than anyone expected.

You balance hustle with humanity. You love the buzz of in-person teamwork, but you also know when to recharge (pun totally intended 🔋).
You grow on purpose. You're hungry to learn, to stretch, and to build something meaningful, not just rack up LinkedIn bullet points.

💪🏼 Gym membership to help you stay active
⏰ Flexible working hours: you own your time

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies — they're lived every day. At Powerdot, everyone has the space to speak up, challenge the status quo, and make a difference. Your voice powers the future — literally.

Title: Data Analyst Power BI confirmé (H/F)
Description:
CDI


SIBYLONE, société de conseil spécialisée dans les systèmes d’information de synthèse et de pilotage, aide ses clients à tirer toute la valeur de leur patrimoine de données, levier stratégique majeur de développement et de rentabilité.

Notre ambition : rendre les différents acteurs de l’entreprise autonomes dans l’exploitation des données, libérer les usages Métier, pour qu’ils soient en mesure de relever les défis de performance, de couverture de risque, de financement, de conquête client, de RSE… qui s’imposent à eux.

Spécialistes reconnus, nos consultants s’appuient pour cela sur une connaissance approfondie de l’activité business de nos clients, en lien avec nos trois piliers que sont le Métier, la Data et le Projet.

SIBYLONE emploie environ 200 salariés et réalise un chiffre d’affaires de 30 millions d’euros en fournissant des services de haute qualité à de grandes entreprises.

SIBYLONE est une Filiale du Groupe Smart 4 Engineering : Créé en 2020, le groupe compte aujourd’hui 12 marques en France, en Italie, en Espagne et au Portugal dans le domaine de l’ingénierie et de l’IT. Avec près de 3 500 ingénieurs et consultants hautement qualifiés, nous offrons des services dans des domaines porteurs comme le Digital, la Data, l’Intelligence Artificielle, la Cybersécurité, le Cloud et le Software.

Avec nos 3,000 ingénieurs / consultants hautement qualifiés, le Groupe offre ses services dans les domaines très porteurs du Digital, de la Data, de l’Intelligence Artificielle, de la Cybersécurité, du Cloud et des Logiciels.

Contexte

Vous interviendrez en tant que Data Analyst Power BI dans le cadre d’un programme de transformation digitale de la Direction Financière. Notre client grand groupe du secteur bancaire souhaite renforcer son équipe Data pour optimiser le pilotage de la performance financière.

L’objectif est de moderniser les outils de reporting, fiabiliser les données et accompagner les métiers dans une meilleure exploitation des indicateurs clés (KPI). Vous interviendrez au sein d’une équipe dynamique, en lien direct avec les contrôleurs de gestion, les responsables financiers et les équipes IT/Data.

Vos missions

En tant que Data Analyst Power BI, vous interviendrez en proximité avec la Direction Financière pour :


Comprendre les enjeux métiers et l’environnement fonctionnel Finance
Prendre en main et faire évoluer les dashboards existants
Repenser le design et la visualisation des KPI financiers
Participer à la collecte, la transformation et la gouvernance des données
Animer des ateliers avec les sponsors pour recueillir les besoins
Automatiser les traitements et garantir la qualité des livrables
Former et accompagner les utilisateurs dans la prise en main des outils


Compétences techniques attendues


Power BI : expertise en visualisation, storytelling et modélisation
SQL : maîtrise des requêtes complexes
Azure : bonne connaissance de Synapse, SSAS
Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery) : un plus apprécié
Git : pour le versioning et le delivery
Bonne culture BI et sensibilité aux évolutions technologiques


Pourquoi pas vous ?

Profil recherché :


Diplômé d’un bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, Miage, …)
+9 ans d’expérience en tant que Data Analyst ou Consultant BI
Forte appétence pour les métiers de la Finance
Excellent relationnel, esprit d’analyse et sens du service
Autonomie, rigueur et capacité à vulgariser les sujets techniques


Les  Sibylone !

Ce Que Nous Offrons !


Une culture d’excellence : Nous exigeons le meilleur de nos collaborateurs tout en cultivant la cohésion et l’esprit d’équipe.
Moments de convivialité : Séminaires, afterworks, conférences, petits déjeuners…
Actions solidaires : Partenariat avec la start-up spécialisée en RSE Vendredi pour permettre à nos collaborateurs de réaliser des missions auprès d’associations.
Formation continue : Une offre de formation innovante adaptée à nos métiers et expertises (Data, Métier, Projet)
Télétravail : Accord de télétravail en vigueur pour une meilleure flexibilité.

Postulez dès maintenant et rejoignez l’aventure Sibylone !

Title: Data Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

BFS health finance nimmt Mediziner:innen alles ab, was Zeit frisst: Vom Zahlungsstrommanagement über die Sicherung von Honoraren bis hin zur Beratung im Praxismanagement. BFS vertrauen tausende Zahnärzt:innen, Ärzt:innen, Tierärzt:innen, Dentallabore, medizinische Versorgungszentren sowie Chefärzt:innen und Kliniken. Als Spezialist für Finanzdienstleistungen im Gesundheitswesen ist BFS health finance der Wegebereiter für das vernetze Gesundheitssystem der Zukunft in der Unternehmensgruppe Riverty. Riverty ist ein global tätiger Finanzdienstleister und zu Bertelsmann zugehörig.

Stellenbeschreibung

In unserer Rolle als dynamischer Finanzdienstleister im Gesundheitswesen streben wir danach, mit Hilfe von Datenanalysen neue Maßstäbe zu setzen. Bist du bereit, als Data Analyst (m/w/d) Teil eines Teams zu werden, das die Zukunft der Branche mitgestaltet? Dann suchen wir genau dich!

(Senior) Data Analyst (m/w/d)

an unserem Standort in Dortmund und bis zu 80 % mobiles Office

Was dich bei uns erwartet


Dashboards und Berichte in Power BI erstellen, pflegen und stetig verbessern
KPIs entwickeln und implementieren, die unternehmensweit als Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen
Reporting-Landschaft mitgestalten/weiterentwickeln und bestehende Strukturen eigenständig optimieren
Python für Datenanalysen nutzen, um komplexe Zusammenhänge sichtbar zu machen
Ansprechperson für Kundendashboards und interne Analysen sein
Datenanalysen durchführen, um strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen
Mit Fachabteilungen zusammenarbeiten, um Datenanforderungen gezielt zu ermitteln


Qualifikationen

Was du mitbringen solltest


Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Statistik, BWL oder einem verwandten Bereich
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Data Analyst, idealerweise in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Power BI, Python und SQL
Fähigkeit zur verständlichen Visualisierung komplexer Daten
Sicheres Auftreten in Kundengesprächen und Präsentationen
Hohe Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise
Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Zusätzliche Informationen

Was wir mitbringen?


Wir sind voll motiviert: Bei uns findest du abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und eine partnerschaftliche Arbeitsatmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien & Duz-Kultur
Wir leben flexibles Arbeiten: Du kannst deinen Arbeitsort im Rahmen unserer 80% Mobile Office-Regelung innerhalb Deutschlands frei wählen sowie nach Antragsgenehmigung auch bis zu 30 Tage aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten
Wir bieten vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten: Wir unterstützen dich dabei, bei uns deine individuellen Ziele zu verwirklichen
Wir fördern umweltfreundliches Verhalten: Bei uns gibt es ein Cash-Back-Programm für einen grünen Arbeitsweg. Passend hierzu befindet sich unser Bürogebäude in verkehrsgünstige Lage - von der Zug- & U-Bahn Haltestelle ist das Büro fußläufig in nur zwei Minuten zu erreichen
Uns liegt deine Gesundheit am Herzen: Unser ganzheitliches Gesundheitsmanagement bietet verschiedenste Angebote in den Bereichen Ernährung, Bewegung, Psyche, Vorsorge und Arbeitsumfeld
Außerdem gibt’s bei uns: eine strukturierte, vollumfängliche Einarbeitung, sechs Wochen Jahresurlaub, Rundumversorgung mit Getränken und Obst (im Büro), einen Zuschuss zu deinen Lebensmitteleinkäufen, zahlreiche Mitarbeiterrabatte und einen Massageservice


Das klingt nach Deinem Traumjob? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Online-Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Angaben zu Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatum.

Informationspflichten Im Zusammenhang Mit Der Erhebung Deiner Personenbezogenen Daten

Verantwortlicher für den Datenschutz bei deiner Bewerbung ist die in der Stellenausschreibung angegebene Firma. Die Firma verarbeitet deine Daten zwecks Begründung eines Beschäftigungsverhältnisses auf Grundlage des Art. 6 (1) b DSGVO /


26 (1) 1 BDSG.


Die Speicherdauer deiner Daten richtet sich an den Fristen des jeweiligen Landes aus beginnend mit Abschluss des Einstellungsprozesses. Diese findest du hier.

Den Datenschutzbeauftragten der Firma kannst du unter der o.g. Postanschrift erreichen.

Weitere Informationen zum Datenschutz und zu deinen Rechten erhältst du hier.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
My client based in Westmeath is seeking a Data Analyst to join an established and expanding data team. This is a perm role. The position will focus on using data to answer key business questions, improve performance and support better commercial and operational decisions. You'll work with a broad range of datasets and collaborate with teams across data, technology and the wider business.




The role offers plenty of scope to go beyond standard reporting, with an emphasis on investigating data, spotting patterns and providing recommendations that can make a measurable difference. You'll take ownership of analytical requirements from initial investigation through to presenting findings and recommendations.




Key responsibilities will include:

Interrogate and analyse large, complex datasets to answer business questions and uncover useful insights.
Identify patterns, emerging trends, potential risks and opportunities for performance improvement.
Develop analysis that supports commercial, operational and strategic decision-making.
Work alongside Data Engineers to understand data availability, quality and structure.
Collaborate with reporting and visualisation specialists to improve dashboards and management information.
Add context and interpretation to reporting, helping stakeholders understand what the data means and what actions should be considered.
Communicate findings in a straightforward and engaging way to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge.
Help improve data quality, governance and analytical processes.
Investigate opportunities to introduce more advanced analytics, including machine learning and AI techniques.
Contribute ideas and best practices as the organisation continues to develop its data and analytics capabilities.




The successful candidate will have:

5+ years' professional experience working in data analysis, analytics or reporting.
A relevant third-level qualification in areas such as Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems or a similar discipline.
Strong hands-on SQL experience and confidence working with large datasets.
Experience with data extraction, transformation, manipulation and segmentation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn raw data into useful business conclusions.
2+ years' experience using Python or R for data analysis.
A solid understanding of databases, data models and data structures.
Good knowledge of Business Intelligence concepts and reporting practices.
Practical experience with at least one major BI platform such as Power BI, Tableau or Qlik.




Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following would be beneficial:

Financial services or another highly data-driven sector.
Predictive modelling or advanced analytics.
Machine learning or AI-related analytical projects.




You'll be comfortable taking ownership of your workload and working through analytical problems with limited supervision. You'll have the curiosity to dig deeper into the data rather than simply producing reports based on predefined requirements.

You'll also need strong stakeholder skills. The role involves working with people across technical and business functions, so being able to explain analytical concepts and recommendations clearly is essential.

Concevoir et développer des solutions d’analyse avancée pour répondre aux besoins métiers (optimisation des stocks, analyse des ventes, comportement client, etc.).

Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus d’analyse et de gouvernance des données.

7 ans d’expérience minimum en tant que Data Analyst, avec une expertise avérée sur :

GCP (Google Cloud Platform) et BigQuery pour le traitement de données à grande échelle.

dbt pour la transformation et la modélisation des données.

Expérience dans le secteur de la Grande Distribution (un atout majeur).

Title: Experienced Data Analyst (Ad-network)
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Voodoo Ad-Network is an autonomous product of around 30 people that carries the ambitious mission of providing ad network services. One goal is to leverage Voodoo’s first-party data to improve Voodoo’s monetisation. Moreover, the product is growing through new ventures like opening up to external inventory, reaching the external-advertisers market and social-network monetisation through BeReal’s recent acquisition. Thanks to promising results, our ambition is now to scale up the team to support growth.

The Ad Experience team owns the end-to-end quality of the ads delivered by our network, from ad rendering to data collection. It has a strong focus on viewability, tracker integrity and the diagnostic signals that feed our Machine Learning models. It’s composed of mostly senior Software Engineers, Mobile Developers, QA Engineers and Full Stack Engineers who iterate together to detect issues quickly, improve the user-side ad experience and protect the quality of the data flowing back into the product.

Role

We’re looking for an Experienced Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you will:


Work on end-to-end data projects with the Ad Experience squad to improve ad delivery quality, reduce ad-load and rendering failures, and maintain a high data quality.
Monitor SDK diagnostic events and build alerting, anomaly detection and root-cause analyses on top of the Ad Experience datasets.
Build data collection and transformation pipelines, and actionable dashboards.
Analyze large, complex data sets with billions of events representing the behaviour of mobile game players and of our ad network to investigate ad-quality regressions, attribution discrepancies and SDK rollouts.
Design solutions from scratch, iterate quickly, create POCs, and deploy to production rapidly.
Occasionally leverage Python skills and Statistics skills to support A/B tests on ad-experience changes


Profile


You possess substantial experience in analytical roles, ideally within a web or mobile company or the tech or ad tech industry.
You are highly skilled in SQL and have a proven track record of building production-ready pipelines that handle large and complex data sets.
You have solid experience in ETL development.
You have solid experience with DBT.
You have practical experience with Tableau or another standard dashboard platform, and can create dashboards that are shared company-wide, facilitating data-driven decision-making across departments.
Advanced knowledge of statistical tools and models will be considered a significant advantage.
Development skills, particularly in Python, will be considered a significant advantage
You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and are able to balance the tradeoff between time-consuming development and rapid results.
You have a solid problem solving mindset as well as a great track record demonstrating ownership and ability to come up with innovative ideas.
A BA/B.Sc degree in Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economy, or other quantitative fields is mandatory for this role.


Our Stack


DBT; Tableau; SQL; Athena; Spark; Python


Benefits


Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays

It’s composed of mostly senior Software Engineers, Mobile Developers, QA Engineers and Full Stack Engineers who iterate together to detect issues quickly, improve the user-side ad experience and protect the quality of the data flowing back into the product.

Role

We’re looking for an Experienced Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you will:

  • Work on end-to-end data projects with the Ad Experience squad to improve ad delivery quality, reduce ad-load and rendering failures, and maintain a high data quality.
  • Monitor SDK diagnostic events and build alerting, anomaly detection and root-cause analyses on top of the Ad Experience datasets.
  • Build data collection and transformation pipelines, and actionable dashboards.
  • Analyze large, complex data sets with billions of events representing the behaviour of mobile game players and of our ad network to investigate ad-quality regressions, attribution discrepancies and SDK rollouts.
  • Design solutions from scratch, iterate quickly, create POCs, and deploy to production rapidly.
  • Occasionally leverage Python skills and Statistics skills to support A/B tests on ad-experience changes

Profile

  • You possess substantial experience in analytical roles, ideally within a web or mobile company or the tech or ad tech industry.
  • You are highly skilled in SQL and have a proven track record of building production-ready pipelines that handle large and complex data sets.
  • You have solid experience in ETL development.
  • You have solid experience with DBT.
  • You have practical experience with Tableau or another standard dashboard platform, and can create dashboards that are shared company-wide, facilitating data-driven decision-making across departments.
  • Advanced knowledge of statistical tools and models will be considered a significant advantage.
  • Development skills, particularly in Python, will be considered a significant advantage
  • You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and are able to balance the tradeoff between time-consuming development and rapid results.
  • You have a solid problem solving mindset as well as a great track record demonstrating ownership and ability to come up with innovative ideas.
  • A BA/B.Sc degree in Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economy, or other quantitative fields is mandatory for this role.

Our Stack

  • DBT; Tableau; SQL; Athena; Spark; Python

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Swile Lunch voucher
  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
  • Wellness activities in our Paris office
  • Remote Fridays

Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
Shape the Future of Data-Driven Airline Operations

Shape the Future of Data-Driven Airline Operations

At SAS, data plays a critical role in keeping our operation running safely, efficiently, and reliably. We are looking for a curious and driven Data Analyst who wants to turn complex data into meaningful insights that help shape decisions across one of Scandinavia's most dynamic operational environments.

As a Data Analyst within SAS Operations, you will work at the heart of our airline business, partnering with stakeholders across Airline Operations, Ground Handling, Fleet Line Maintenance, Operations Control Center, Resource Management, and Global Line Stations.

You will join our Data Analytics team, where your work will directly influence operational performance, resource planning, and strategic decision-making. This is an opportunity to combine analytical expertise, business understanding, and storytelling skills to create solutions that make a real impact across the organization.

The challenges You will work on

As a Data Analyst, you will transform data into actionable insights that help our stakeholders make smarter and faster decisions.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Designing, developing, and maintaining insightful Power BI dashboards and reports.
Translating business needs and operational challenges into analytical solutions.
Identifying trends, risks, and opportunities through data analysis.
Supporting management with ad hoc analyses and decision-support materials.
Ensuring reporting accuracy, quality, and alignment with business requirements.
Driving process improvements through data-driven recommendations.
Presenting findings and recommendations to leaders and stakeholders across the business.
Turning complex data into clear, engaging, and actionable stories.


What Makes This Role Exciting


Work with data that supports the daily operation of an international airline.
Collaborate with stakeholders across a broad range of operational functions.
Influence business decisions at both tactical and strategic levels.
Be part of a team that is accelerating SAS's journey toward data-driven decision-making.
Help shape new analytics solutions and continuously improve how insights are delivered across the organization.


To be successful we believe you have

You are passionate about using data to solve business challenges and communicate insights that drive action. You enjoy working closely with stakeholders, asking the right questions, and finding opportunities to improve processes and performance.

You Bring


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
A data-driven mindset and attention to detail.
The ability to communicate complex concepts in a simple and engaging way.
Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
A proactive approach to continuous improvement and innovation.


Qualifications

We are looking for someone who has:


At least 2-4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Strong experience with Power BI and data visualization.
Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, pivot tables, and data modelling.
Experience translating business challenges into analytical solutions.
A Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.


It Would Be a Plus If You Have


Experience from the airline, aviation, transportation, or operations industry.
Experience with automation, data modelling, or advanced analytics.
Relevant certifications in analytics, BI, or data management.


Why SAS?

At SAS, you will be part of a company undergoing an exciting transformation, where innovation, collaboration, and data-driven decision-making are key to our future success. You'll work alongside passionate colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and see the impact of your work reflected in the daily operation of Scandinavia's leading airline.

Benefits

We offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:


Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


Our Culture at SAS

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travellers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

Additional information

Ready to join us?

We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, as we review applications and conduct interviews continuously. The position may be filled before the application deadline.

Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we are unable to process applications received via email. All applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

We might use online tests and an on-demand interview tool to give more applicants the opportunity to engage with us.


Employment Type: Full-time (100%) position with a 6-month probation period.
Location: Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm). We value in-person collaboration and expect you to work primarily from the office, while offering flexibility for remote work upon agreement with your leader.


Come and fly with us!

Title: Data Analyst H/F
Description:
Le Poste

En tant que Data Analyst rattaché(e) au Pôle Pilotage commercial de la Direction de la Distribution, vous contribuez à la fiabilisation, la sécurisation et le traitement des données en assurant la consolidation des objectifs commerciaux.

Vous participez également à la production d'analyses et à la valorisation des données au travers d'outils de reporting et de visualisation destinés à accompagner le pilotage de l'activité.

Vos Missions Principales

Vous participez à la consolidation et à la mise à disposition des objectifs commerciaux afin de garantir un pilotage fiable de l’activité :


Vous consolidez les données relatives aux objectifs commerciaux et assurez leur déclinaison à l’ensemble des niveaux de l’organisation (territoires, directions, entités, équipes, collaborateurs).
Vous contrôlez la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées dans le cadre des campagnes annuelles de fixation des objectifs.
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers afin de recueillir, challenger et intégrer les évolutions nécessaires au pilotage commercial.
Vous transformez et valorisez les données issues de différentes sources (notamment Excel) afin d’alimenter les outils de reporting et les tableaux de bord Power BI.
Vous analysez les indicateurs commerciaux pour contribuer à la prise de décision et à l’amélioration de la performance.


Selon les besoins de l’équipe et les demandes entrantes, vous intervenez ponctuellement sur les requêtages et traitements de données nécessaires à la production des indicateurs (maintenance corrective, évolution et création de tableaux de bord, accompagnement des utilisateurs et traitement des anomalies).

Expérience Souhaitée


Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en Statistiques, Informatique Décisionnelle, Data ou en Contrôle de Gestion.
Votre expérience en consolidation annuelle des données dans un environnement orienté Contrôle de Gestion serait un plus à votre candidature.


Qualités personnelles :


Vous appréciez travailler avec des équipes métiers pluridisciplinaires.
Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.
Vous êtes autonome dans la conduite de vos missions et force de proposition.


Outils Informatiques


Vous maitrisez impérativement les modèles décisionnels, le langage SQL et un outil de data visualisation (idéalement Power BI).
Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils digitaux et bureautiques.
Vous serez formé(e) aux logiciels et aux processus internes d’Harmonie Mutuelle.


Nos Avantages


Accord d’intéressement
Télétravail jusqu'à 3 jours par semaine (à partir de 6 mois d'ancienneté)
22,5 jours de RTT par an
Carte déjeuner à 9,50 € (60 % pris en charge par l’employeur) et avantages CSE (enveloppes loisirs, culture, avantages vacances…)
Forfait mobilité durable : jusqu’à 400 € par an (cumulable avec le remboursement de l’abonnement aux transports en commun, dans la limite de 600 euros au total)
Contrat collectif santé et prévoyance
Plan d’épargne entreprise, plan d’épargne retraite et compte épargne temps
Formation : un parcours complet avec une plateforme d’apprentissage en ligne
2 jours d'engagement solidaire par an au profit d’associations


Le processus de recrutement :


Evaluation de votre CV par le recruteur
Entretien téléphonique avec le recruteur
Entretien avec le recruteur et avec votre futur manager
Test de personnalité suivi d’un débrief avec le recruteur


Chez Harmonie Mutuelle, votre métier contribue à une ambition collective : agir sur la santé de tous et prendre soin de chacun !


Nous sommes une entreprise mutualiste à mission et notre engagement est concret, porté par des actions de prévention, de conseil, d'accompagnement et de solidarité qui ont un vrai impact sur la vie de nos adhérents.
Nous encourageons les parcours singuliers : vous pouvez apprendre, évoluer, changer de métier ou de région grâce à la mobilité interne au sein du Groupe Vyv. L'important, c'est que votre trajectoire vous ressemble.
Nous savons que la diversité et l'inclusion sont une force, c'est pourquoi nous cultivons les différences et soutenons chaque individu. Nous luttons activement contre les discriminations et accompagnons, par exemple, nos salariés dans les moments de fragilité (maladies chroniques, aidance…). Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.
Au quotidien, vous évoluez dans un environnement de travail fondé sur la confiance, porté par un management qui valorise l'autonomie, l'écoute et le droit à l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle.
Nous faisons de l'innovation et des usages numériques un levier majeur de transformation de nos métiers au service de nos adhérents. Qu'il s'agisse de projets data et IA, de nouveaux usages digitaux ou de parcours clients repensés grâce à la tech, vous participez à notre transformation, au bénéfice de la santé de tous.

  • Vous transformez et valorisez les données issues de différentes sources (notamment Excel) afin d’alimenter les outils de reporting et les tableaux de bord Power BI.
  • Vous analysez les indicateurs commerciaux pour contribuer à la prise de décision et à l’amélioration de la performance.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe et les demandes entrantes, vous intervenez ponctuellement sur les requêtages et traitements de données nécessaires à la production des indicateurs (maintenance corrective, évolution et création de tableaux de bord, accompagnement des utilisateurs et traitement des anomalies).

Expérience Souhaitée

  • Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en Statistiques, Informatique Décisionnelle, Data ou en Contrôle de Gestion.
  • Votre expérience en consolidation annuelle des données dans un environnement orienté Contrôle de Gestion serait un plus à votre candidature.

Qualités personnelles :

  • Vous appréciez travailler avec des équipes métiers pluridisciplinaires.
  • Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.
  • Vous êtes autonome dans la conduite de vos missions et force de proposition.

Outils Informatiques

  • Vous maitrisez impérativement les modèles décisionnels, le langage SQL et un outil de data visualisation (idéalement Power BI).
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils digitaux et bureautiques.
  • Vous serez formé(e) aux logiciels et aux processus internes d’Harmonie Mutuelle.

Nos Avantages

  • Accord d’intéressement
  • Télétravail jusqu'à 3 jours par semaine (à partir de 6 mois d'ancienneté)
  • 22,5 jours de RTT par an
  • Carte déjeuner à 9,50 € (60 % pris en charge par l’employeur) et avantages CSE (enveloppes loisirs, culture, avantages vacances…)
  • Forfait mobilité durable : jusqu’à 400 € par an (cumulable avec le remboursement de l’abonnement aux transports en commun, dans la limite de 600 euros au total)
  • Contrat collectif santé et prévoyance
  • Plan d’épargne entreprise, plan d’épargne retraite et compte épargne temps
  • Formation : un parcours complet avec une plateforme d’apprentissage en ligne

Nous luttons activement contre les discriminations et accompagnons, par exemple, nos salariés dans les moments de fragilité (maladies chroniques, aidance…). Title: Junior Data & BI Analyst
Description:
En Solcasino buscamos incorporar un/a Junior Data & BI Analyst con una sólida formación cuantitativa y una clara especialización en datos, analítica y Business Intelligence.




Esta posición está especialmente pensada para recién graduados o profesionales en sus primeras experiencias laborales que quieran desarrollarse rápidamente trabajando con datos reales de negocio y participando en la toma de decisiones de diferentes áreas de la compañía.

No buscamos una larga experiencia profesional. Buscamos muy buena base técnica, capacidad analítica, curiosidad y alto potencial de desarrollo.




¿Qué harás?

Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos relacionados con clientes, producto, marketing y operaciones.
Preparar, limpiar y transformar datos para diferentes análisis de negocio.
Construir consultas SQL y realizar análisis utilizando Python.
Crear dashboards, reporting y herramientas de Business Intelligence.
Analizar comportamiento de clientes, segmentaciones, cohortes y tendencias.
Apoyar análisis relacionados con adquisición, CRM, promociones, producto y operaciones.
Detectar anomalías, patrones y oportunidades a partir de los datos.
Ayudar a diferentes departamentos a responder preguntas concretas de negocio.
Transformar información compleja en conclusiones claras y accionables.
Evolucionar progresivamente hacia análisis estadísticos, predictivos y proyectos de mayor complejidad.




Formación académica

Buscamos candidatos con una formación cuantitativa sólida, preferiblemente en:

Matemáticas
Estadística
Matemática Aplicada
Ingeniería
Física
Econometría
Data Science
Informática con fuerte componente cuantitativo
O titulaciones similares

Además, valoraremos especialmente una especialización adicional en áreas como:

Business Intelligence
Data Analytics
Data Science
Estadística aplicada
Big Data
Analytics Engineering

Será especialmente valorable contar con un Máster en Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Science o similar.

Nos interesan especialmente perfiles que combinen una fuerte base matemática o estadística con una formación práctica en BI y análisis de datos.




Conocimientos técnicos

Buscamos una buena base, académica o práctica, en:

SQL
Python aplicado al análisis de datos
Excel avanzado
Herramientas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Tableau, Looker o similares
Estadística aplicada
Preparación, limpieza y transformación de datos
Visualización de datos
Modelado de datos

No es necesario tener experiencia profesional previa con todas estas herramientas, pero sí una buena base técnica y muchas ganas de desarrollarse.

Inglés

Es imprescindible un muy buen nivel de inglés hablado y escrito.

La persona debe sentirse cómoda:

Participando en reuniones profesionales en inglés.
Trabajando con equipos y proveedores internacionales.
Leyendo documentación técnica en inglés.
Explicando análisis, conclusiones y recomendaciones en inglés.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos una persona:

Muy analítica y cómoda trabajando con números.
Con fuerte capacidad matemática y lógica.
Curiosa y con interés por entender por qué suceden las cosas.
Rigurosa y atenta al detalle.
Capaz de trabajar con información compleja.
Capaz de transformar datos en conclusiones sencillas y útiles.
Interesada en comprender el negocio, no únicamente en generar reporting.
Con muchas ganas de aprender y desarrollarse rápidamente.
Proactiva y con capacidad para cuestionar los datos cuando algo no encaja.

Valoraremos especialmente

Proyectos académicos o personales relacionados con datos.
Experiencia con Pandas y NumPy.
Buen nivel de Power BI.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos.
Conocimientos básicos de Machine Learning.
Experiencia académica trabajando con grandes datasets.
Conocimientos de bases de datos.
Conocimientos de APIs o pipelines de datos.
Uso de herramientas de IA aplicadas al análisis.
Haber desarrollado dashboards o modelos analíticos en proyectos académicos o personales.

No es necesario haber trabajado anteriormente en el sector gaming.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

La oportunidad de comenzar y desarrollar tu carrera trabajando con datos reales dentro de una compañía digital en crecimiento.

No queremos que esta posición se limite a preparar informes.

Buscamos desarrollar progresivamente una persona que pueda convertirse en una referencia analítica dentro de la compañía, combinando datos, estadística, Business Intelligence y conocimiento del negocio para ayudarnos a tomar mejores decisiones.

Desde el inicio tendrás exposición a problemas reales de negocio relacionados con clientes, marketing, producto y operaciones.
