Westborough, MA. Hybrid schedule.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Administration & Finance Support Services (Access) Team, the Data Analyst is responsible for developing analysis, reporting, and dashboard capabilities that support operational and strategic decision-making across Administration & Finance.

The Data Analyst will collaborate with data and analytics professionals across the Administration & Finance function, as well as product owners/stakeholders, and A&F leadership, to understand business requirements and translate them into effective analytics solutions. The position will monitor data quality and performance, validate data for accuracy and consistency, and identify opportunities to strengthen reporting processes and controls.

Working closely with IT and other technical partners, the Data Analyst will support the development of data models and the automation of data workflows and reporting processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability. The position is also responsible for designing and developing intuitive, insightful dashboards, reports, and presentations that effectively communicate key performance indicators (KPIs), trends, and actionable insights to stakeholders and leadership.

Essential Functions


Design, develop, maintain, and enhance interactive dashboards and data visualizations that effectively communicate key metrics, trends, and insights.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities, and translate findings into meaningful and actionable insights.
Acquire, integrate, and prepare data from multiple sources for analysis and reporting.
Perform data validation and quality assurance to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data; investigate discrepancies and collaborate with IT and other technical partners to resolve data issues.
Develop and maintain KPI calculations, business rules, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistent and accurate reporting.
Identify opportunities to streamline and automate data preparation, validation, and recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across Administration & Finance to understand business requirements and develop appropriate analytical solutions.
Conduct ad hoc analyses and prepare reports, presentations, and analytical summaries that clearly communicate findings to managers and leadership.
Maintain documentation of data sources, calculations, business rules, reporting processes, and identified data issues and resolutions.
Perform testing and validation of new data sources, data models, system enhancements, and reporting solutions to ensure accuracy and alignment with business requirements.
Perform other related duties and support special projects and initiatives as assigned.



Other Functions

Perform other duties as may be assigned.

BS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics.
1-3 years' experience as a data analyst or business data analyst.
Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
Advanced skills in creating interactive and visually compelling dashboards and reports that communicate data insights and findings clearly to business stakeholders.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Power Query), Python, or R.
Knowledge of data governance, compliance, and reporting best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Adept at queries, report writing, and presenting findings.



Preferred Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education, Experience)


Master’s degree in a related field



Working Conditions


Hybrid work environment. Primarily located at the UMass President’s Office located at 50 Washington St., Westborough, MA with remote work.
Must be able to travel occasionally to all UMass campuses and the Boston central office.



Additional Details

All offers are contingent on the successful completion of a background check.

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

The Business Data Analyst turns operational and product data into reliable reporting, actionable insights, and decision-support tools. The role works across cloud data warehouses, transformation pipelines, and BI platforms to define metrics, investigate performance, and improve how teams use data.

You will partner with product, operations, finance, and engineering stakeholders to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analysis. The team needs someone who can write production-quality SQL, validate data across source systems, and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain complex SQL queries, data models, and recurring reporting workflows in Snowflake, BigQuery, or a comparable cloud data warehouse
Build and manage dashboards in Looker, Tableau, or Power BI that track product, customer, operational, and financial performance
Define metric logic and business requirements with stakeholders, documenting source data, calculation rules, ownership, and known limitations
Analyze trends, cohorts, funnels, and anomalies using SQL and Python to identify drivers of performance and support business decisions
Validate data pipelines and reporting outputs by reconciling source systems, investigating discrepancies, and partnering with data engineers on quality fixes
Automate recurring analyses and reporting processes using Python, dbt, scheduled queries, or workflow orchestration tools
Present concise recommendations to leadership and functional teams, connecting analytical findings to measurable business outcomes


What We Are Looking For


3–6 years of experience in business analytics, data analysis, product analytics, operations analytics, or a related role
Advanced SQL skills, including CTEs, window functions, query optimization, data validation, and analysis across multiple relational data sources
Hands-on experience with at least one BI platform such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI, including dashboard design and governed metric definitions
Working proficiency in Python for exploratory analysis, automation, and data manipulation with libraries such as pandas
Experience working with modern data stacks, including Snowflake or BigQuery and transformation tools such as dbt
Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, business analytics, or a related quantitative field
Bonus: Experience with Amplitude, Mixpanel, Segment, Airflow, Git, experimentation analysis, or SaaS and marketplace business models

Title: Data Analyst - Digital (Customer Insights & Analytics)
Description:
OVERVIEW:

Data Analyst on the Domain Analytics Team, part of M&T’s Customer Insights & Analytics Organization. We provide analytical insights that empower Marketing and Digital Product organizations to drive business growth, strengthen customer relationships, and accelerate digital adoption.

Our work spans:


Experimentation & Measurement – Designing and analyzing tests to optimize customer acquisition for Retail and Business Banking segments.
Cross-Channel Analytics & Attribution – Understanding how customers interact across channels and identifying what drives engagement.
Digital Journey Analytics – Uncovering insights from web and app behaviors to improve customer experiences.
Digital Product Enablement – Partnering with product teams across the development lifecycle to support new feature launches with data and performance measurement.
Data Products & Ad-Hoc Analysis – Building dashboards and self-service tools, and delivering quick-turn insights to answer business questions.


The Data Analyst will partner with Digital Product and Technology teams to deliver data products, insights, and scalable reporting solutions that enable data-informed decision-making. This role will support the full digital product lifecycle by measuring performance, monitoring customer engagement, evaluating new features, and providing analytical guidance for both strategic roadmap initiatives and operational priorities.

LOCATION:

This role follows a hybrid work model, requiring onsite presence four days per week at one of M&T Bank’s regional offices. Candidates must reside within a reasonable commuting distance to one of the following locations:


345 Main Street, Buffalo, NY
115 Federal Street, Boston, MA
1 Light Street, Baltimore, MD
1350 I Street NW, Washington, DC
1100 North Market Street, Wilmington, DE
277 Park Avenue, New York, NY
850 Main Street, Bridgeport, CT
77 Pine Street, Burlington, VT


POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:


Explore, mine, and profile data across multiple datasets to gain and interpret insights for use in dashboards, ad-hoc analysis and analytics products.
Support digital platform modernization initiatives by designing and validating reporting, dashboards, and tracking solutions for migrations to new platforms and data sources.
Collaborate with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders to translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Support high‑quality analytics delivery by conducting data quality checks, collaborating on data model design, and applying best practices for code documentation and storage.
Develop business intelligence solutions designed to meet business needs.
Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.
Design, implement, maintain, and enhance internal controls to mitigate risk on an ongoing basis. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.
Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.
Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED:


Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience, or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 7 years higher education and/ or work experience, including a minimum of 3 years related experience
Intermediate SQL, experience querying databases (SQL Server, Snowflake, etc).
Experience working in large databases
Experience with Business Intelligence/Visualization tools (PowerBI, Tableau)


IDEAL QUALIFICATIONS PREFERRED:


1 or more years related work experience in data analysis, bonus if supporting digital product development, operations, or technology organizations.
Experience with programming languages such as Python, SAS
Experience with reporting automation (PowerBI, Alteryx)
Experience with one or more cloud databases.
Experience working within an agile environment

Title: Senior Analyst
Description:
The Senior Analyst is responsible for providing data-driven insight for key business stakeholders, across Coverys internal functional areas. This position will play a key role in the identification of trends that drive strategic and operational decision-making. This will necessitate an in-depth understanding of the business, its data, and corresponding technologies. The Senior Analyst will be responsible for setting, managing and meeting deadlines, ensuring the highest level of data accuracy in all work products.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities


Understand business problems, requirements or expectations and translate them into a data driven solutions.
Use various applications and systems to extract, transform, manipulate, explore, analyze and report data, using data integration/preparation, analytics, modeling, and visualization tools including (but not limited to) PowerBI, Alteryx, Excel, SAS/SQL, etc.
Work with business units to identify areas where reports, dashboards, and advanced analytic methodologies can provide sharper decision making and actionable insights. Work with cross-departmental teams to define metrics, guidelines, and strategies for effective use of algorithms and data.
Develop dashboards and reports for consumption by various levels of users across the organization.
Maintain an in-depth knowledge base in underwriting, claims, business development, and risk management business functions.
Establish links across existing data sources and finds new ways by which disparate data sets can be brought together.
Coordinate data requirements between analytics and IT teams.
Assist in the development of data management policies and procedures.
Assist in finding, evaluating and recommending new data sources and analytic tools. Identify tools that will help end users across Coverys interface more efficiently with large amounts of data.
Assist with developing and creating informative visualizations that intuitively display large amounts of data and/or complex relationships.
Work closely with the Coverys Data Governance body to ensure effective protection, integrity, and high quality of data assets. Analyze data quality issues, identify root causes of data defects, and continually seek ways by which high confidence in Coverys data can be sustained and strengthened.
Work with Data Scientist to assist in data prep and analysis for use in data models.
Simplify and explain advanced analytic work to business users.
Train staff on data definitions, coding structures, data sources and the use of Coverys tools.


Education, Requirements & Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree is required.
Insurance industry experience is required. Experience in healthcare preferred.
At least three years of relevant experience in analytics, informatics or statistics and/or an advanced degree is preferred.
Must possess knowledge of relational databases and reporting/analysis tools.
Proficient in the use of Power BI, Tableau, Excel, SQL or similar tools is required.
Experience with Advanced Analytic Tools a plus.
Ability to not only work well independently, but also to function seamlessly in a team-based, collaborative environment.
A meticulous attention to detail with a commitment to the highest standards of data accuracy, methodology integrity, and ongoing data quality.
Excellent teaming, communication and time management skills are essential.
A demonstrated capability of working on multiple projects simultaneously, with high functionality in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner
Highly self-motivated and directed.
Strong customer service orientation
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and maintain ongoing work authorization throughout employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship, including visa transfers, now or in the future.


Base salary range is $88,561 - $104,190. Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors that are unique to each candidate including location, skill set, experience, qualifications and education.

Title: Lead Data Analyst - Marketing and Customer Experience
Description:
Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp! 

This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast-paced, mission-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world. 

What we’re looking for: 

We're looking for a Lead Data Analyst to craft insightful and compelling data stories, empower business owners across Nexamp to make more effective data-driven decisions, and help build our self-service data platform. As one of the nation’s largest and longest tenured solar and storage owner operators – and one of the few that is fully vertically integrated – our data is a differentiator in the market and a catalyst for future growth. You’ll be solving uniquely challenging data problems, alongside a strong team, and for a company in which the business model and mission are inseparably intertwined: our solar farms save customers money, help the planet, and are profitable for Nexamp and its investors. 

You will be hybrid out of our Boston office. You will report to the Director, Product Management - Data.

What you’ll do:  

Independently gather requirements for, prioritize, deliver, maintain, and continuously improve reusable data models, dashboards, analyses, A/B tests, and other data assets. Act as the product manager and implementer for your domain-specific marketing and customer experience team's data offerings - including a customer acquisition and retention forecast. Implement work using advanced SQL and BI tool skills.
Become the subject matter expert for data in your business areas. Identify opportunities for impact, proactively surface insights, support decision-making, and contribute to and influence business strategy and initiatives. Serve as your business stakeholders’ right hand. Support other business areas opportunistically.
Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation and communicate updates to your stakeholders. Write user stories or tickets for data engineering, validate data mapping, conduct QA, and implement data quality monitoring.
Monitor the usage of data assets, increase data literacy, and promote self-service through BI tools among stakeholders. Provide training, guidance, and support as needed.
Work within a centralized data team using agile methodologies. Collaborate with peer analysts through overlapping work, priority shifting, and code reviews to broaden your Nexamp knowledge.
Partner with the data architect, engineers, scientists, and analysts to shape the vision and roadmap for Nexamp’s data platform. Define and track annual OKRs to measure your impact. 

What you’ll bring:

7+ years of experience as a data analyst serving business owners and collaborating with data engineers (experience in the energy/construction industry is a plus, but not required)
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field would be preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
Advanced in SQL and BI tool administration and usage (experience with Databricks and Sigma are a plus, but not required)
Strong track record of independently solving problems.
Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today.
Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization.   
Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality. 
Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions. 
Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry. 
Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.

At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. Title: Senior Pharmacy Data Analyst
Description:
It’s an exciting time to join the WellSense Health Plan, a growing regional health insurance company with a 25-year history of providing health insurance that works for our members, no matter their circumstances.

Job Summary

The Senior Pharmacy Data Analyst is a highly experienced and results-driven professional who plays a critical role in advancing the strategic objectives of the Pharmacy Department. Reporting to the Manager of Pharmacy Contracting and Reporting, this role operates with a high degree of autonomy and precision, leveraging deep expertise in pharmacy data analytics to deliver timely, actionable insights that drive operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and member health outcomes.

This individual is a master of data strategy—skilled in SAS, SQL, and advanced Microsoft tools—with a proven ability to architect complex data models, streamline reporting processes, and lead cross-functional initiatives. The Senior Analyst is responsible for developing and maintaining enterprise-level dashboards, overseeing regulatory submissions, and serving as the Pharmacy Data Steward, ensuring data integrity across systems and stakeholders.

With a minimum of 10 years of industry experience, the ideal candidate demonstrates exceptional analytical acumen, strategic foresight, and a commitment to producing high-quality deliverables efficiently and independently. This role demands a proactive leader who can translate complex data into compelling narratives, influence decision-making, and support cost-effective, data-driven pharmacy benefit management.

Our Investment In You


Full-time remote work
Competitive salaries
Excellent benefits


Key Functions/Responsibilities


Develop and maintain a centralized dashboard for tracking pharmacy financial, operational, and clinical performance measures.
Lead the process of regulatory reporting from development, validation, and submission collaborating with vendor partners to ensure data accuracy.
Conduct data queries to monitor performance metrics, including Medicare STAR measures and quality improvement initiatives.
Oversee PBM submission of all Part D claims to CMS as PDEs, identifying discrepancies and resolving errors to ensure 100% alignment.
Assume the leadership role of Pharmacy Data Steward, advising cross-functional departments on data exchange specifications and serving as the subject matter expert for pharmacy data integrity.
Support program processes by conducting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) testing.
Collaborate with Pharmacy Department team members to identify, prioritize, and analyze customer needs and requests to include the development and execution of sophisticated data-driven strategies that are closely aligned with the company's overarching mission and strategic objectives
Communicate effectively with internal cross-functional areas regarding pharmacy programs, formulary management, and pharmacy processes.
Document workflows, perform analysis, and contribute to the design of systems to meet Pharmacy data needs.
Deliver compelling presentations of findings and insights to internal stakeholders, effectively communicating complex concepts in a clear, concise, and persuasive manner using Utilize leading BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Architect and implement intricate data models, data flows, and data integration processes to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and efficiency of data collection, storage, and retrieval mechanisms.
Engage collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, data scientists, and developers, to identify optimization opportunities and develop innovative, data-driven solutions.
Utilize leading BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI to create dynamic, visually compelling reports and distribute actionable insights effectively.
Harness advanced tools such as Excel (including VBA), Python, or R to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data with precision and sophistication.
Other duties as assigned


Supervision Received


General direction and supervision by Manager of Pharmacy Contracting and Reporting


Qualifications

Education Required:


Bachelor's degree in mathematics, information management, information systems, statistics, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.


Education Preferred


Master's degree preferred.


Experience Required


Minimum of 5 years of healthcare experience.
Working knowledge of industry coding standards (e.g., generic product indicators, national drug codes, GPI’s, etc.).


Experience Preferred/Desirable


Minimum of 10 years in health insurance or with a PBM
Working knowledge of industry coding standards (e.g., generic product indicators, national drug codes, GPI’s, etc.).
Extensive experience analyzing pharmacy claims data, formulary utilization, and drug cost trends.
Familiarity with Medicare Part D data, STAR measures, and PDE submissions
Required Licensure, Certification or Conditions of Employment:
Successful completion of pre-employment background check


Competencies, Skills, And Attributes


Excellent written and verbal communication skills, adept at presenting complex data insights to senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners.
Advanced technical proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, Power Query), with strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis. Skilled in additional BI and reporting tools (Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent).
Deep understanding of IT and business processes, with proven ability to translate clinical and operational requirements into actionable technical solutions.
Demonstrated ability to influence, consult, and build consensus across multiple stakeholders, driving collaboration between business, IT, and vendor teams.
Strong clinical and operational problem-solving skills with experience in synthesizing large, complex datasets into actionable insights and executive-ready reports.
Proficient in designing, developing, and automating queries, dashboards, and ad hoc reports that support strategic decision-making.
Committed to data integrity, accuracy, and quality, with meticulous attention to detail and validation processes.
Quick to adopt new systems, tools, and analytic approaches, consistently staying ahead of industry trends and best practices.
Ability to organize, synthesize, and analyze large volumes of information.
Skilled at prioritizing multiple initiatives, managing timelines, and delivering high-quality outputs in fast-paced environments.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to producing analytic products of the highest accuracy.
Strong interpersonal skills with a track record of thriving in collaborative, team-based environments.


Working Conditions And Physical Effort


Ability to work OT during peak periods.
Regular and reliable attendance is an essential function of the position.
Work is normally performed in a typical interior/office work environment.
No or very limited physical effort required. No or very limited exposure to physical risk.


Compensation Range

$77,000 - $111,500

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, skills, and certifications/licensure as they directly relate to position requirements; as well as business/organizational needs, internal equity, and market-competitiveness. In addition, WellSense offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), merit increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family wellbeing.

Note: This range is based on Boston-area data, and is subject to modification based on geographic location.

About WellSense

WellSense Health Plan is a nonprofit health insurance company serving more than 740,000 members across Massachusetts and New Hampshire through Medicare, Individual and Family, and Medicaid plans. Founded in 1997, WellSense provides high-quality health plans and services that work for our members, no matter their circumstances. WellSense is committed to the diversity and inclusion of staff and their members.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. WellSense participates in the E-Verify program to electronically verify the employment eligibility of newly hired employees

Responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to develop immersive stories that answer business questions. Using proven and sound statistical methods, the analyst draws insights from data, and translates those insights into action that drive business results. Data Analysts are extremely resourceful and able to find novel new data sources to enrich their analysis. They apply mathematical and statistical methods to business and risk management problems. Mine, process, and summarize data; Manage the quality assurance of data scraping, query databases for stakeholder requests, and triage data issues for timely resolutions; Analyze large datasets, draw valid inferences and prepare insights in narrative or visual forms, including dashboards; Set up and maintain data processes and new analytics capabilities; Produce and track key performance indicators; Ability to formulate functional and technical requirements from business problems; Program management of key tasks and resources to achieve cost and schedule.

Skills

Create and maintain interactive data analytics dashboards to measure and improve operations performance
Collect, analyze, and summarize data to communicate insightful information to key stakeholders
Work closely with leadership team, IT team, and other key stakeholders
Present thorough and detailed reports to identify areas of opportunity to drive future decision making
Perform data validation and maintain integrity of dashboards and databases
Maintain and optimize current Tableau dashboards
Complete Ad-hoc research request from senior leadership

Bachelor’s degree and 1-2 years of experience

Experience in Manufacturing, or Business Intelligence (BI) / Data Warehousing (DW) industry

Proficiency in SQL coding

Proficiency with Excel/MS Office Suite

Interest in machine learning or Natural Language Processing

Able to perform specialized data investigations to support analytics and custom reporting scenarios

Able to focus on results

Ability to interact and communicate effectively with colleagues on requirements

Ability to work independently as well as with a team

Energetic and a self-starter

Ability to obtain a secret security clearance within 1 year, which requires U.S. citizenship

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Data Analysis, Mathematics, or Business Analytics

Experience with SAP HANA

Experience with cloud-based data solutions (AWS preferred: EMR, Redshift, S3)

Experience with MS SharePoint

Experience with Grafana

Experience with VMware Tanzu / AWS Openshift

Proficiency with Tableau Desktop and Prep Builder

Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt certification)

Production Operations/Manufacturing background

Title: Lead Customer Insights & Data Analyst
Description:
Job Seekers can review the Job Applicant Privacy Policy by clicking here (http://ryder.com/job-applicant-privacy-policy) .

Job Description

The Customer Insights & Data Analytics Lead Data Analyst is a highly experienced technical resource responsible for leading complex analytical initiatives and translating large internal and external data sources into actionable insights that support Ryder’s Marketing team and broader business objectives. This role combines advanced analytical expertise with the ability to lead analytical workstreams and guide projects from concept through delivery. The Lead Data Analyst is responsible for designing and executing complex analyses, integrating data from multiple systems, and developing scalable reporting and analytical solutions. They ensure that insights are clearly communicated to stakeholders and leadership, translating technical findings into meaningful business recommendations. The Lead Data Analyst is expected to proactively identify opportunities to enhance data processes, improve reporting methodologies, and expand the team’s analytical capabilities. They must be comfortable working with large datasets, managing complex analytical requests, and collaborating across the organization with partners in Marketing, Sales, IT, and other business units to drive impactful insights and successful outcomes. The Lead Data Analyst is responsible for planning and executing complex analytical initiatives, including developing project plans, managing timelines, and ensuring successful delivery of key outputs. They proactively communicate progress, challenges, and results to stakeholders and leadership to maintain alignment and drive successful outcomes.

Responsibilities


Lead the design, development, and delivery of advanced dashboards, reporting solutions, and analytical products to support executive leadership and key strategic initiatives. Own project planning, including defining scope, timelines, and deliverables, and provide guidance on complex ad hoc reporting requests to ensure outputs deliver actionable insights.
Design, enhance, and oversee scalable reporting frameworks across multiple product lines and business segments, ensuring consistency, usability, and alignment with evolving business needs. Manage associated workstreams and timelines to ensure successful implementation.
Lead comprehensive customer and market analyses across Ryder business units, including customer and market sizing, share analysis, growth trends, segmentation, and other advanced analytical initiatives that support Marketing strategy and decision making. Drive these initiatives from planning through execution and delivery.
Establish and reinforce best practices for data accuracy and integrity, supporting periodic audits, validation processes, and quality checks to ensure the reliability of reporting and analytical outputs. Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!



Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.



What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!



Who we are:

Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments in higher education. We’ve since scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.



Today we support more than 5,100 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.



With over 1,200 global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 12 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.







Job Description



The Opportunity



We, at Flywire, are looking for a smart, analytical thinker who's excited to wow our clients with best in class data and analytics capabilities. As a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst, you will help set the vision and direction for how we communicate the story of Flywire's data to our clients, both with interactive in-app reporting solutions and custom analytics projects that speak to the unique value and ROI that our product has delivered throughout our partnership.



This is a true cross-functional role, with responsibilities crossing data & analytics, product development, relationship management, and sales. The ideal candidate will feel comfortable managing cross-functional projects and also have a deep technical understanding of a general BI stack and will be able to periodically contribute to development and analysis.



The responsibilities of the role include:



Help set a broad company vision for the way we communicate data and our value proposition to clients
Partner with business stakeholders to understand unique client situations and deliver analyses to show the value of Flywire's value and performance
Lead the design and development of customer-facing dashboards
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure that reporting and analytical solutions are secure, scalable, and part of a seamless user experience


Qualifications



Here's What We're Looking For



5-7 years of experience in business intelligence, product management, data and analytics, or a related field
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams
Strong experience with business intelligence tools is required, with a preference for Looker and Sigma
Comfortable presenting to both internal and external stakeholders
Strong communication skills: You can make even the most complex data easy to comprehend
Emerging data science and analytical skills
Familiar and comfortable with emerging AI technologies, digital assistants for natural language queries, and core LLM tools
Strong business acumen by connecting data and dashboard design decisions to revenue, client retention, and broader company strategy, not just technical execution
Experience working with finance-related data (revenue, billing, payments, or similar financial reporting) and translating it into stakeholder-ready insights
Experience working with client or CRM data (e.g. Salesforce) to build a unified view of client relationships and usage patterns


Additional Information



Submit today and get started!



We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager and other Flymates. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for questions.

The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and several other factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education and training.

Under the direction of the Program Director or designee, the Health Care Data Analyst is responsible for developing and maintaining financial, claim-related and program performance reporting database(s), reports and processes, applying their knowledge of state and federal requirements and detailed program guidelines and reimbursement methodologies. Operational duties include completion of tasks required to ensure quality and accuracy of health care claiming and cost reporting data and preparation of financial and other claim-related reporting in a deadline-driven and fast-paced environment. Develop and maintain data-driven financial, claim-related, and program performance reports for internal management and external client audiences.
Perform compliance reviews of program data, including claims, payments, payment or costs settlement report data for quality assurance and program integrity purposes.
Analyze large, complex data sets to quantify and resolve problems, inform management decisions, monitor program changes and their impact, and communicate important information for internal management and external clients.
Apply knowledge of program systems to identify and troubleshoot issues, participate in testing of software changes and assist clients and external users to effectively use the programs systems and applications.
Assist in the design and maintenance of internal controls to ensure quality and accuracy of business units work products.
Compile and review claims, payments and/or other financial data for approval or distribution
Identify and resolve any discrepancies, questions or outstanding issues related to claims, payments or other financial data for approval or distribution including coordination with internal staff, health plans, clients, or systems staff.
Prepare financial/claims data for final submission and ensure the quality of the data is accurate and meets regulatory compliance, financial and/or other contractual requirements.
Apply knowledge of state and federal program requirements, program guidelines and reimbursement methodologies in all aspects of work.
Design and produce ad-hoc reports to meet internal management and client requests for data to inform decision-making and to fulfill public records requests.
Complete and synthesize analysis of claims, payments and/other financial data to report to appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
Utilize verbal and written communication skills to effectively communicate program information and explain requirements and methodology to various clients and external users of Umass Chan systems and applications.
Complete tasks required for the preparation and conclusion of the programs operational, financial or other contractual deadlines including set-up and maintenance of required claiming variables, notifications to clients and other stakeholders of deadlines, claim status, and actions needed.
Preserve confidential, protected health and personally identifiable information and files.
Perform related duties as needed and as assigned.

Bachelor's Level Degree or equivalent in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Health Care Financing, or a related field

Strong analytic and auditing skills.

Title: Senior Customer Operations Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Customer Operations Data Analyst - hybrid role based in Lexington, MA

About Mimecast

The work people build is worth protecting, and it's harder to protect than it used to be. AI agents now move at machine speed with human-level access, and a small slip-up can become a very public one. We disrupt cybercriminal activity before that happens. We think fast, go big, and always demand more of ourselves. We work hard, deliver, and repeat. We grow with real determination and put success well within reach. We push each other to be better and expect to be pushed back, in a community built on respect, where everyone is counted. Work Protected.

Overview

As the analytical backbone of our Customer Experience & Delivery (CxD) organization, you’ll provide the insight that helps leaders across Support, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Renewals make better decisions. You’ll own metrics and reporting for each function, identify risk across the customer base, and deliver timely analysis of operational performance, customer cohorts, process bottlenecks, and emerging issues.

You’ll partner closely with CxD leaders to turn ambiguous business questions into clear, actionable insights. You’ll also work alongside Mimecast’s corporate AI team and CxD’s AI initiatives to define success measures and evaluate the customer and operational impact of AI-driven tools. This highly visible senior individual contributor role is suited to someone equally comfortable building recurring dashboards and pressure-testing a hypothesis with ad hoc SQL.

This role reports to a Manager or Director within CxD Operations & Analytics and is remote or hybrid in line with Mimecast’s location policy.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain recurring dashboards and reporting for Support, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Renewals, covering metrics such as SLA and CSAT performance, ticket volume and resolution time, utilization, engagement, and renewal and retention rates
Analyze usage, support, engagement, and financial data to identify at-risk accounts and segments, refine risk-scoring approaches, and proactively surface emerging trends to CxD leadership
Deliver timely deep-dive analyses of operational performance, customer cohorts, process bottlenecks, and emerging issues, with clear findings and actionable recommendations
Partner directly with CxD function leaders to understand evolving data needs, define and refine KPIs, and translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses
Mine operational data to identify cross-functional trends and connect insights that individual teams may not see on their own
Partner with Mimecast’s corporate AI team and CxD AI workstreams to define success metrics, track project performance, and measure the impact of AI-driven tools on customer and operational outcomes
Validate the accuracy and integrity of data from systems such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk or ServiceNow, and Snowflake, resolving or escalating quality issues at the source
Automate recurring reporting and develop self-service analytics that enable CxD teams to answer routine questions independently


What You'll Bring


A bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Substantial experience independently delivering data analysis, business intelligence, or operations analytics in a complex environment, ideally within customer support, customer success, or professional services
Advanced SQL skills and experience querying and modeling large datasets in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery
Proficiency with a BI and visualization platform such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
Hands-on experience with CRM or customer success platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk, or ServiceNow
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables and complex formulas
Strong business acumen and the ability to translate data into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting findings directly to functional leaders
The judgment and autonomy to manage multiple concurrent requests and prioritize effectively in a fast-moving environment
Experience using Python or R for statistical analysis, forecasting, or risk and propensity modeling is advantageous
Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts, including partnering with data science or AI teams to define and track success metrics, is advantageous
Experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or enterprise technology, particularly building customer health scores or churn and renewal risk models, is advantageous
Familiarity with workflow automation and self-service BI adoption practices is advantageous


The base salary range for this position is $124,000−$186,000 plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location with individual compensation also dependent on factors such as qualifications, experience, and skills. Final offers will reflect these considerations and may vary accordingly.

Belonging at Mimecast

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.

We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.

If you require any adjustments or accommodations due to a disability, or any other reason that may help you in your interview process, please let us know by emailing careers@mimecast.com.

Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.

Title: Senior Analyst, Property Claims Analytics
Description:
Description

The Loss Insights Analytics team sits within US Retail Markets Property Claims organization and is at the center of some of the most consequential decisions in our claims organization. We quantify the financial impact of changes across the full lifecycle of a claim — from first notice of loss through final resolution — including the adoption of new tools, vendors, and process innovations. We are a team of rigorous, intellectually driven analysts who believe that the right question, asked at the right time, is just as powerful as the right answer. If you are energized by complex problems, motivated by meaningful work, and want your analysis to directly shape how one of the world's largest insurers handles billions of dollars in property claims, this is your team.


This role may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location**


Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote.

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior Analyst to join the Loss Insights team. In this role, you will design and execute high-complexity analyses that drive tangible improvements to claims handling processes and financial outcomes. You will serve as a trusted analytical voice to senior stakeholders, translating nuanced data findings into clear, compelling recommendations. This is not just a reporting role — it is a thinking role. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, identify the stories hidden in data, and advocate for evidence-based decisions.

What You Will Do


Drive Financial Insight: Design and conduct moderate-to-high complexity analyses evaluating the financial performance of claims operations, process changes, and newly adopted tools or vendor partnerships across the full claim lifecycle.
Measure What Matters: Build and maintain reporting frameworks that track initiative success, financial performance, and key operational metrics — ensuring stakeholders always have a clear, accurate picture of business outcomes.
Lead Analytical Projects: Own moderately complex, end-to-end analytical projects independently, partnering with Claims Process, Data Office, Product, and other key partners to develop rigorous solutions and see initiatives through to measurable impact.
Turn Data into Action: Synthesize complex, multi-source data into concise, actionable recommendations and present findings confidently to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Shape the Future of Claims: Contribute to a team culture of intellectual curiosity and continuous improvement, proactively identifying new analytical opportunities that enhance customer outcomes and operational efficiency.


What We're Looking For


You are intellectually curious. You don't just answer the question asked — you interrogate it. You are energized by ambiguity, drawn to complex problems, and always looking for the insight beneath the surface.
You are analytically rigorous. You have hands-on experience gathering, interpreting, and synthesizing data across multiple sources. You are proficient in one or more of the following: SAS, SQL, Python, or R — and you know how to use these tools not just to pull data, but to build compelling analytical narratives.
You think critically and communicate clearly. You can translate a sophisticated analysis into a story that resonates with a non-technical audience. You are comfortable presenting to stakeholders and defending your methodology under scrutiny.
You are a proactive, organized self-starter. You manage your own workload with discipline, follow through without being prompted, and thrive in an environment where you are trusted to work independently.
You are a collaborative team player. You bring energy and engagement to the team, invest in the success of your colleagues, and build strong relationships across partner teams.


Qualifications


Bachelor's Degree plus a minimum 3 years, typically 4 or more years of experience, or equivalent, is required. Mathematics, Economics, Statistics or other quantitative field are preferred fields of study.
Advanced knowledge of data sources, tools, statistical principles and methodologies, and techniques.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (VBA, macros, scripts, formulas, data visualization, etc.), PowerPoint, and statistical software packages (SAS, Snowflake).
Must have good planning, analytical, decision-making and communication skills.
Solid understanding of business to improve business outcomes.


About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. Title: Claims Analyst
Description:
The Claims Analyst will be responsible for supporting the effective management of claims portfolios through data analysis, forecasting, and reporting, providing insights into claim trends and financial performance to inform decision-making in line with Group Claims processes.




Responsibilities

Analyze claims data across managed portfolios to identify trends, patterns, and key drivers of loss performance
Support claims forecasting activities, including projections of loss development, reserves, and financial outcomes
Prepare and maintain regular management reporting on claims performance, key metrics, and emerging trends
Partner with Claims, Finance, Actuary, IT, and Operations teams to validate data accuracy and ensure consistency across reporting outputs
Monitor and analyze variances between actuals and forecasts, providing insights and recommendations to support decision-making
Develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models to improve visibility into claims performance
Support the identification and remediation of unreconciled data, reporting, and systems-related gaps impacting claims analytics and forecasting capabilities
Contribute to initiatives aimed at improving consistency and standardization across claims processes, including controls, KPIs, and governance practices
Provide analytical support for portfolio reviews, including evaluation of resource needs, alignment with forecasted claims outcomes, and overview of portfolio performance
Assist in tracking and prioritizing operational and reporting improvements to enhance readiness, scalability, and overall claims performance
Ensure data integrity and compliance with internal controls, reporting standards, and Group Claims policies
Work with external stakeholders to fulfill any claims related requests, including loss runs, data calls and other time-sensitive matters
Support ad hoc analysis requests related to claims performance, portfolio trends, and emerging risks




Requirements

2–6+ years of relevant experience in insurance, claims analytics, or financial/data analysis
Experience working with large data sets, including reporting, trend analysis, and performance monitoring
Strong analytical capability and problem-solving skills, including experience with data modeling, forecasting, and variance analysis
Advanced Excel Skills (e.g., Pivot Tables and Lookup Formulas) proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL ,SAP, or similar analytics platforms) and PowerPoint skills strongly desired
Solid understanding of insurance and/or reinsurance business models, with exposure to claims operations preferred
Strong business writing and reporting skills, with the ability to present insights clearly and concisely
Demonstrated attention to detail and a high level of data accuracy
Ability to translate data into actionable insights to support business decision-making
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across all levels of the Claims, Finance, IT, and Operations teams
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
High level of motivation and creativity to identify and develop new strategies and approaches to problems, creating efficiencies in existing and new processes
Must be legally authorized to work in USA.
Limited travel may be required.

  • Support the identification and remediation of unreconciled data, reporting, and systems-related gaps impacting claims analytics and forecasting capabilities
  • Contribute to initiatives aimed at improving consistency and standardization across claims processes, including controls, KPIs, and governance practices
  • Provide analytical support for portfolio reviews, including evaluation of resource needs, alignment with forecasted claims outcomes, and overview of portfolio performance
  • Assist in tracking and prioritizing operational and reporting improvements to enhance readiness, scalability, and overall claims performance
  • Ensure data integrity and compliance with internal controls, reporting standards, and Group Claims policies
  • Work with external stakeholders to fulfill any claims related requests, including loss runs, data calls and other time-sensitive matters
  • Support ad hoc analysis requests related to claims performance, portfolio trends, and emerging risks


Requirements

  • 2–6+ years of relevant experience in insurance, claims analytics, or financial/data analysis
  • Experience working with large data sets, including reporting, trend analysis, and performance monitoring
  • Strong analytical capability and problem-solving skills, including experience with data modeling, forecasting, and variance analysis
  • Advanced Excel Skills (e.g., Pivot Tables and Lookup Formulas) proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL ,SAP, or similar analytics platforms) and PowerPoint skills strongly desired
  • Solid understanding of insurance and/or reinsurance business models, with exposure to claims operations preferred
  • Strong business writing and reporting skills, with the ability to present insights clearly and concisely
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and a high level of data accuracy
  • Ability to translate data into actionable insights to support business decision-making
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across all levels of the Claims, Finance, IT, and Operations teams
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • High level of motivation and creativity to identify and develop new strategies and approaches to problems, creating efficiencies in existing and new processes
  • Must be legally authorized to work in USA.
  • Limited travel may be required.

Description:
At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet. We do that by creating a people-first culture built on trust, accountability, and transparency; where every employee – regardless of position, role, or identity is treated with respect and given an equal chance to thrive.

Additionally, You Will Enjoy


Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance; we also offer a company-paid health care concierge service to help navigate our health plan to make the best decisions for you and yours
401(k) with company match
Paid vacation, sick, personal and parental leave time
Paid Volunteer Time: giving back to our communities is important to us
Employee Recognition Program – convert your recognition points into gift cards
Employee Assistance Program – offers benefits to help you manage daily responsibilities
Access to on-demand training courses to advance further in your career


Job Description

We are looking for a talented individual…

To join our team! CLEAResult's Strategic Energy Management (SEM) team is expanding, and we have a new opportunity for a Data Analyst to help power the work of our SEM experts across the US and Canada. If you love digging into data, spotting patterns others miss, and building the tools and templates that make a whole program run smoother, this is a great place to make an impact.

As a Data Analyst, you'll be the engine behind the scenes for our Statistical Analysts and SEM program teams across North America, supporting energy modeling, standardizing processes, and keeping our data clean, consistent, and ready to drive real decisions. This role is primarily internally facing and centered on data analysis, with occasional interaction with clients and end-use customers to gather data or answer questions. You'll play a central role in bringing consistency and efficiency to how our SEM teams work internationally, directly supporting the accuracy and quality of the models and reports our program depends on.

Here at CLEAResult, you will fit right in with our energetic team if you are resourceful, resilient, and kind.

In this role, you will…


Perform pre- and post-modeling data review and manipulation to support our Statistical Analysts.
Manipulate and format production data with precision and consistency.
Analyze large data sets to catch errors and ensure accuracy before it moves downstream.
Integrate data into statistical software templates.
Collaborate with internal and external teams to build and maintain database files.
Partner with program teams across the organization to create and maintain standardized templates for energy modeling and program data.
Write clear work instructions for newly developed templates, so others can pick them up with ease.
Track, draft, edit, and quality-control final models and reports.
Help automate data processing to save time and reduce manual error.
Troubleshoot, modify, and build tools using Visual Basic and Excel formulas.
Manage and manipulate data in Smartsheet.
Support benchmarking reporting and contribute to the development of our digital infrastructure.


For this exciting career opportunity, you're a great fit if you have…


Strong data manipulation and formatting skills, with an eye for consistency and detail
Experience analyzing large, complex data sets
Comfort working with statistical software and templates
Proficiency in Visual Basic and advanced Excel formulas
Experience with Smartsheet
SharePoint experience
A collaborative mindset, comfortable working across internal teams and occasionally with external clients and customers
Energy industry experience preferred, but not required


Please note: sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Us:

American Technology Consulting (ATC) is a service-first tech company dedicated to helping businesses unlock their full potential through innovative technology solutions. We empower organizations to leverage data for smarter decisions and meaningful impact. At ATC, we foster a culture of growth and invite passionate individuals to join our team, contribute to impactful projects, and excel as data-driven problem solvers. We embrace diversity and welcome candidates from all educational and professional backgrounds, including recent Master’s graduates without prior technical experience.




Job Overview:

As an Entry-Level Data Analyst at ATC, you will be at the forefront of turning raw data into actionable insights. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to work on real-world challenges, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and apply your problem-solving skills in a supportive and innovative environment.




Key Responsibilities:

Collect, clean, and organize data to prepare it for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and correlations using statistical and analytical tools.
Develop insightful dashboards, visualizations, and reports using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Excel.
Assist teams in making data-driven decisions by presenting clear and concise insights.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.
Ensure data accuracy and consistency through validation and quality checks.
Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and new data tools or technologies.




Qualifications:

Master’s degree.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and a willingness to learn data visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI.
Excellent communication skills to present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
Candidates must have U.S. work authorization.




Preferred Qualifications:

Internship or project experience in data analysis or visualization.
Familiarity with SQL for querying and managing databases.
Knowledge of statistical concepts and tools like Python or R (a plus but not required).




What We Offer:

Career Growth: Opportunity to advance in a dynamic and supportive work environment.
Mentorship: Guidance and training from experienced professionals in the field.
Diversity in Projects: Work across various industries and innovative technologies.
Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive salary, health insurance, and other perks.




Work Authorization Support:

H1B sponsorship or related visa support for eligible candidates.
Applications from individuals on F1/OPT are welcome.




Equal Opportunity Commitment:

ATC is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive.

Title: Environmental Data Analyst - EOH Group
Description:
ERG is a research and consulting firm that provides a wide range of support to federal, state, and commercial clients. ERG offers multidisciplinary teams with nationally recognized skills in engineering, science, economics, public health, informational technology, and communications. We hire people with the best minds and then provide them with a vibrant and flexible environment in which to develop their careers. The qualified individual must be highly motivated with the skills to prioritize, perform, and communicate effectively in a fast-paced environment. 




ERG’s Environmental and Occupational Health Group has an immediate opening for an early career professional to join our multi-disciplinary team. This individual will support a range of environmental and sustainability-related projects, including a clean energy grant program. The qualified individual must be highly motivated with the skills to prioritize, perform, and communicate effectively in a fast-paced environment. Responsibilities include managing large datasets, working with applicants to meet grant program requirements, using grant management software and related database applications to support client needs, and interfacing directly with clients.




 




Ideal candidates will have direct experience developing and supporting data visualization tools; conducting independent research and data analysis; and providing client services. 




Job Description:


Review clean energy grant applications for eligibility and completeness


Process payment requests and interface with applicants throughout the grant process


Identify and categorize potential application errors and communicate them to applicants and clients


Help develop and maintain a public-facing government data dashboard


Analyze, collect, and organize data to support greenhouse gas, energy, and water reduction projects, benchmarking, and reporting


Research and develop briefing materials on sustainability topics, including decarbonization and building and fleet electrification


Provide additional data analysis and technical communications support on environmental, sustainability, and public health topics







Qualifications and Skills:


Bachelor’s degree in environmental science or a related field


Minimum of one year of experience working with environmental or sustainability-related data


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other data management tools preferred


Experience with data visualization software, such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik Sense


Familiarity with energy efficiency improvements, water conservation measures, and greenhouse gas emissions inventories


Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, including experience drafting technical reports and presenting findings


Experience working with and managing large, complex datasets


Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary team


Strong interpersonal skills with a customer service focus


Ability to take initiative, stay organized, and manage multiple tasks










ERG offers competitive salaries and excellent benefits, including health and dental insurance, life insurance, long-term disability, educational benefits, FSAs, a generous 401k plan, profit sharing, an EAP, 11-20 paid vacation days per year, 10 paid holidays per year, 56 hours or more of sick leave (based on the state you work in) per year (pro-rated for part-time) and more. The salary range for all positions depends on the years and type of experience. 

  

ERG is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable EEOC regulations. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual preference, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.  

   

Please be aware, the only authentic corporate domain for ERG is https://www.erg.com.  ERG may, on occasion, screen applicants via telephone or video interviews via Skype, Teams, GoToMeeting, or another type of video platform. However, any candidate extended a job offer might be asked to meet in person with an ERG employee before providing confidential personal information associated with new employment. 

  

If you’re a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access ERG’s online application process as a result of your disability. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources via email at Resumes-Lex@erg.com or call (781) 674-7293. 

  

ERG fosters a friendly, flexible work environment. ERGers are dedicated to serving clients who are committed to making the world a better place. We promote and recognize principles of fairness and respect in the work we do, the partnerships we foster, and the culture we value both within and outside of our organization.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst to support grants management operations and reporting across Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH). The Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst will serve as a liaison between grants management stakeholders, technical teams, and system business analysts ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data within the grants management system and related applications. This role will manage data elements, system interactions, and reporting requirements while developing dashboards, management reports, and analytics for leadership and other stakeholders. The position will define and oversee the reporting pipeline for the various grants operations groups, including the selection, validation, and integration of data elements from the grants management system into the enterprise data warehouse to support consistent reporting and analytics. The role will collaborate closely with Grants Administration, Finance, Compliance, Information Systems, and other ancillary groups to support informed decision-making, process improvement, and the effective use of grants management and compliance data. Successful candidates will have demonstrated experience with enterprise data lake queries (like SnowFlake), familiarily with ELT processes, report and dashboard design, and ad hoc reporting using SQL tools and PowerBI.

Leverages software applications to design solutions, performs detailed data mapping and analysis and reviews all data for accuracy and reasonableness prior to distribution. Produces business, research or clinical intelligence.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:


Manages one or more complex data projects. Utilizes hospital systems and database applications to update and analyze data. Prepares and distributes various reports to key stakeholders. Meets with departmental leadership to review reports or requests for data.
Maintains integrity and quality of data and assures data conformity meets operational requirements and goals. Acts as a central resource and integral member of data collection team. Assists in planning, establishing and monitoring criteria for data collection. Trains department staff on data acquisition methods. Extracts data from multiple sources. Audits and resolves all issues.
Ensures application access is in compliance with all regulatory and medical center practices. Acts as gatekeeper for application. Sets and defines user access and determines level of access. Reports all security risks to the application.
Collaborates with IS to obtain and maintain applications used for data collection and reporting. Recommends tools, upgrades and alternatives. Assists in the development of application security and back-up plans. Coordinates interface solution with multiple applications.
Designs and develops reporting and analysis tools. Interprets data and refines analysis. Prepares and presents comprehensive reports. Develops forms, tables and other data tools in the applications that capture, report and consolidate data. Provides application data collection, analytics and reporting expertise. Completes analytics in a timely and efficient manner.
Prepares weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports/dashboards and/or data submissions department.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Allied Health, or related field.
3-5 years related work experience required.
1-3 years of multiple application maintenance with relational databases.
Advanced technical computer skills as required for technical support specific to functional area and related systems.


Preferred Qualifications


Application Certification for one of the applications used in the department.


Competencies

Written Communications:

Ability to summarize and communicate in English moderately complex information in varied written formats to internal and external customers.

Oral Communications

Ability to comprehend and communicate complex verbal information in English to medical center staff, patients, families and external customers.

Knowledge

Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge of concepts, practices and policies with the ability to use them in complex varied situations.

Teamwork

Ability to act as a team leader for small projects or work groups, creating a collaborative and respectful team environment and improving workflows. Results may impact the operations of one or more departments.

Customer Service

Ability to provide a high level of customer service to patients, visitors, staff and external customers in a professional, service-oriented, respectful manner using skills in active listening and problem solving. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

Physical Nature Of The Job

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally in carrying, lifting, pushing, pulling objects. Sitting most of the time, with walking and standing required only occasionally.

Pay Range

$74,880.00 USD - $124,800.00 USD

The pay range listed for this position is the annual base salary range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other applicable factors permissible by law.

As a health care organization, we have a responsibility to do everything in our power to care for and protect our patients, our colleagues and our communities. Beth Israel Lahey Health requires that all staff be vaccinated against influenza (flu) as a condition of employment.

More than 35,000 people working together. Nurses, doctors, technicians, therapists, researchers, teachers and more, making a difference in patients' lives. Your skill and compassion can make us even stronger.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled
