Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together.

The Crown Is Yours

As a Senior Finance Data Analyst, you’ll turn complex financial and player activity data into reliable insights that support Accounting, financial reporting, and audit readiness. You’ll partner across Finance, Accounting, Data Engineering, and Analytics to connect operational activity with accurate, reconcilable financial data. You’ll strengthen our control environment by building repeatable processes, improving reporting automation, and maintaining clear data lineage and documentation for critical financial datasets and reports.

What you’ll do as a Senior Data Analyst


Build and automate financial reports, reconciliations, and analyses using SQL in Snowflake and reporting tools such as Tableau and Sigma.
Reconcile player activity, transactional systems, and financial datasets, investigating discrepancies and driving issues through resolution.
Partner with Accounting and Finance during financial close to investigate variances, validate data, and deliver supporting analyses.
Support internal and external audits by preparing data extracts, reconciliations, documentation, and control evidence.
Collaborate with Data Engineering and Analytics to define Finance-critical metrics, transformations, and reporting logic that connect source activity to financial reporting.
Design and maintain data controls, reconciliation procedures, data lineage, and documentation that strengthen the accuracy and integrity of financial reporting.
Shape how financial and operational data flows into the Financial System of Record and downstream reporting as new offerings, features, jurisdictions, and markets launch.
Identify opportunities to automate Finance and Accounting processes and translate reporting requirements into scalable data solutions.



What you’ll bring


A Bachelor’s Degree in a related field and 4+ years of experience in data analytics, financial analytics, accounting analytics, or another similar field.
Advanced SQL expertise, and experience analyzing large, complex transactional datasets.
Experience supporting financial reporting, accounting reconciliations, financial close processes, audits, or financial controls.
An understanding of financial data flows and accounting concepts with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes.
Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, or Alteryx.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on automation, process improvement, and repeatable solutions.
Strong communication, organization, and attention to detail, with the ability to collaborate across technical, Accounting, and Finance stakeholders.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Gupta Media was founded over 25 years ago on the idea that advertising could create huge leverage in our clients' businesses. Our work initially focused on the entertainment industry, specifically live events and recorded music (SXSW, Sony Music, Universal Music, and Disney Music Group are all clients). We have grown to include global brands (Amazon, Sophia Learning), major sports franchises (X Games, Florida Panthers, Washington Commanders, Cleveland Cavaliers, Women’s Tennis Association), as well as public sector institutions (City of Boston, Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism).




We are on the hunt for a talented Data Analyst I to join our Strategy & Analytics team to assist with reporting, tracking, data analysis, advertising strategy, and visualization needs. In this role, you will work internally to assist paid media analysts with reporting requests and externally to provide clients with insights into their advertising campaigns.




The ideal candidate is inherently resourceful. We need someone who enjoys the "instruction manual" level of detail and views a technical hurdle as a problem to be solved rather than a roadblock. When you encounter a gap in your knowledge, you have the drive to research, test, and figure out the answer. We want someone who doesn't just want to run reports, but wants to build a better, faster version of them.




Who You Are:

You have no problem tearing apart complex problems and living inside spreadsheets, data sets, or documentation to find the answer to any question
You bring a strong technical toolkit, including SQL, Excel, Google Data Studio/Data Visualization, and enjoy working with SQL on a day-to-day basis
You are technically curious and resourceful. You have a natural ability to navigate and understand technical documentation—whether it’s for an API, a piece of software, or a new platform—and use it to troubleshoot or build new solutions. Experience with Marketing APIs, BigQuery, Snowflake, ETL tools (Rivery, Supermetrics), or Python is a significant plus
You communicate with clarity. You can take the deep-dive technical work you do under the hood and explain the logic, the solution, and the results to a non-technical audience without losing the meaning
You have a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 1 year of experience working with complex datasets, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Experience with marketing data or paid advertising is a plus




What You’ll Do:

Analytics & Visualization: You will design and maintain customized dashboards that transform thousands of lines of data into clear, visual stories. You’ll be responsible for translating complex performance media metrics into digestible, client-ready reports via Google Sheets, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Media Strategy: You will learn our clients’ businesses inside and out to align their media strategy with overarching business goals. You’ll identify advertising trends across projects to help guide media buying decisions and optimize spend.
Data Integrity: You will collaborate across teams to ensure our tracking and measurement frameworks are scalable, accurate, and best-in-class, acting as a bridge between raw data and strategy.
Strategic Consulting: You will use your understanding of concepts like LTV, ROAS, and Incremental Revenue to lead discussions with clients, gaining trust and shareholder buy-in on media strategy and results.




Work Environment

Gupta Media is an office-first organization.




Our Commitment

At Gupta Media, we work hard every day to be better at all that we do — and that includes fostering a diverse and inclusive community that encourages and respects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.




Compensation

At Gupta Media, base salary is one component of our total compensation and benefits package. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000 - $85,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan, which is based on the company's performance.




We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and pet insurance; Flexible and Dependent Care Savings Accounts; a 401(k) with up to 5% Safe Harbor contributions; paid time off; paid family leave; commuting and wellness stipends; and opportunities for professional development and career growth.




Candidates must be authorized to work in the US.

Title: CEMA Business Intel Analyst
Description:
Job Description


Do you love to improve business processes and drive improvement through data analytics? Are you looking for a role that supports a diverse and growing portfolio developing and producing the most advanced electronic systems that protect our warfighters? Are you inspired to join an organization with a strong culture that’s focused on ensuring we hear all voices, being brilliant on the basics, and developing our teams and leaders? BAE systems put our customers first – exemplified by our mission “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®. Come join our team!

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst who will partner with a diverse team of directors, managers, engineers, technicians, and operators to develop solutions for gathering and analyzing data to help overcome challenges and improve business execution. The role requires use of your process knowledge to rapidly translate complex data into actionable insights, improving data accuracy and automation to accelerate ramp to rate, and serve as the factory‑floor liaison to ensure that quantitative findings lead to tangible quality and throughput gains. Candidates must have strong analytical, statistical, and communication skills, a solid foundation in manufacturing processes, and thrive in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.



Key Responsibilities



Partner with cross‑functional teams to turn production data into insights that boost product yield, flow, and cost efficiency.
Be a spokesperson for the factories and get involved in the design, testing, and implementation of dashboards and other data tools with the Analytics Team.
Use data analysis to determine areas for improved process yields, flows, on-time delivery and cost savings measures.
Work directly with the process and product teams to implement improvements.
Champion the implementation of AI solutions and assistants to the factory end users.


If you want an exciting opportunity in a fast-paced environment, where you can partner with a diverse team and contribute to our mission, then this position will provide tremendous professional and personal satisfaction.



Required Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related work experience
Experience with manufacturing standards, processes and techniques
Strong technical skills in data analysis
Strong communication skills
Experience working in cross functional teams
Experience using dashboards and reporting for business intelligence
Experience using GenAI models for analysis




Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a technical field
Background in data analytics or data science
Experience with Mat lab, Python, SQL, or other programming language
Experience in project management
Process or Product Engineering experience
New product introduction experience
Proven success with change management in a fast-paced, manufacturing environment



Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $118095 - $200762

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems Electronic Systems


BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

Title: Customer Insights Analyst
Description:
Reporting to: SVP, Strategic Analytics

Department: Strategic Analytics

Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Grand Circle Corporation is the leader in international travel, adventure and discovery for Americans aged 50+. Headquartered in Boston MA, and with more than 35 offices globally, more than two million Americans have traveled with our award-winning travel brands: Grand Circle Cruise Line, Overseas Adventure Travel and Grand Circle Travel.

We’re looking for a Customer Insights Analyst to transform how we understand and predict customer behavior. Embedded within the Strategic Analytics department, you will use data to shape brand development and bring value to customers and business teams. This role sits at the intersection of advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and business strategy.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze customer behavior patterns to identify actionable insights and opportunities for targeted marketing interventions
Collaborate with data engineering and BI to ensure data quality and reporting accessibility
Define and monitor KPIs that align with business objectives
Build conceptual dashboards that track customer journeys and identify optimization opportunities
Partner with brand, marketing, and other business teams to translate analytical findings into measurable business impact
Tell data-driven stories that convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations
Develop predictive models for key business metrics including churn, lifetime value, and propensity scoring
Design and run experiments to test hypotheses about customer engagement and measure impact of strategic initiatives


Qualifications


2+ years in data analysis, preferably in a subscription or loyalty focused B2C environment
Advanced SQL proficiency (complex queries, window functions, and optimization)
Strong statistical foundation with hands-on experience in regression, classification, clustering, and time series analysis
Proficiency in Python or R for analysis and modeling
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker, or similar)
Proven ability to communicate the results and recommendations of your analysis to senior leadership
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or quantitative field


Technical Skills


Experience working with cloud data warehouses and large-scale datasets
Proficiency with version control and collaborative development practices
Understanding of data pipeline concepts and ETL processes
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms and services
Knowledge of data governance and security best practices


Nice to Have


Experience with customer data platforms or marketing automation
Knowledge of machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow)
A/B testing and experimental design expertise
Familiarity with causal inference methodologies and experimentation techniques
Prior experience in travel or hospitality industry


Total Rewards

The base salary range for this role is $110,000 – $130,000 annually for employees based in Boston, MA. Final compensation may vary and will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for an annual incentive bonus and first-class benefits, which include:


Health & wellness: Comprehensive and heavily subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans, plus on-site gym access, holistic wellness sessions, and group fitness classes
Time for you: Substantial Paid Time Off (PTO), and 11 paid holidays- including Juneteenth, Memorial Day, and Labor Day – and Summer Fridays. Plus- extensive parental leave, with up to 12-16 weeks paid leave at 100% base salary.
Travel more, spend less: 50% off our trips for you and a companion, 25% for additional immediate family members, and exclusive quarterly associate travel deals
Your future, secured: 401(k) with company match, life insurance, and disability coverage
Continuous growth: Tuition assistance for both professional and personal development, opportunities for professional development through oversees travel, and direct access to Pinnacle Leadership & Team Development.
Extra perks: Commuter benefits, FSA options, pet insurance, home & auto discounts, and paid volunteer time off to give back to the community


To learn more, please visit our websites at www.gct.com, www.oattravel.com and www.grandcirclefoundation.org.

Title: Associate Data Analyst
Description:
At MarketOnce, we empower businesses with the insights and strategies they need to excel in today's dynamic market. With a strong foundation in market research, we offer innovative solutions in research, software, consulting, advertising, and marketing to corporate, private equity firms, and other organizations seeking to achieve their goals.

Our team is distinguished by their client-centric approach—treating each client's business with the dedication and care as if it were their own. This commitment enables us to deliver personalized service and achieve the highest standards of success and innovation in everything we do. Together, our family of companies, including MarketOnce, ROI Rocket, and eAccountable, work towards delivering unparalleled solutions. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, our global team collaborates from locations across the US and Europe.

We value curiosity, creativity, collaboration, and expertise, continuously striving to push boundaries and exceed our clients' expectations. Join us to be part of a culture that drives meaningful results.

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a data analyst with a minimum of three years’ experience to clean, structure and process data from primary market research. An understanding of quantitative marketing research techniques, tools, processes, and procedures is preferred. Experience in primary market research is required. You must have strong interpersonal and organizational skills and be detail-oriented, flexible and above all, collaborative. The range of duties includes enforcing data quality control protocols, cleaning and structuring data sets, generating data cross tabulations and conducting a variety of analytical procedures.

In this role, you will be working closely with the Sr. Director of Custom Research, various Research Managers, the Director of Marketing Sciences, fellow Data Analysts and various Publishing department personnel.

What You'll Do


Clean and structure complex data sets in SPSS/alternate platforms, including AI-based apps
Analyze/interpret results using common statistical techniques in SPSS and other programs as assigned
Produce client-friendly data cross-tabulations in WinCross, JMP and alternate platforms, including our in-house survey platform, MarketOnce
Perform various quality assurance tasks, including QA on in-progress surveys
Develop and maintain databases/data systems
Develop new process improvements as necessary


What We’re Looking For


3+ years of relevant experience as a data analyst/data processor with a track record of high performance
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to plan, prioritize, manage, and effectively deliver on multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment
Understanding of market research processes highly desired
Strong knowledge of and experience with statistical packages for analyzing large datasets, specifically, SPSS, R, WinCross and/or Excel
Knowledge of Python, Javascript and/or XML helpful but not required provided you can demonstrate an understanding of survey logic and the potential to acquire the necessary expertise
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
BS or MS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics
Superior customer focus, and willingness to work evenings and weekends if needed to support our clients
A can-do, positive and collaborative attitude, with a willingness to support the development of team members across the organization


What We Offer


Competitive base salary: $72,000-$90,000/year
Flexible vacation policy – take the time you need to recharge
Comprehensive health, vision & dental insurance
401k with company contribution
Beautiful downtown Denver office with company-paid commuter benefits (parking or RTD/MBTA Pass)
Opportunity for career progression with plenty of room for personal growth


What To Expect


1st Round: 30-45 minute interview with the Recruiter
2nd Round: 60-minute interview with the Hiring Manager
3rd Round: 2 hours of onsite interviews with the Hiring Team


Please note that we are fully onsite work environment, and require daily presence at our LoDo/Union Station (Denver) or Back Bay (Boston) office. We are not considering remote, hybrid, or out-of-area candidates, and do not work with outside recruiting agencies.

MarketOnce will accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis.

MarketOnce is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We are committed to hiring individuals based on their skills and qualifications, regardless of race, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic. We welcome and encourage applications from all backgrounds.

At MarketOnce, we empower businesses with the insights and strategies they need to excel in today's dynamic market. With a strong foundation in market research, we offer innovative solutions in research, software, consulting, advertising, and marketing to corporate, private equity firms, and other organizations seeking to achieve their goals.

Our team is distinguished by their client-centric approach—treating each client's business with the dedication and care as if it were their own. This commitment enables us to deliver personalized service and achieve the highest standards of success and innovation in everything we do. Together, our family of companies, including MarketOnce, ROI Rocket, and eAccountable, work towards delivering unparalleled solutions. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, our global team collaborates from locations across the US and Europe.

We value curiosity, creativity, collaboration, and expertise, continuously striving to push boundaries and exceed our clients' expectations. Join us to be part of a culture that drives meaningful results.

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a data analyst with a minimum of three years’ experience to clean, structure and process data from primary market research. An understanding of quantitative marketing research techniques, tools, processes, and procedures is preferred. Experience in primary market research is required. You must have strong interpersonal and organizational skills and be detail-oriented, flexible and above all, collaborative. The range of duties includes enforcing data quality control protocols, cleaning and structuring data sets, generating data cross tabulations and conducting a variety of analytical procedures.

In this role, you will be working closely with the Sr. Director of Custom Research, various Research Managers, the Director of Marketing Sciences, fellow Data Analysts and various Publishing department personnel.

What You'll Do

  • Clean and structure complex data sets in SPSS/alternate platforms, including AI-based apps
  • Analyze/interpret results using common statistical techniques in SPSS and other programs as assigned
  • Produce client-friendly data cross-tabulations in WinCross, JMP and alternate platforms, including our in-house survey platform, MarketOnce
  • Perform various quality assurance tasks, including QA on in-progress surveys
  • Develop and maintain databases/data systems
  • Develop new process improvements as necessary

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of relevant experience as a data analyst/data processor with a track record of high performance
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to plan, prioritize, manage, and effectively deliver on multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment
  • Understanding of market research processes highly desired
  • Strong knowledge of and experience with statistical packages for analyzing large datasets, specifically, SPSS, R, WinCross and/or Excel
  • Knowledge of Python, Javascript and/or XML helpful but not required provided you can demonstrate an understanding of survey logic and the potential to acquire the necessary expertise
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
  • BS or MS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics
  • Superior customer focus, and willingness to work evenings and weekends if needed to support our clients
  • A can-do, positive and collaborative attitude, with a willingness to support the development of team members across the organization

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary: $72,000-$90,000/year
  • Flexible vacation policy – take the time you need to recharge
  • Comprehensive health, vision & dental insurance
  • 401k with company contribution
  • Beautiful downtown Denver office with company-paid commuter benefits (parking or RTD/MBTA Pass)
  • Opportunity for career progression with plenty of room for personal growth

What To Expect

  • 1st Round: 30-45 minute interview with the Recruiter
  • 2nd Round: 60-minute interview with the Hiring Manager
  • 3rd Round: 2 hours of onsite interviews with the Hiring Team

Please note that we are fully onsite work environment, and require daily presence at our LoDo/Union Station (Denver) or Back Bay (Boston) office. We are not considering remote, hybrid, or out-of-area candidates, and do not work with outside recruiting agencies.

Title: Clinical Data Analyst
Description:
The Clinical Data Analyst (CDA) is a mid-level individual contributor role that supports the Data Sciences department in identifying requirements and building solutions towards enhancing clinical study data reporting and analytics capabilities.  This role will support in the development of advanced analytical solutions, better supporting internal and external stakeholders needs in summarizing clinical study data. This role will also enable operational quality and efficiency through the generation and analysis of departmental operational and performance metrics.




 




Reporting Standards Management


Lead the creation & development of a standard library of reporting and/or analysis solutions (report, dashboard, visualization, or other) for Data Sciences and other stakeholders


Gather requirements from a cross-functional group to a particular study question or operational activity


Build & configure solution to meet the requirements


Lead validation activities to prepare reporting solutions for release/usage


Gather (as needed) and collaborate with volunteer stakeholder group to support validation activities


Contribute to the Data Standards Governance Committee (DSGC) for the management of standard reports


Maintain ongoing updates to standard report templates


Support training for the Data Sciences team of new standard reports/solutions







Study-Specific Reporting Deployment


Deploy standard reporting solutions for use on a study-specific basis


Create & develop ad hoc reporting and/or analysis solutions – report, dashboard, visualization, or other – as requested by study team members


Gather requirements from study team member(s) for ad hoc solutions


Build & configure ad hoc solutions to meet the requirements


Support report requestor in validation activities of study-specific ad hoc solutions to prepare for release/usage


Support long-term maintenance of study-specific solutions and contribute to investigating issues, as raised by study team members







Department Operational & Performance Analysis


Identify requirements with Data Sciences leaders to measure & monitor operational and performance metrics


Design, build, and maintain metrics governance within Data Sciences


Work with large data sets to analyze operational & study data and deliver reporting that outline areas for process & performance improvement/optimization (inefficiencies, inaccuracies, and other issues) to Data Sciences leadership







Technical Systems


Participate in the strategy, management and integration of data reporting systems that impact Data Sciences, including the assessment, integration, build of vendor systems and Alimentiv technologies


Act as a technical system subject matter expert; perform validation and testing of systems


Help gather and determine requirements for relevant technical systems, with cross-functional groups or other Business/Process analysts. Work closely with other technical roles (Data Management, Database Programming, Statistics, Enterprise Analyses, etc.) to drive data governance and excellence


Assess ways to further leverage existing systems to optimize internal efficiencies and processes


Support Data Sciences contribution to a Data Warehouse, contributing to key decisions and strategy


While evaluating new projects or requests for enhancements, help determine the project cost, timeline, goals and feasibility and then support the project through completion







Qualifications


Minimum of a Bachelor's degree + 4-6 years of related experience


Strong analytical skills


Visual design and aesthetic sense to produce appealing and intuitive outputs


Proficiency with data visualization tools (i.e., PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc)


Skilled data storyteller to communicate complex information in clear and effective manner


Strong collaborator


Preference to certificate in data analysis, data visualizations, or technical solutions (i.e., PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc.)


Preference to prior Clinical Research and/or Clinical Data Management experience







Working Condition


Home-based

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Principal People Data Analyst
Description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

Reporting to: SVP of People Operations

Location: Boston, MA office (hybrid)

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal People Data Analytics Analyst to lead advanced people analytics and workforce insights, with Workday serving as the backbone of our people data ecosystem.

This role will be responsible for turning Workday data into strategic insights that inform workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee retention, compensation, and broader People strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with the People Leadership Team, HR Technology, Finance, business leaders, and other stakeholders to ensure that Workday data is trusted, well-governed, accessible, and translated into meaningful business intelligence.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in People Analytics and Workday data with strong analytical, technical, and consulting capabilities. This individual will operate as a subject-matter expert, establish analytical standards and best practices, and serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders.

Key Responsibilities


Serve as a subject-matter expert for Workday people data, including the underlying data structures, business processes, organizational hierarchies, worker data, job and position data, compensation, recruiting, talent, and other adjacent technologies.
Use Workday as the primary source and foundation for enterprise people analytics, ensuring that workforce insights are grounded in consistent and trusted data.
Develop and maintain sophisticated analytical datasets, metrics, dashboards, and reporting solutions leveraging Workday data.
Partner with HR Technology and HRIS teams to understand and optimize Workday configuration, data structures, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve Workday data quality, consistency, completeness, and usability for analytics.
Establish standardized definitions and methodologies for critical workforce metrics, using Workday as the system of record wherever appropriate.
Evaluate data flows between Workday and downstream data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, and other enterprise systems.


People Analytics & Strategic Insights


Lead high-impact analytics initiatives addressing complex workforce and business questions.
Analyze workforce data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities across the employee lifecycle.
Develop predictive and advanced analytics to support workforce planning, retention, talent management, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience.
Connect people metrics to business outcomes to help leaders understand the organizational implications of workforce trends.
Develop executive-level dashboards and data solutions that provide clear, actionable visibility into the workforce.
Translate complex analytical findings into compelling recommendations for senior People leaders and executives.


Strategic Partnership


Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior People leaders, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business executives.
Partner with HR Technology, HRIS, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Finance, and other teams to develop integrated workforce insights.
Proactively identify important workforce trends and analytical opportunities rather than relying solely on reporting requests.
Influence strategic decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear executive storytelling.
Lead analytical projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, and implementation.


Data Governance & Analytics Architecture


Help establish and maintain a trusted People data foundation centered on Workday.
Define and document enterprise people metrics, data definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards.
Partner with HR Technology and Data teams to establish appropriate data governance, lineage, quality controls, and access practices.
Identify gaps between Workday data and other enterprise data sources and develop approaches for reconciling and integrating information.
Promote responsible use of employee data, including appropriate privacy, confidentiality, security, and access controls.
Help shape the evolution of the People Analytics data architecture and technology roadmap.


Technical & Analytical Leadership


Leverage Workday reporting and analytics capabilities, including Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, composite reports, dashboards, and other relevant Workday reporting technologies.
Develop visualizations and analytical products using tools such as Visier, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to use predictive analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and other advanced methodologies to improve workforce decision-making.
Mentor analysts and provide analytical and technical guidance across the People Analytics organization.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Deep experience working with Workday as a primary source of people data, including strong understanding of its data model, reporting capabilities, business processes, and organizational structures.
Strong understanding of workforce metrics, HR processes, and the employee lifecycle.
Experience translating Workday data into executive dashboards, analytical models, and strategic insights.
Experience with Workday reporting technologies such as Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and/or advanced reporting capabilities.
Experience working with downstream data warehouses, BI platforms, or enterprise data environments connected to Workday.
Strong statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders.
High degree of discretion and understanding of employee data privacy, confidentiality, and governance.


Preferred Qualifications


Workday certification or significant hands-on Workday reporting experience.
Experience with Workday Prism Analytics or other Workday analytics capabilities.
Experience with Workday integrations and downstream data pipelines.
Experience integrating Workday data with Finance, Finance Planning, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, or other enterprise systems.
Experience with predictive workforce analytics, attrition modeling, workforce planning, or organizational network analysis.
Experience establishing enterprise People Analytics data governance and metric frameworks.
Experience in a complex, global, or rapidly scaling organization.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a trusted, Workday-centered people data foundation that enables leaders to make faster, more informed workforce decisions.

The Principal People Analytics Analyst will ensure that Workday data is not simply reported—it is understood, connected, analyzed, and translated into strategic insight. Leaders should be able to trust the underlying data, understand what the metrics mean, and confidently use the resulting insights to make decisions about people, talent, organization, and business performance.

Core Competencies


Workday & People Data Expertise
Advanced People Analytics
Strategic Thinking
Data Architecture & Governance
Statistical & Quantitative Analysis
Executive Data Storytelling
Business Acumen
Stakeholder Influence
Data Visualization
Problem Solving
Innovation
Collaboration & Mentorship
Judgment & Discretion

Title: Analyst Development Program - Boston,MA/Plano,TX/Seattle,WA (January, June, and September 2027)
Description:
Description

It's a data-driven world. Be part of a rotational development program that harnesses the power of data and cutting-edge technology to analyze performance trends, identify opportunities, and keep Liberty Mutual moving forward.

 

The Details

Do you love telling stories with data? Are you looking to jump into the broad world of analytics? Are you looking to jumpstart your career with a global Fortune 100 company?

Here’s a fantastic opportunity to hone your strategic, technical, and analytical skills while learning the ins and outs of the fast-paced insurance industry.

The Analyst Development Program (ADP) helps aspiring graduates (like you!) develop a broad knowledge base through a curated training curriculum, an established mentorship program, and rotational assignments tailored to your developmental goals. Through both collaborative and independent work, you will begin your career ready to make an impact with your foundation of business acumen, analytical toolbelt, and professional skills all with the support of your instant network in our vast analyst community.

Qualifications

What you’ve got:


You have 0-2 years of related professional experience. 
You hold, or will be completing, a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Business, MIS, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related discipline.
A strong academic record with a cumulative 3.0 GPA preferred.
You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills that fuel your passion for identifying and investigating patterns and trends. 
You possess strong interpersonal, communication, organizational, and leadership skills.

Job Title: Data Analyst – Banking & Financial Services

Company: Aaratech Inc.

Employment Type: Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)

Experience: 3–4 years

Compensation: $70,000 – $80,000 per year

Work Mode: On-Site / Hybrid

Work Authorization

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Why This Role?

Banks run on data — and analysts who understand both the numbers and the regulations behind them are among the most sought-after in the market. Sharpen your skills in risk, fraud, and regulatory analytics, the specialties that command premium pay across financial services.

Job Summary

Aaratech Inc. is seeking a Data Analyst – Banking & Financial Services to turn transaction, credit, and operational data into insight. You will build risk and performance reporting, support fraud and compliance analytics, and deliver findings that drive strategic decisions in a regulated environment.

Key Responsibilities

Gather, validate, and analyze banking datasets — transactions, credit, deposits, loans, and customer data — using SQL and Python.
Design and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for financial performance, portfolio risk, and KPI monitoring.
Support fraud detection, AML/KYC transaction monitoring, and credit-risk analytics.
Prepare data for regulatory and compliance reporting (BSA/AML, CECL, stress testing, call reports).
Perform trend, variance, and root-cause analysis on financial and operational metrics.
Ensure data accuracy, lineage, and governance across reporting platforms.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to business and risk stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
3–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst in banking, financial services, or fintech.
Strong, hands-on SQL skills — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization.
Proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, plus advanced Microsoft Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
Hands-on experience with financial data — transactions, credit, risk, or regulatory reporting.
Strong analytical, data-storytelling, and stakeholder-communication skills.

Tools & Technologies You Will Use

Analytics & querying: SQL (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL), Python (pandas, NumPy), SAS.
BI & visualization: Power BI (DAX, Power Query), Tableau, Excel.
Cloud & data platforms: Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Amazon Redshift, Databricks.
Domain systems: core banking platforms, payments data, AML/fraud monitoring tools (Actimize, Verafin exposure a plus).

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of AML/KYC, fraud analytics, credit risk modeling, Basel or CECL concepts.
Experience with data governance and lineage tools (Collibra, Alation exposure a plus).
Familiarity with statistical analysis and A/B testing for product or risk decisions.
Certifications such as Microsoft PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), Tableau Desktop Specialist, or Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate are a plus.

About Aaratech Inc.

Aaratech Inc. is a technology-driven organization delivering innovative solutions across cybersecurity, data & analytics, healthcare, and enterprise domains. We are committed to helping organizations transform data into actionable insights through advanced analytics, modern technologies, and data-driven innovation.

Title: Sr. Marketing Analyst
Description:
About Us

Founded in 1992 in Dover, NH, Planet Fitness is one of the largest and fastest-growing franchisors and operators of fitness centers in the world by number of members and locations. As of March 31, 2026, Planet Fitness had approximately 21.5 million members and 2,909 clubs in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Canada, Panama, Mexico, Australia and Spain. The Company’s mission is to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment, which we call the Judgement Free Zone®. Approximately 90% of Planet Fitness clubs are owned and operated by independent business owners.

At Planet Fitness, our unique mission has always been to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment. And we’re proud of the amazing Planet Fitness team that supports our clubs and team members. They are comprised of dynamic, dedicated, and talented individuals who represent our values of integrity, transparency, passion, respect, and excellence (while having fun!) in everything they do.

Joining the PF family means being part of a company that cares about bettering the health and wellbeing of our communities. It means being a part of a supportive, engaging workforce with an inclusive culture that values diversity and creates an environment where everyone can feel they belong. It means encouraging professional growth and development. It means making true, lasting connections with your co-workers with celebrations, team building activities and engaging corporate events! It means creating a positive impact in our local communities through our Judgement Free Generation® philanthropic initiative. It means being part of a brand that you can be proud of!

For the past 30 years, we’ve helped millions of people in their fitness journey and revolutionized the industry along the way. And we’re just getting started!




Overview

Reporting to the Director, Marketing Analytics & Data Science, the Senior Marketing Analyst is responsible for supporting marketing strategy and business decision-making through data analysis, performance measurement, experimentation, and reporting.

This role partners with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Technology to evaluate marketing performance, measure campaign effectiveness, and deliver actionable insights that drive member growth, engagement, and marketing effectiveness.

The Senior Marketing Analyst will analyze marketing and member performance, develop insights that drive strategic marketing decisions, build/support dashboards and KPI reporting, design and support experimentation and measurement initiatives, and provide senior leaders with clear insights through skilled data-driven story telling.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities, marketing business acumen, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for translating complex data into compelling, actionable insights and strategies.

This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires regular, in-person work at our Boston, MA or Hampton, NH office. Our hybrid model is M/T/W in office and TH/F are optional work-from-home. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of one of these locations. Fully remote work is not available for this role.




Responsibilities

Marketing Analytics & Performance Measurement

Analyzes marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital channels, campaigns, and member engagement initiatives
Drives measurement of marketing initiatives through KPI development, reporting, trend analysis, and performance insights
Develops analytical recommendations that identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes
Supports testing and measurement initiatives including campaign analysis, segmentation, and performance evaluations
Develops and maintains dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and analytical tools that provide visibility into marketing performance
Monitors key performance indicators, identify trends, and communicate insights to business stakeholders
Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting and analysis.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Co-owns the design, development, and execution of marketing insights and measurement strategy with Marketing Team counterparts
Partners with Strategy, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to support business initiatives through data analysis
Translates analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences
Supports ad hoc analyses and business requests related to marketing performance, member growth, and strategic initiatives.




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, customer analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, marketing science, or a related analytical discipline
Demonstrated experience partnering with Marketing and business leaders to deliver analytics, reporting, and actionable recommendations that influence strategic and operational decisions
Experience analyzing marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, campaign effectiveness, and customer engagement
Strong understanding of marketing measurement methodologies, including attribution, A/B testing, incrementality, customer segmentation, and marketing ROI
Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, reporting solutions, and self-service analytics that improve visibility into business performance
Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex datasets into clear business insights and recommendations
Proficiency with SQL and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar reporting platforms
Experience working with modern analytics and marketing platforms such as Snowflake, Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, CRM platforms, or similar technologies
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and recommend data-driven solutions
Extremely detail-oriented, efficient, and organized with an exceptional ability to establish priorities and objectives
Excellent presentation and written and oral communication skills along with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization
Able to establish and maintain effective, collaborative work relationships with diverse individuals, internally and externally
Dedicated learner with a natural curiosity for consistent growth
Cooperative team player with an upbeat, positive, “can-do” attitude!

Perks

Planet Fitness cares about you and your well-being. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees which includes the core medical, dental, vision, life and disability as well as supplemental accident, hospital and critical illness coverage options. In addition, we are proud to offer eligible employees a generous time off program (including volunteer time), childcare reimbursement, paid parental leave, pet care reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, free Black Card membership, learning and development programs and a whole host of engagement activities. We offer a 401(k) Plan with safe harbor employer matching and an employee stock purchase plan. This role is also eligible to participate in an annual corporate bonus incentive program based on company financial and personal performance.

The salary for MA-based and NH-based employees hired into this role will be aligned with the range below. This is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with a candidate’s professional experience, qualifications and internal equity.

Annual Base Salary Range: $110,000-$135,000




Note to Applicants: We have been made aware of an increasing number of hiring fraud schemes across numerous platforms. Planet Fitness never requires advance payments of any kind for computer equipment or any other purpose at the start of employment. Any request for you to provide payment information during the application process is part of a fraud scheme. Further, we recommend that you do not provide sensitive personal information (SSN, DOB, driver’s license number) as part of the initial application process.

Title: Senior Analyst, Procurement Data & Analytics
Description:
Acute Care Technology

At ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives. We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions.

The Acute Care Technology division of ZOLL Medical Corporation develops and delivers innovative lifesaving products and software solutions to EMS, hospital, public safety, and military customers globally. Products include AEDs, trauma kits, ventilators, temperature management solutions, and more. Our dedicated employees take pride in their commitment to improving patient outcomes while delivering world-class customer service.

At ZOLL, you won’t just have a job. You'll have a career—and a purpose.

Join our team. It’s a great time to be a part of ZOLL!

ZOLL Medical does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need ZOLL immigration sponsorship (e.g. H1B, TN, STEM, OPT, etc.) either now or in the future.

The Opportunity

Procurement has stood up a new Data & Analytics team inside our Center of Excellence, and this is one of its first hires. The team is chartered to build the analytical backbone for the entire Procurement organization — Direct and Indirect Sourcing, Purchasing, Supplier Quality Engineering, and Cost Reduction. As the team's Senior Analyst, you won't inherit legacy reports; you'll build the function's first spend cube, its first live Oracle Fusion Analytics dashboards, and the automated data pipelines behind them.

Your work will be highly visible: the dashboards and insights you build will be the reporting foundation that Procurement and executive leadership rely on to steer cost reduction, supplier performance, and supply continuity decisions across a global medical device business. You'll be a part of a small team, by design, where we push each other to be innovative, forward-thinking and high performing.

What You'll Build In Year One


Spend Cube: Partner with the Data & Analytics Manager to design and deliver Procurement's first spend cube (supplier × commodity × cost center) in Oracle Fusion Analytics
Live Dashboards: Replace manual, ad-hoc reporting processes with live, self-service dashboards for spend, supplier performance, and category views
Product Analytics: Build repeatable product-line dashboards covering forecasting, supplier quality, and supply risk — then automate the data pipelines behind them
Data Quality Foundation: Help establish data ownership, validation, and a "clean in, clean out" standard across Oracle Cloud, Workday Sourcing, and connected systems
Predictive Readiness: Contribute to exception-based reporting and the roadmap toward predictive analytics and AI-readiness


Essential Functions


Develop, maintain, and improve procurement dashboards, reports, and KPI frameworks across all ZOLL ACT sites
Analyze procurement spend across suppliers, commodities, and sites to surface savings opportunities and support cost reduction initiatives
Translate complex, multi-system data into clear, actionable insights for Purchasing, Sourcing, SQE, and leadership stakeholders
Design and automate recurring reporting processes, reducing manual effort and improving data reliability
Develop and maintain supplier performance reporting and scorecards
Support cost and price variance analysis and procurement-related financial metrics
Maintain and validate key procurement and planning data within Oracle Cloud; champion data quality at the source
Analyze demand, supply, and inventory trends to identify material risks and operational impacts
Provide analytical support to buyers and purchasing teams, balancing strategic build work with operational needs


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Engineering, Operations, or a related field
4–6+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, procurement, supply chain, or related analytical functions
Proficiency in SQL and structuring large, multi-source datasets for analysis
Hands-on experience building dashboards in a modern BI platform (Oracle Fusion Analytics, Power BI, or Tableau)
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query and data modeling
Proven ability to convert findings into actionable business insights and communicate them to non-technical stakeholders


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with procurement, sourcing, planning, or inventory data in a manufacturing environment
Experience working within ERP systems, preferably Oracle Cloud
Experience with spend analysis, supplier performance reporting, or KPI development
Exposure to data pipeline automation, exception-based reporting, or predictive analytics


Deep procurement domain expertise is not required — we will teach you procurement. We're prioritizing analytical horsepower, curiosity, and the ability to build.

How We'll Invest In You

This team develops people deliberately. You'll join with a structured 30/60/90-day onboarding plan, a competency framework spanning five priority areas (data modeling, insights generation, visualization, business acumen, and financial acumen), an individual development plan built in your first quarter, and a clear progression path within a growing analytics function. By the end of year one, you'll independently own multiple reporting workstreams.

Location & Work Arrangement

This role is open to remote candidates across the U.S., with periodic onsite collaboration at our Chelmsford, MA site (approximately quarterly, plus onboarding). Candidates local to the Boston area who prefer a hybrid arrangement are equally welcome.

ZOLL is a fast-growing company that operates in more than 140 countries around the world. Our employees are inspired by a commitment to make a difference in patients' lives, and our culture values innovation, self-motivation and an entrepreneurial spirit. Join us in our efforts to improve outcomes for underserved patients suffering from critical cardiopulmonary conditions and help save more lives.

The Annual Salary For This Position Is

$90,000.00 to $110,000.00

Factors which may affect starting salary include geography, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Details of ZOLL's comprehensive benefits plans can be found at www.zollbenefits.com.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until this position is filled. For fully remote positions, compensation will comply with all applicable federal, state, and local wage laws, including minimum wage requirements, based on the employee’s primary work location.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

As the team's Senior Analyst, you won't inherit legacy reports; you'll build the function's first spend cube, its first live Oracle Fusion Analytics dashboards, and the automated data pipelines behind them.

Your work will be highly visible: the dashboards and insights you build will be the reporting foundation that Procurement and executive leadership rely on to steer cost reduction, supplier performance, and supply continuity decisions across a global medical device business. You'll be a part of a small team, by design, where we push each other to be innovative, forward-thinking and high performing.

What You'll Build In Year One

  • Spend Cube: Partner with the Data & Analytics Manager to design and deliver Procurement's first spend cube (supplier × commodity × cost center) in Oracle Fusion Analytics
  • Live Dashboards: Replace manual, ad-hoc reporting processes with live, self-service dashboards for spend, supplier performance, and category views
  • Product Analytics: Build repeatable product-line dashboards covering forecasting, supplier quality, and supply risk — then automate the data pipelines behind them
  • Data Quality Foundation: Help establish data ownership, validation, and a "clean in, clean out" standard across Oracle Cloud, Workday Sourcing, and connected systems
  • Predictive Readiness: Contribute to exception-based reporting and the roadmap toward predictive analytics and AI-readiness

Essential Functions

  • Develop, maintain, and improve procurement dashboards, reports, and KPI frameworks across all ZOLL ACT sites
  • Analyze procurement spend across suppliers, commodities, and sites to surface savings opportunities and support cost reduction initiatives
  • Translate complex, multi-system data into clear, actionable insights for Purchasing, Sourcing, SQE, and leadership stakeholders
  • Design and automate recurring reporting processes, reducing manual effort and improving data reliability
  • Develop and maintain supplier performance reporting and scorecards
  • Support cost and price variance analysis and procurement-related financial metrics
  • Maintain and validate key procurement and planning data within Oracle Cloud; champion data quality at the source
  • Analyze demand, supply, and inventory trends to identify material risks and operational impacts
  • Provide analytical support to buyers and purchasing teams, balancing strategic build work with operational needs

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Engineering, Operations, or a related field
  • 4–6+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, procurement, supply chain, or related analytical functions
  • Proficiency in SQL and structuring large, multi-source datasets for analysis
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in a modern BI platform (Oracle Fusion Analytics, Power BI, or Tableau)
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query and data modeling
  • Proven ability to convert findings into actionable business insights and communicate them to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with procurement, sourcing, planning, or inventory data in a manufacturing environment
  • Experience working within ERP systems, preferably Oracle Cloud
  • Experience with spend analysis, supplier performance reporting, or KPI development
  • Exposure to data pipeline automation, exception-based reporting, or predictive analytics

Deep procurement domain expertise is not required — we will teach you procurement. We're prioritizing analytical horsepower, curiosity, and the ability to build.

How We'll Invest In You

This team develops people deliberately. You'll join with a structured 30/60/90-day onboarding plan, a competency framework spanning five priority areas (data modeling, insights generation, visualization, business acumen, and financial acumen), an individual development plan built in your first quarter, and a clear progression path within a growing analytics function. By the end of year one, you'll independently own multiple reporting workstreams.

Location & Work Arrangement

This role is open to remote candidates across the U.S., with periodic onsite collaboration at our Chelmsford, MA site (approximately quarterly, plus onboarding). Candidates local to the Boston area who prefer a hybrid arrangement are equally welcome.

ZOLL is a fast-growing company that operates in more than 140 countries around the world. Our employees are inspired by a commitment to make a difference in patients' lives, and our culture values innovation, self-motivation and an entrepreneurial spirit. Join us in our efforts to improve outcomes for underserved patients suffering from critical cardiopulmonary conditions and help save more lives.

The Annual Salary For This Position Is

$90,000.00 to $110,000.00

Factors which may affect starting salary include geography, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Details of ZOLL's comprehensive benefits plans can be found at www.zollbenefits.com.

Title: Operations & Analytics Associate
Description:
Company Overview

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

Position Summary

KKR is hiring for an enterprise Data Operations group to collect, manage, and harness the power of data across our diverse business activities. The Data Operations Center of Excellence (CoE) is a cross-functional team dedicated to formulating and driving KKR's enterprise data strategy while also providing the operating leverage required to bring these strategies and frameworks to life.

We are hiring an Associate / Senior Analyst within the Data Operations CoE focused on Data & Analytics. This individual will sit at the intersection of business and technology, combining strong data analytics capabilities with a solid understanding of private markets and credit to deliver insights, reporting, and data solutions that support investment and operational decision-making across the firm.

The ideal candidate brings 4+ years of experience in data analytics or data science. They are comfortable partnering with both business stakeholders and technology teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable, data-driven solutions. A genuine interest in private markets, credit, and alternative investments is essential, and experience applying AI and automation to improve workflows is a strong plus.

Responsibilities


Data Analytics & Insights: Design, build, and maintain analytical models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that support private markets and credit investment teams, translating complex data into clear and actionable insights
Business Partnership: Serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams, gathering requirements, defining analytical use cases, and ensuring delivered solutions meet business needs
SQL & Data Development: Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data across multiple sources and platforms, ensuring data quality and consistency
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with data engineering, technology, and operations teams to design and implement scalable data pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure that underpin analytics and reporting
Private Markets & Credit Support: Develop domain expertise in private markets and credit data, including deal, portfolio, fund, and investor data, and apply that knowledge to improve data coverage, quality, and analytical depth
Process Improvement & Automation: Identify opportunities to streamline manual workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve the efficiency and reliability of data processes across the team
AI & Innovation: Explore and apply AI tools, large language models, and emerging technologies to enhance analytical workflows, accelerate reporting, and unlock new capabilities for the business


Qualifications


4+ years of experience in data analytics, data science, or a related field
Proficiency in SQL with demonstrated ability to write complex queries, build data models, and work across large-scale datasets
Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or equivalent cloud data warehouse) and BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Sigma, Tableau)
Working knowledge of Python with the ability to read, interpret, and contribute to Python-based data pipelines and analytical scripts
Experience partnering with data engineering or technology teams to design, build, and operationalize data solutions
Demonstrated ability to work in business-facing roles, translating stakeholder needs into analytical frameworks, reports, and data products
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical findings to non-technical audiences
Intellectual curiosity and interest in private markets, credit, and alternative investments
Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, self-starter mindset and high attention to detail
Strong cultural fit (teamwork, results-oriented, proactive, and high integrity)


Preferred Qualifications


Direct experience in private markets, credit, or alternative investment data and analytics
Hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, or large language models to improve business workflows and data processes
Background in financial services, asset management, or fintech
Working understanding of dbt (data build tool) for managing data transformations, building modular analytics pipelines, and maintaining well-tested, version-controlled data models
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows


This is the expected annual base salary range for this Boston-based position. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

Base Salary Range

$100,000—$130,000 USD

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Description

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

Realtor.com is a two-sided platform helping match the consumers on our site and apps to our paying customers. The Data Science & Analytics team at Realtor.com provides trusted data and insights to optimize every aspect of consumer/customer experience and to drive the company’s commercial performance.

Avail Realtor.com is a fast-growing platform transforming how independent landlords and tenants manage the rental experience. Built with the spirit of a startup and backed by the scale and stability of a leading digital real estate company, Avail provides a complete suite of tools, resources, and education to help landlords manage their properties with confidence and professionalism. As part of the Avail team, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact – shaping the future of this rapidly expanding brand and helping to reimagine the rental industry for millions across the U.S..

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst with a strong background in business intelligence and strategic analytics to help shape the future of Avail. As a trusted partner to the Avail leadership team, you will be the vital link between complex data and pivotal business moves, striving to enable and empower data-driven decision making across the business.

In this role, you will analyze large and complex data sets, define and track business KPIs, build automated reporting solutions, conduct robust analyses, generate actionable insights, and deliver clear recommendations that inform critical decisions across strategy, product, marketing, and operations.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented analytics expert, a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, and a team player who excels in cross-functional collaborations, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and driven by a desire to make things better.

What You'll Do


Partner closely with Avail business stakeholders to understand/clarify needs and requirements, and translate them into analytical problems.
If the required data is not available, work with the team to identify the right data sources, and build analytical data layers in collaboration with the data engineering partner.
Independently conduct end-to-end data analytical work from data collection, ETL, analysis, to the delivery of insights and recommendations.
Serve as Avail’s Business Intelligence expert and own KPI development, measurement, tracking, and reporting. Closely monitor KPIs and carry out deep-dive analysis to explain changes and trends, and surface areas of opportunities.
Own and run regular business performance reporting, and actively contribute analytics-related content to business reviews and other reports.
Build automated reports and dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Mixpanel, etc.
Build and grow adoption of self-service solutions that empower stakeholders to access data and insights, and hence accelerate data-driven decision making.
Conduct market and competitor analysis using a variety of internal and external data sources.
Work with Avail leadership team on strategic initiatives and planning, providing analytical support on financial modeling, forecast, opportunity sizing, and so on.


What You Bring


Bachelor’s degree, ideally in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
6+ years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role.
SQL proficiency is a must, with 6+ years of experience.
Proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets for quick reporting and ad hoc analysis.
Strong capability to work with complex data sets and perform EDA, descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analyses.
Experience with cloud-based data environments such as Snowflake and AWS.
Significant experience creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Mixpanel, Power BI, or similar tools.
Proven experience using data and analytics to drive revenue and other business KPIs, and doing so in a proactive manner by actively seeking to identify opportunities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to diverse technical and business audiences at different levels.
Experience in collaborating with cross-functional partners.
Experience managing multiple priorities, responding to urgent data requests, and adapting to changing business needs and priorities.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
Proficiency with a scripting language such as Python or R.
Experience in the tech sector, especially marketplace or property tech.


How We Work

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.

How We Reward You

Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to:


Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage
Family forming benefits
13 Paid Holidays
Flexible Time Off
8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off
Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3.5% company match
Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non-degreed programs
1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions
Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program
Free snacks and refreshments in each office location


Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com®

Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow.

Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Permanent Full Time

As a Data Analyst, you will join Canada Life’s Canada Operations & Business Enablement, Data Analytics and Reporting team. In this role you will support all Canada Operations and Business Enablement teams with the development, implementation, and maintenance of analytics solutions ranging from descriptive and diagnostic to predictive.

The Analyst, Data & Analytics supports decision making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will assist in modelling, analysing, and predicting business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements, collect, integrate, clean, explore, model, and analyze large datasets and visualize results and present to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Work with large datasets that are not consistent, clean, or fully modelled
Communicate effectively and demonstrate critical thinking and business acumen.
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner
