1-3 years of relevant experience and a bachelor’s degree in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification is preferred
Demonstrated experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualisation tools (Power BI) with experience at creating interactive dashboards
Ability to write efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate, and transform data from multiple sources, and to automate data pipelines
Proficiency in Power BI, Data Modelling, Power Query, and DAX
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Good knowledge in data analytics and statistical modelling
Strong communication and presentation skills
Proven ability to learn quickly and independently and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0247289

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to the Navy to understand their data and support Fleet readiness.

As a client-facing data analyst embedded with a DOW client, you’ll work closely with our customers to understand their data questions and then dig into their data-rich environments and tools to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise the client on what the information means by developing decision-making support visualization products and dashboards to help translate data into recommendations. You will use automation tools and scripts to streamline data processing and reporting.

What You'll Work On:


Provide clear, timely data analysis and trend insights for leadership in a fast paced environment and preparing written analysis.
Analyze data across various subject areas to develop a complete data picture for non-technical leadership and clients.
Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data is accessible and organized to support analysis, trend forecasting and alerting needs.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies, and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, interpretation, evaluation, and analysis of large data sets.
Establish quantitative/qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive decision-making.
Create visualizations and dashboards, such as graphs, tables, and maps, across multiple platforms to communicate findings effectively.
Produce recurring and rapid-turnaround reports and analysis, including responses to high-priority leadership and congressional requests, across multiple office branches to ensure a holistic understanding and facilitate informed decision-making.
Engage directly with clients to understand their evolving needs, communicate findings clearly, and provide actionable recommendations. Adapt to client feedback and requests, fostering strong professional relationships and supporting informed decision-making at all organizational levels.



Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


3+ years of experience in data analysis or data visualization
Experience in quantitative data analysis, performance measurement, data cleansing, metrics evaluation, and applied research
Experience executing projects and tasks independently, including large-scale initiatives
Experience leading discussions about data products, sources, and projects with executive leadership
Ability to identify and analyze data sets to meet customer requirements and translate complex findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences
Ability to be organized, multi-task, and respond quickly to urgent requests
Ability to work closely with executive leadership on large data projects and communicate effectively via email and phone
Secret clearance
Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Law, Engineering, Social Sciences, Physical Science, Applied Science, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics or Management

3+ years of experience with data analysis or data visualization with Power BI, Excel, or Tableau preferred

The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability

Description:
Description

About Us

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a best in class, seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

Position Overview

We are looking for a meticulous Senior Data Analyst with exceptional skills in data analytics and reporting to join our team. This role will serve as a vital link between our business intelligence team, commercial, and client success departments. The Senior Data Analyst will collaborate closely with both internal and client-facing teams to ensure seamless alignment across all analytics initiatives, performance measurement, and key insights. Reporting directly to the Executive Director of Data Strategy, this position is an integral part of the iBIDADS team.

Data Management & Analytics Support


Build, develop, and maintain datasets to support automated reporting solutions and program performance measurement, ensuring alignment with established SLAs.
Support commercial teams with data needs for performance reviews, business planning activities, and newly onboarded business.
Conduct ad hoc analysis to investigate and resolve program issues, providing critical support during QBR, Business Planning, and Launch Execution.
Manage third-party data integration and analysis, including shipping analytics and return-to-sender reconciliation processes.


Program Performance Analytics


Design and implement internal and client-facing program performance datasets, tracking and analyzing key SLA measurements and program KPIs.
Co-develop dashboards that visualize program performance trends, providing data-driven insights to client-facing teams and internal operational support.
Collaborate with both internal operations and client-facing BI teams to ensure consistent metrics and reporting.
Provide data-driven insights to the commercial and internal teams


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with internal and customer-facing BI departments on healthcare analytics initiatives, supporting the internal operations excellence team and commercial team with key performance insights.
Ensure consistent data definitions and metrics across both BI functions, contributing to monetization opportunities through consulting and data products.
Work closely with Product Engineering to ensure product features, enhancements, and changes are reflected in the datasets


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure accuracy, reliability, and security of all performance data, implementing data validation processes and quality control measures.
Document data lineage and maintain data dictionaries, collaborating with stakeholders to define business rules and metrics.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to continuously improve data management and analytics processes.


Requirements

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in data analysis, with at least 3 years focused on healthcare reporting.
Advanced skills in SQL and Python, with experience in database management.
Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Domo, or similar.
Strong understanding of healthcare metrics and reporting requirements.
Experience supporting commercial and operations teams with program performance and identification of opportunities.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Deep passion for data, analytics, and a natural curiosity to explore and extract key insights.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in the healthcare industry.
Proficiency in R for data manipulation.
Knowledge of data warehouse concepts and ETL processes.
Understanding of SLA management and performance metrics.
Experience working in dual-focused BI environments (internal and client-facing).
Familiarity with pharmacy management systems and logistics data.
Experience with data transfer agreements, data use agreements, and third-party data integration.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms.


Personal Attributes


Natural curiosity about data and its business implications.
Strong desire to track and improve program performance.
Can-do attitude with a passion for solving complex problems.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Excellent communication skills to translate technical findings to business stakeholders.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Team player willing to go the extra mile to support organizational goals.
Adaptable and responsive during high-pressure periods like launches, business planning, and quarterly reporting.
Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends.


What Success Looks Like


The commercial team consistently receives accurate, timely data for program management and performance.
Client-facing teams leverage insights to enhance customer relationships and drive business growth.
SLAs are consistently met for all reporting requirements, ensuring high standards of service.
New programs are seamlessly integrated into reporting and data systems.
Continuous improvement of data processes and reporting efficiency is achieved.
Seamless collaboration between internal and client-facing BI functions is maintained.
Operational metrics are effectively tracked and analyzed to drive commercial success and program performance.
Data sources are effectively integrated and governed, ensuring data quality and reliability.
Data security and privacy are maintained, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
Innovation and staying updated with industry trends are prioritized to maintain a competitive edge.
User satisfaction and feedback are actively sought and incorporated to continuously improve data solutions.

Status: Full-time

FLSA: Exempt

Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Data Analytics Senior Analyst is responsible for analyzing, preparing, and presenting data to support executive decision-making, project reporting, and operational performance tracking. This role focuses on developing structured reporting, dashboards, and data solutions while continuously improving data collection, quality, and efficiency. The position collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality insights and scalable reporting capabilities.

Key Responsibilities


Analyse, prepare data, and create reports for executive and project-level stakeholders
Prepare data, KPIs, and metrics for executive reports and presentations
Create various reports and dashboards for project management and executive reporting
Design report layouts with clear, high-level summaries, KPIs, and graphical presentations
Review existing data collection methods and identify continuous improvement opportunities
Develop and maintain tables, templates, trackers, and structured data models
Implement automation in data collection and reporting processes
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and readiness for reporting
Identify trends, patterns, and insights from structured and unstructured data
Support cross-functional teams with reporting and analytical needs
Develop and enhance business intelligence solutions and dashboards
Apply data transformation, cleansing, and standardization techniques
Continuously improve reporting processes for speed, quality, and efficiency


Qualifications


Minimum 8–10+ years of experience in data management and analysis
Strong experience with databases; relational databases preferred
Strong ability to summarize and interpret data and recognize trends and patterns
Experience with project reporting and executive-level reporting
Advanced user of Excel and Office tools
Experience with PowerQuery, Power BI, and similar reporting tools
Experience designing reports with strong visualization and presentation capabilities
Proficiency in SQL; knowledge of M and DAX is a plus
Programming experience (e.g., VBA or other languages) is a plus
Experience working with data structures, templates, and tracking tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong communication skills and ability to present complex data to non-technical stakeholders
Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources
Ability to work cross-functionally in a dynamic environment

High-Performance Culture

Financial Strength

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Medix Infusion is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team. This entry-level position is ideal for an individual who enjoys working with data, solving problems, and learning how analytics can support business operations and strategic decision-making.

The Data Analyst will assist with collecting, organizing, analyzing, and presenting data to help teams better understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement. The successful candidate will have foundational technical skills, strong attention to detail, and an eagerness to grow within a collaborative, healthcare-focused environment.

Medix Infusion is a technology-driven healthcare platform dedicated to enhancing patient care and access to infusion therapies. We specialize in disease management and infusion pharmacy services for chronic and acutely ill patients, particularly those in underserved communities. We provide personalized home and in-suite infusion therapies, including anti-infectives, biologics, IVIG, and other injectable treatments, with the goal of making each patient’s journey as smooth as possible.

Key Responsibilities


Collect, organize, and analyze data to support business operations and departmental initiatives.
Assist with developing and maintaining SQL queries for data extraction, validation, and analysis.
Prepare routine and ad hoc reports for business leaders and departmental stakeholders.
Create and maintain dashboards and data visualizations using Power BI.
Assist with cleaning, transforming, and validating data from multiple sources.
Review data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency, and report identified issues.
Work with team members to understand reporting needs and translate business questions into meaningful analyses.
Identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for operational improvement.
Document reporting processes, data definitions, and analytical procedures.
Assist with basic automation and data analysis using Python, Excel, or other available tools.
Participate in testing new reports, dashboards, and data solutions.
Present findings in a clear and understandable manner to technical and non-technical audiences.
Maintain the confidentiality and security of sensitive business, employee, and patient information.
Perform other duties and analytical projects as assigned.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
Foundational knowledge of data analysis, reporting, and visualization concepts.
Basic knowledge of SQL, including the ability to write or modify queries.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, filters, pivot tables, and charts.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to explain findings clearly to individuals with varying levels of technical knowledge.
Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and ask for guidance when needed.
Willingness to learn new technologies, systems, and healthcare business processes.
Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.


Preferred Qualifications


Internship, academic, or project experience involving data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence.
Exposure to Power BI, Tableau, or another data visualization platform.
Familiarity with DAX or an interest in developing DAX skills.
Basic experience with Python and/or R for data analysis or scripting.
Familiarity with cloud-based relational databases or data warehouses (Azure SQL preferred; exposure to Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery also relevant).
Experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to support analytical and coding tasks.
Basic understanding of data quality and data-management principles.
Experience working with APIs for data extraction or integration.
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint.
Interest in healthcare analytics, infusion services, specialty pharmacy, or healthcare operations.


Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the primary functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be required to frequently stand, walk, sit, bend, twist, talk, and hear. There may be prolonged periods of sitting, keyboarding, and reading. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include reading, distance, computer, and color vision. Talking and hearing are essential to communicate with patients, vendors, and staff.

Why Join Us?

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The Senior Data Analyst serves as a key resource for business intelligence, performance and operational analysisfor Central Health. Under general direction of the Central Health's Analytics Quality Manager, the Senior Data Analyst is responsible for organizing, analyzing and reporting on data from large clinical, financial, and enrollment datasets. They will also assist in the design and development of data warehouses, performance dashboards and other systems that support the needs of an integrated network of physicians, safety net providers and hospitals to advance care that is patient centered and data driven. This analyst will act as an Epic subject matter expert for front/back-end Epic reporting development.

Remote = Individuals in this position may work at an approved off-site location; however, they may be required to occasionally visit an on-site location in Austin, Texas.

Essential Functions


Collect and document business requirements for reporting and analysis initiatives with customers, which includes gathering, formatting and analyzing clinical, claims, eligibility, financial and other data from various sources to develop reports and dashboards.
Serve as an Analytics and Reporting lead on assigned projects.
Perform quantitative and/or qualitative data analysis and prepare results to share with internal and external customers.
Aid in design and development of data warehouse/data mart applications.
Create and maintain reports and dashboards for multiple stakeholders including clinical, operations, finance, planning, strategy, reimbursement and other Central Health teams.
Collaborate with IT (Joint Technologies) when necessary to automate reporting and to troubleshoot data issues.
Utilize SQL or other advanced analytic tools to perform data extract, integration and query functions. Identify and troubleshoot data anomalies and irregularities.
Work closely with Epic Business Intelligence Director to identify potential solutions for various reporting needs.
Builds SlicerDicer and Reporting Workbench reports and completes Epic Radar setup for custom SQL metrics.
Prepare written and oral reports that communicate necessary information to internal and external customers.
Produce and streamline as needed ongoing monthly, quarterly and annual reports in support of CentralHealth.
Become a data subject matter expert (SME) and understand various sources and applications of Central Health data.



Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Demonstrated ability and desire to lead projects.
Advanced SQL query writing with experience working in a Microsoft SQL Server environment.
Experience developing and troubleshooting programming code (e.g. SAS, R, Python, SQL).
Uses statistics to problem solve and perform moderately complex data analysis and validation.
Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects with varying deadlines.
Complies with data confidentiality and security procedures.
Demonstrated advanced experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Worked in a data cloud warehouse environment such as Snowflake.
Possesses a good understanding of healthcare data infrastructure including the creation of data pipelines and ETL processes in general.
Willingness to learn and work with new programming languages and analytics tools for extracting, manipulating and analyzing data.
Ability to write and speak clearly, easily communicating complex ideas and findings to different audiences.
Knowledge of healthcare, including medical claims coding, relationships between health plans, providers, and payers, a plus.
Demonstrates a strong curiosity and a deep-seated drive to solve complex problems.
Capable of discerning when a solution is sufficient to meet reporting needs.
Experience with healthcare data governance processes.
Strong attention to detail with a focus on validation and accuracy.



MINIMUM EDUCATION


High School Diploma or equivalent with an additional 5 years' experience in a related field (healthcare, statistics, experimental research, data science, economics or public health) will be considered in lieu of degree /
Bachelor's Degree Management Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or related quantitative discipline.



PREFERRED EDUCATION


Master's Degree Master’s degree in Management Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or related quantitative discipline.



MINIMUM EXPERIENCE


3 years of experience in healthcare, statistics, experimental research, data science, reporting and analytics, economics, or public health.
3 years experience in SQL (preferably T-SQL) or Python scripting with an advanced level of expertise.
3 years experience with MS Excel with an advanced level of expertise.
2 years experience in Tableau or other data visualization tool
2 years experience in report development within Epic EMR using Slicer/ Dicer, RWB, Clarity or Caboodle.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSURE

Epic Cogito Certification within 6 Months

Title: (USA) Data Analyst II
Description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...Role summary:

As a Data Analyst II, you will leverage advanced analytical techniques and business knowledge to support data-driven decision-making across multiple domains including product, finance, marketing, and technology. This role involves identifying relevant data sources, ensuring data quality, and applying statistical methods to generate actionable insights. You will collaborate with stakeholders to develop visualizations and reports that effectively communicate findings, while supporting process improvements and project delivery. The position requires strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

About the team:

The Data Ventures team advances Walmart’s data transformation by creating B2B data products that empower merchants and suppliers with timely, informed decisions. The team manages the entire data product lifecycle, emphasizing compliance reporting, data analysis, and business process enhancement. In this role you will be a part of the Research and Remediation team which focuses on ensuring that the data provided meets the business expectations once it has been put into production. You will research and present solutions for parity issues between enterprise applications and edge case scenarios which provide decision risk if unaddressed.

What you'll do:


Leverage business knowledge to ensure that we are meeting business needs for clients and internal users
Research data quality errors to understand root cause and quantify these opportunities to gain priority in the development road map
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business context and translate requirements into actionable insights.
Demonstrating proficiency in writing SQL queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets from relational databases, including experience with Hive and Google BigQuery
Support the identification and sourcing of relevant data from multiple systems and databases.
Partner with Account Management and Sales teams in order to drive trust and confidence in our data


What you'll bring:


Proficiency in data analysis techniques including exploratory data analysis and statistical methods using tools such as SQL, Python, and Excel.
Strong understanding of business domains including product, finance, marketing, sales, and technology to interpret and apply relevant business metrics.
Experience with data quality management practices, including profiling, cleansing, and validation to ensure accuracy and reliability of data.
Ability to develop clear data visualizations using tools like Tableau, PowerBI, or Python libraries to communicate insights effectively.
Knowledge of data sourcing, integration, and warehousing concepts to support analytical modeling and reporting.
Effective communication skills to present findings and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

The Work:

The Senior Data Analyst plays a critical role in the application migration team by leveraging data to drive informed decision-making throughout the migration process. This position is responsible for compiling and analyzing complex datasets, maintaining comprehensive reports, and presenting actionable insights to stakeholders. The Senior Data Analyst works within Agile frameworks to support the team's data-driven approach to application assessment, migration planning, and post-migration evaluation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collect and consolidate data from various sources related to application performance, usage, and migration progress
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency across all datasets
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of application data to identify patterns, trends, and potential issues
  • Perform statistical analysis to support decision-making in the migration process
  • Design and create comprehensive reports on various aspects of the migration project
  • Develop dashboards and visualizations to effectively communicate complex data insights
  • Maintain and update regular reports on migration progress, performance metrics, and KPIs
  • Create compelling visual representations of data findings using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar
  • Present data-driven insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Develop and deliver presentations on migration analytics to various levels of the organization
  • Conduct pre- and post-migration comparisons to evaluate the success of migration efforts
  • Provide data-driven insights to support decision-making at all levels of the project
  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for the migration project
  • Develop metrics to measure the success and efficiency of the migration process
  • Create and maintain scorecards to track progress against project goals
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives)
  • Collaborate with Product Owners to define and refine data-related user stories

Requirements:

  • Bachelors degree and minimum 5 years experience
  • Secret Security Clerance required
  • Demonstrated experience working with business stakeholders to understand business process, pain points, and insights that will deliver greatest value to the mission
  • Building and maintaining visualizations and dashboards in enterprise Business Intelligence tools (such as Tableau, PowerBI, Qlik, Microstrategy) or custom coding (D3, React, CSS)
  • Performing complex data pre-processing (joins, unions, aggregations) using tools and languages like SQL, R, or Python

Title: Sr Data Analyst
Description:
Company

Shared Services

Argo and Farm Family are specialty property and casualty insurance brands whose underwriting companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Clearbrook Holdings Inc. Argo and Farm Family partner with agents and brokers to provide insurance solutions that enable businesses to manage risks with confidence.

Job Description

Summary:

The Sr Data Analyst partners with stakeholders across P&C Operations (Underwriting, Product, Actuarial, Claims, and Marketing) to deliver advanced analytical insights that inform business strategy and operational decision-making.

This role’s responsibility includes performing data analysis (e.g., conceptualization, mining/modeling, and presentation of data) and developing methods to efficiently capture, manage, and analyze data.

The position serves as a trusted partner to business leaders by translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and identifying opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.

This is a 100% in-office position. Candidates must be able to work on-site at a designated company office during standard business hours.

Essential Responsibilities


Partners with stakeholders to define business problems, translate data needs into analytical solutions, and ensure alignment between business objectives and data outputs.
Develops and maintains methods to distribute management information, as appropriate, throughout P&C Operations using tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Designs, develops, and maintains dashboards (Power BI), reports, and data products for use throughout P&C Operations using the tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Develops and optimizes SQL queries, Python/PySpark scripts, and data pipelines to extract, transform, and validate data for analysis and reporting.
Independently leads analytics initiatives, managing priorities, timelines, and deliverables from intake through deployment.
Responds to support questions promptly, courteously, and accurately, with an analysis of the results and any issues or changes made with minimal guidance.
Synthesizes analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations, tailoring communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure enterprise reporting and analytics adhere to defined data governance standards, business rules, and data quality expectations.
Validates data accuracy and completeness across source systems and downstream reporting layers, identifying trends, anomalies, and data quality issues. Performs quality assurance checks to validate completeness and accuracy of data and/or deliverables for release with minimal guidance.
Supports recurring operational data needs (e.g., month‑end, quarter‑end, and ongoing production reporting cycles) by ensuring timely, accurate delivery of analytics and reports.
Identifies trends, patterns, and opportunities within data to support process improvements and strategic initiatives.

Additional Responsibilities


Document, update, and utilize the policies, procedures, and processes used throughout P&C Operations.
Mentor junior analysts by reviewing policies, procedures, and processes and validating the queries/code, reports, and dashboards for accuracy and quality.
Proactively identify opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders to remedy the errors timely with minimal guidance.
Ensures that the data produced remains secure, respecting corporate privacy and security procedures.
Assists with training for stakeholders in areas such as proper data usage, SQL, or Power BI.
Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure alignment between analytics solutions and enterprise data platforms (e.g., cloud data warehouses, semantic models, and BI environments).


Qualifications / Experience Required


Four to six years of relevant work experience
Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, computer science, data science, data analytics, or a related field. Equivalent work experience in a business or technical environment will be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
Proficient in Python/PySpark, SQL (CTE, window functions) and Power BI using graphs, charts, and map features.
Experience in data quality control/governance, data mining, and modeling
Working knowledge of emerging analytics technology (e.g., Agentic AI/ML concepts)
Strong soft skills with clear, effective oral and written communication.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake Ecosystem, and Visual Studio Code
Strong understanding of Property & Casualty insurance data concepts and operational workflows is preferred.


The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

Omaha & Albany Pay Range $95,000 - $115,000

Chicago Pay Range $103,000 - $133,000

NYC Pay Range $113,000 - $143,000

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas.

If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar state or local law and you wish to discuss potential reasonable accommodations related to applying for employment with us, please contact our Benefits Department at 210-321-8400.

Benefits And Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program—including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Core Values

At Clearbrook our Core Values are Integrity, Collaboration, Pursuit of Excellence and Forward Thinking. These values reflect who we are today and who we aspire to be - guiding how we work, how we lead and how we succeed.
